title: Hiking at the Lake of Gaube
short_description: A well-known hike to discover one of the Great Sites of Occitania, between the successive waterfalls at the Pont d'Espagne and the lake of Gaube further up. Not to be missed in the Hautes-Pyrénées!
long_description:
From the car park, turn right to cross a bridge over the Gave de Cauterets. A small climb awaits you before reaching the Pont d'Espagne. You may have the opportunity to cross a herd of sheep and their shepherds heading to the mountain pastures for the summer.
From the car park, turn right to cross a bridge over the Gave d'Cauterets.
Then head straight ahead on the path along the stream. You then take the path of a large gravelly and grassy track. Enjoy the panoramic views all the way up.
At the end of the trail, you'll find the path leading you to the top of the hill.
At the arrival of the chairlifts, the Cot d'Omi lookout invites you to learn more about the environment, the mountains, the fauna and flora of the area. This is followed by a very accessible path to reach the banks of the Gaube lake, a perfect spot for a picnic.
This is followed by a beautiful walk along the lake.
This beautiful hike is then continued along the GR10 on a more stony and wooded path for 2 km. This more or less uneven descent allows you to reach the starting point of this circuit.

title: A classic hike in the Bucegi Mountains: Jepii Mici & Jepii Mari
short_description: This is one of the classic hikes that almost anyone attempts in the Bucegi Mountains. It conveniently starts and ends in Busteni, climbing through Jepii Mici, descending on Jepii Mari, plus a short stop at Cabana Caraiman. Despite its popularity, the route is not an easy one, given the significant elevation gain.
long_description:
Jepii Mici & Jepii Mari (loosely translated as the big & small junipers) are any mountaineer's nightmare. Whichever direction you choose, the pressure exerted on your knees, in particular, is extreme. However, many prefer to endure this pressure and choose the route for its accessibility, challenges, and scenery.
The route offers quite an all-inclusive mountain experience with steep ascents, exposed areas (chain-secured), a vast alpine plateau where you have to find your way around, bypassing a sheepfold (where you might encounter dogs), slippery snow patches even during summer, and a seemingly endless descent through the forest. The landscape constantly changes from mixed forests to rocky cliffs, and waterfalls, then to the unmistakable bare alpine plateau of the Bucegi Mountains, and junipers.
If necessary you can take shelter at the Caraiman Cabin, although the cabin itself is closed.

title: Travessia Marins Itaguaré
short_description: Being one of the most classic mountain crossings of the Serra da Mantiqueira and Brazil, Marins-Itaguar impresses everyone by its beauty and the incredible challenges encountered.
long_description: Long distance trail lasting three days over the crests of the Mantiqueira Mountains, connecting the Marins Peak (2,420m) and Itaguar Peak (2,308m), which mark the border between the states of S&atildeo Paulo and Minas Gerais.It is a very technical mountain traverse, full of beauty and challenges through the high peaks of the Mantiqueira Mountains. Its crests are made of stacked rocks, which shows several crevices. Many parts of the walk are over rocky ground, with ascents and descents on little visible and marked trails, some stretches of climbing and rock climbing, in some points é necessary the use of ropes and chair, as for the arrival at é the summit of the Pico do Itaguar é. Due to the various ups and downs, the weight of the backpack on account of the lack of á water on the trail, this crossing requires a lot of physical preparation.

title: Views of the South Chuya Range
short_description: Four photo-points with views of the South-Chuyskiy Range. The length of the hike along picturesque rivers of the Altai Mountains is about 20 km in one direction;
long_description: The South Chuisky Range is located to the south of the North Chuisky Range and the highest peak here is Mount Irbistu (3967). The slopes of the South ridge are less forested than the North ridge, so in good weather the panoramic view of the Altai beauties can be seen for 50 km.

title: Abenteuer im Dschungel: Eine Wanderung durch Iquitos' grüne Wildnis
short_description: Tauche ein in das pulsierende Herz des Amazonas mit einer Wanderung durch den Dschungel von Iquitos. Entdecke die unberührte Natur, exotische Tierwelt und erlebe ein unvergessliches Abenteuer inmitten des üppigen Grüns.
long_description: Erkunde den faszinierenden Regenwald von Iquitos bei einer geführten Wanderung voller Abenteuer. Tauche ein in das üppige Grün des Dschungels und erlebe die einzigartige Atmosphäre der schwülen Tropen. Während einer 2- bis 3-stündigen Wanderung führt dich ein erfahrener Guide durch dichte Vegetation, vorbei an exotischen Pflanzen und wild lebenden Tieren. Du wirst die Gelegenheit haben, die Vielfalt der Tier- und Pflanzenwelt zu beobachten und faszinierende Geschichten über den Regenwald und seine Ökosysteme zu erfahren. Dein Guide wird dich auch über die Bedeutung des Schutzes dieser wertvollen Umgebung informieren. Bereite dich auf eine unvergessliche Reise in die Wildnis vor, während du den Regenwald von Iquitos erkundest und die Wunder dieser einzigartigen Natur hautnah erlebst.

title: Fairy Fortress
short_description: A hike for the whole family, not without some challenges, to the Dacian fortress also known as the Fortress of Zânelor, discovered on the outskirts of Covasna.
long_description:
The hike starts out relaxing, like a walk in the woods. Signposts show about an hour's walk. You cross a river, then an area with camping huts, which unfortunately doesn't seem to work.
After a few gentle meanders, you emerge into a clearing where you come across a farmhouse - alone, isolated, guarded by several chained dogs. Here you can buy natural syrups.
Further on, the forest almost completely engulfs you. A series of informative, well-documented panels prepare you for the „înt” encounter with the fortress at the end of the road. The same panels help you to înderstand what the area would have looked like in Dacian times.
The trail along the forest road suddenly breaks off to continue very steeply through the forest. It follows a continuous climb up the terraces of the Fortress Hill, once inhabited by the people around the fortress.
More improvised stairs, then through slightly trampled grass, the route climbs upwards to the first terrace of the fortress, where there is shelter and benches for resting.
After a few more steps, you reach the only (reconstructed) walls dug out of the ground by archaeologists. To see them better, you have to climb higher. In fact, the entire fortress - what's left of it - is underground. The few visible traces can be disappointing, as is the lack of panorama due to vegetation. But at least the journey was a welcome one.

title: थुंपासेरी इस्टेट टरैक
short_description: थुंपासेरी इस्टेट ट्रेल, केरल राज्य के करावलूर गांव में स्थित एक रबर बागान की बाहरी सीमा से होकर गुजरने वाली छोटी लेकिन सुन्दर लूप ट्रेल है।
long_description:
थुंपासेरी इस्टेट ट्रैक केरल राज्य की राजधानी तिरुवनंतपुरम से लगभग 65 किमी दूर करावलूर गांव में स्थित एक नेचर ट्रेल है। यह ट्रेल मार्ग सभी स्तर के हाइकर्स के लिए उपयुक्त है। इसमें सुंदर जंगली फूल और अनछुआ प्राकृतिक परिदृश्य देखने को मिलता हैं। यह ट्रेल मार्ग प्रमुख तौर पर हाइकिंग, सुबह की सैर, और बर्ड वाचिंग के लिए इस्तेमाल की जाती है और साल भर खुली रहती है।
थुंपासेरी इस्टेट करावलूर इलाके में मौजूद ऊंची पहाड़ियों में से एक पर स्थित है। प्रथम विश्व युद्ध के दौरान रबड़ की बढ़ती हुई माँग को पूरा करने के लिए स्वर्गीय श्री टी जे मैथ्यू ने इसकी स्थापना एक रबड़ बागान के रूप में की थी। आजकल यहाँ रबर के पेड़ों की आंशिक छाया के नीचे काली मिर्च भी उगाई जाती है।
एस्टेट में बारहमासी झरने, हरी-भरी वनस्पति और पुराने समय की बिखरी हुई पत्थर की खदानें हैं। एक छोटे ट्रैक के लिए यह मार्ग बहुत उपयुक्त है।

images.caption: केरल में पदयात्रा मार्ग: थुंपासेरी इस्टेट ट्रैक

title: Drumeție spre cetatea Starigrad (Fortica)
short_description:
Abordăm cei aproape 300 m diferență de nivel pe un traseu ceva mai lung, în schimb mai ușor abordabil. Traseul ne oferă o panoramă superbă a orașului pe tot timpul urcării.
Translate to English

images.caption: Drumul spre Fortica este bine marcat

title: Chlustobelweg
short_description: Experience the exciting Chlustobel between Weissbad and Brülisau with all your senses.
long_description:
Have you ever taken a stone from a stream, turned it over and watched what sticks to it or hastily crawls away? Do you have any idea how many animals your feet are standing on right now? Come with us on a voyage of discovery into the unknown known! Keep your eyes and nose open, prick up your ears and let your senses run free. Immerse yourself in the mysterious Chlustobel!
The nature discovery trail is suitable for young and old alike. Five panels provide information about the nature of the Chlustobel and its inhabitants. Short instructions encourage exciting observations and fun games.
You should allow two to three hours for the walk if you want to experience the information and observations.

images.caption: Panorama from Hoher Kasten over the Stauberenfirst to Lake Sämtis

title: Hochgratlauf - Salomon Trailrunning Cup
short_description: This run is designed for ambitious runners. In addition to a professional organisation, the Hochgratberglauf impresses with the great panorama of Bavaria and unique nature experiences are guaranteed. This run is a mixture of amateur and professional sport, where hobby runners can compete with top athletes.
long_description: The start of the run is the Hochgratbahn valley station at 858m above sea level. The finish is at 1708m altitude and is the Hochgratbahn mountain station. The total length of the route is 6040m with a difference in altitude of 850m. From the start, the course runs for about 2000m on an asphalt road that is about four metres wide. The rest of the route is a mountain path about 2 metres wide. In wet road and path conditions, running shoes with non-slip soles should be used.

title: The Pointe de Dinan - Crozon Peninsula
short_description: Starting from the beach of Goulien, this superb walk between the sea and the countryside will allow you to discover the Pointe de Dinan. Its natural fortress-like shape and its castle-like appearance have earned it the name of Dinan Castle.
long_description: You follow the GR34 coastal path for more than 4km and return to your starting point via beautiful country roads.

images.caption: Pointe de Dinan - GR34 - Crozon peninsula
circuit de randonnée - Crozon: La Pointe de Dinan - Presqu'île de Crozon

title: Wanderung zum Berg der Sieben Farben (Vinicunca) & weiter zum Roten Tal
short_description: Erkunde die atemberaubende Schönheit des Vinicunca-Berges, bekannt als Berg der Sieben Farben, und setze deine Reise fort ins magische Rote Tal. Tauche ein in die beeindruckende Landschaft, erlebe die einzigartigen Farben der Natur und vermeide dabei die überfüllten Touristenmengen. Ein unvergessliches Abenteuer erwartet dich auf dieser Route.
long_description: Erkunde die beeindruckende Schönheit des Vinicunca-Berges, auch bekannt als Berg der Sieben Farben, und setze deine Reise fort ins malerische Rote Tal. Durch die umgekehrte Reihenfolge vermeidest du Menschenmassen und lange Warteschlangen. Die einzigartigen Farben des Berges werden durch verschiedene Mineralien wie rote Ton- und Tonsteinablagerungen, quarzhaltigen Sandstein, eisenhaltige Tone und kalkhaltigen Sandstein erzeugt. Tauche ein in diese faszinierende Landschaft und erlebe unvergessliche Momente fernab der Massen.

title: Stroll through Moniga del Garda
short_description: Leisurely hike for the whole family
long_description: The route leads from the harbour through Moniga del Garda to the "Castello" and St. Martin's Church, through the centre and then along the beach back to the harbour.

images.caption: Wanderung am Gardasee: Spaziergang durch Moniga del Garda
Aussicht von der Burg in Moniga

title: Short walking route through the dunes of Texel
short_description: During this route, you will walk through the dunes of Texel.
long_description: This part of the dunes belongs to the National Park Dunes of Texel. This is not without reason, because it is a beautiful area.

title: Early autumn trek in Varghis Gorges
short_description: This is the classic route through Varghis Gorges (Cheile Vârghișului), perfect to trek in autumn to see the entire color palette specific to the season.
long_description:
It is an easy route in terms of difficulty, moderate in terms of duration, which does not pose accessibility problems. Just follow the path marked with a blue cross that leads from one end of the gorges to the other.
The route is more spectacular in the first half: the rocks that rise steeply from the water, huge boulders with strange shapes, caves and grottoes, the forest that seems to grow straight from the water's edge, wooden bridges, and the winding course of the Vârghiș brook. Many people give up when the more spectacular rock clusters end, which is somewhere three-quarters of the way. But it's a shame not to go all the way till the end.
On the last part, there's a more exposed segment, with iron bars for more safety. You emerge in a meadow where you can take a picnic break.

images.caption: Two of the markings on the trail

title: Hiking at Mont de Gez
short_description: A beautiful loop to reach the top of the Mont de Gez and enjoy a superb panorama of the Argelès-Gazost valley, the Gave de Pau and the surrounding Pyrenean massifs.
long_description:
The hike begins with a stony but very shady and green path. One gradually climbs the path through the forest. Halfway up, there are only a few meters left before reaching the summit (1095 m altitude) of Mont de Gez.
The panoramic view over the Gave de Pau valley and the Estaing valley with the Pic du Cabaliros is superb.
The return is again through the forest but by another path before finishing the hike by the same path as the outward journey.

title: Around Kempten
short_description: We experience a very varied and often also panoramic hike through the near surroundings of Kempten.
long_description:
This tour is probably reserved for specialists, as it was put together specifically for the purpose of circumnavigating Kempten. Attractive sections alternate with passages that are easy to walk in order to keep the workload within reasonable limits and to close the circle. The tour can also be hiked throughout the winter, as long as the snow conditions permit. However, you should be aware that sections of the trail may be icy and therefore difficult to walk on.
First we hike along the route of the former Kempten - Isny railway line. Then we climb up to the Mariaberg and enjoy the beautiful view of the typical Allgäu landscape. At the halfway point we cross the Iller. We dive into the valley of the Leubas, feel the proximity of the motorway, leave Kempten Ost on the right and reach the Iller again shortly before the finish. Finally, we explore the Hermannstobel before taking the shortest route to our destination.

images.caption: Former railway bridge over the Rottach.
Lone pine tree on the Mariaberg.
View of the Alps west of the Grünten.
The Kollerbach near the hamlet of the same name.
Former water pumping station of Lauben.

title: Transverse path Gengenbach
short_description: We set out on a three-day hike through the beautiful Black Forest. Some very demanding ascents and descents take us through several river valleys and up mountains with great views. Far away from cities or larger towns, we enjoy the solitude of nature - but also have to provide ourselves with sufficient water and provisions.
long_description:
Stage 1: Gengenbach - Bärhag (Nordrach) (16 km)
We start our tour in the old town of Gengenbach and immediately leave the valley of the Kinzig. We hike steadily uphill for the first few hours to the Mooskopf, where we are rewarded for our efforts with fantastic views. On the way, we can still see the damage caused by hurricane Lothar in 1999 and, after reaching the summit (lookout tower), get ready for the descent into the Nordrachtal.
Stage 2: Bärhag - Schapbach (20 km)
Today also starts with a challenging climb. However, this is less long than yesterday and soon we have a relaxed, relatively climb-free stage on forest paths ahead of us, which ends with a descent into the spa town of Bad Rippoldsau-Schapbach. Apart from a few huts with places to stop for refreshments, we will hardly encounter any signs of human settlement today, but instead devote ourselves entirely to the pleasure of hiking in the wonderful mixed forest.
Stage 3: Schapbach - Alpirsbach (16 km)
Our feet have already become accustomed to starting the day with a steep climb and so we hike uphill first on the last stage. In the process, we not only experience almost endless forest areas, but also the former nunnery of Wittichen (17th century) and the monastery in Alpirsbach, where we end our tour.

title: Overseas Highway
short_description: The Overseas Highway is a stunning coastal highway which connects the famous Florida Keys with the US mainland. As the southernmost leg of the freeway U.S.1, the freeway is the only connection between more than 40 islands.
long_description:
Do you feel like winding down your window, enjoying the breeze on your skin while Florida’s warming sun is shining upon the highway? This route will give you a sense of unlimited freedom. Besides the famous route 66 there are only a few roads and freeways that make you feel this kind of special spirit like the Overseas Highway does.
It is part of the mighty U.S. Highway 1 and known for its incredible engineering: More than 40 oversea bridges of concrete and steel connect the giant freeway. The most famous of them is the Seven Mile Bridge, an 11-km-long (6.8 miles) construction between Bahia Honda Key and Vaca Key.
A total of 205 km (127 miles) give you a spectacular view onto the shimmering Atlantic Ocean, the sunny Florida Bay and the picturesque Florida Keys.

images.caption: Seven Miles Brige towards Marathon, Florida
Monument at the entry of Everglades National Park
Bird's eye view of Seven Mile Bridge

title: Romantic walk around Păltiniș mountain resort
short_description: This is an easy walk around Păltiniș resort. It follows a "romantic route" - as it is also called by some locals - on the hills of the Cindrel Mountains. The picturesque and beautiful landscapes fully justify this name.
long_description:
The walk starts on the opposite side of the Platoș Arena sky slope, a few hundred meters away from the main road. For a start, we followed the wide forest road, also suitable for bicycles, and often preferred by ATV enthusiasts, as I noticed.
Initially, the landscape displayed only scattered fir trees, which have been miraculously spared by the loggers. Somewhere to the right stood the higher peaks of the Cindrel Mountains. We could see especially the barren Poiana Găujoara - a meadow in the middle of dense pine forests - making a contrasting note.
Our footsteps carried us a little deeper into the forest; after about 10-15 minutes, the path emerged into some meadows with panoramic views - first toward Fântânele Cabin, then toward the hills above Gura Râului Lake. We passed some holiday cabins or shelters, and we ventured randomly on a few paths, trodden mostly by locals or shepherds. For a break, we settled on top of a hill, overlooking Gura Râului village.

images.caption: The dirt road at the beginning of the walk
One of the many picturesque views during your walk
You come across many paths that lead who knows where

title: Mulder Cycle Route - United Mulde
short_description: An easy, mostly flat tour that can be ridden in one or more days. We cycle 122 km in the Mulde Valley in Saxony-Anhalt to Dessau.
long_description: Can be done individually or as a connecting tour to the Mulderadweg - Freiberger Mulde or Mulderadweg - Zwickauer Mulde. The Mulderadweg is not a man-made cycle path. It runs on little-used public roads and partly on hiking trails. The area around the cycle path is also called the "Valley of Castles" because of the many castles and ruins.

title: Climbing Engetal's three peaks: Aggenstein, Brentenjoch and Roßberg
short_description: Why be content with only going up one mountain in a day when you can be greedy and do three. From Grän in Tannheimer Tal, this mountain hike takes you up to the ridge that runs from the very popular Aggenstein to the less-visited Roßberg.
long_description:
One of the striking features of this trip is what you see from the ridge, which lies on the absolute edge of the Alps. The view looking north stretches out as far as the eye can see across the flatness of Bavaria whereas to the south, you are presented with a wall of seemingly unending mountains and jaw-dropping awesomeness. You can even make out Schloß Neuschwanstein if you look in the direction of Füssen. 
The other notable experience of this route is the flow of traffic. The Aggenstein gets very crowded as the day wears on (I guess the Bad Kissinger Hütte is a big draw), which is why I recommend you climb it first. By contrast, Roßberg comes across as a pretty lonely and unloved peak and one that we had entirely to ourselves.

images.caption: Approaching the summit cross of Roßberg.
Brentenjoch of the left and Aggenstein on the right.
The view across the valley from Aggenstein

title: Bückebergweg
short_description: This main hiking trail takes us through the outstanding natural relief of the Weserbergland in three daily stages. The route is marked "X11" and has a lot to offer culturally as well as scenically.
long_description:
Stage 1: Porta Westfalica - Bad Eilsen (19.6 km)
The first section of the route starts in Porta Westfalica and initially runs uphill to the so-called "Porta-Kanzel", which offers us excellent views. Following the Weser Mountains eastwards through wooded hills, we leave them only at Kleinbremen and continue our way through the fields. There, picturesque mills await us along the way and the Kleinbremen visitor mine, a showpiece of the Weserbergland, which provides an insight into life in the past "underground". Via Bückeburg, which captivates with its castle, we make our way to the Harrlberg and the Idaturm with its magnificent views, before arriving in Bad Eilsen.
  Stage 2: Bad Eilsen - Reinsdorf (17.5 km)
On the second day we set off on the ascent to the Steinberg, which marks the start of the Bückeberge. Green slopes and small woods provide variety on the way east. On our way along the ridge, not only magnificent views await us, but also one or two caves - one of the most rewarding is the Hühnerbachstollen, a truly magical place for rock lovers. In the last section of the route, the road slowly descends again and we leave the mountainous terrain to set up our quarters in Reinsdorf.
  Stage 3: Reinsdorf - Bad Nenndorf (16.2 km)
The last stage of the day begins on the already familiar route, which now takes us back to the hiking trail through the Bückeberge mountains. The usual wonderful nature is again our constant companion, while we briefly leave the hills at Reinsen, which, however, have us back a little later. Once again we pass through tree-rich heights on the way to the Heisterberg. Here we also pass the venerable Heisterschlösschen before reaching the tranquil Beckedorf. Now we have the last section of the route ahead of us, which leads through the fields to Bad Nenndorf. There we have reached our destination, but we should take time for the numerous sights, such as the Agnes Miegel House or the spa park on the Galgenberg.

title: Walking Around Karakilic Village
short_description: With this route in Adana's Karakılı neighbourhood, you can breathe the fresh air of the countryside and look at the hills through the greenery.
long_description:
Adana's köys offer a variety of experiences, both in terms of its bölge structure and the cleanliness of the air you breathe. There are many routes to be explored in the Köy phase. While experiencing these routes, you both discover the local life of the böl region and breathe the köy air. 
Karakılı Köyü is located in Karaisalı province of Adana. It is 64 km to Adana and 14 km to Karaisalı province. This route is a route travelling around Karakılı. The route, which is about 14 km long, first reaches Topuşur Watchtower. Afterwards, the route, which provides backtracking from the tower, reaches Karakılı location from a different line. You go round Kabalak Hill and re-enter Karakılı. 
This route, which blends greenery and rocks, reveals the geography of the region. With the route, you get a beautiful view of the hills.
If you are looking for nature walks in Adana and the winter weather suits you, you can experience this route.

title: From Jungholz to Edelsberg mountain
short_description: Promising hike from Jungholz on the Edelsberg towards Nesselwang. The landscape and the view offer an absolute highlight for hiking fans.
long_description: A wonderful hike (medium level)  can be enjoyed on the designated paths. The inspiration and diversity of nature and landscape is beautiful. Many sights can be discovered. On the way up to the summit there are various places to stop for refreshments (sometimes only 100 meters deviating from the specified route). After around 2 hours you will be at the end of the hike, the Edelsberg summit. From there you can enjoy a view of the vast landscape of the Allgäu.

title: Försterweg
short_description: We hike across the entire Dübener Heide Nature Park on the Forester's Trail and experience numerous botanical and geological features. From Bergwitz we follow the "yellow crossbar in white field" markings for almost 60 km to Doberschütz.

title: Bohusleden - Section 6 - Grandalen to Lysevatten
short_description: The fourth stage of the Bohusleden trail leads from Grandalen through the Svartedalen nature reserve via Bottestugan to Lake Lysevatten.
long_description: Our route today also leads through hilly countryside. Svartedalen is the largest contiguous nature reserve in southern Sweden and is characterised by its numerous lakes, which invite you to swim, fish and canoe. The extensive forests are home to many bird species, and berries and mushrooms also thrive here. Along the path you will find the ruins of some cottages, which remind you of the former agricultural use of the region;

title: Apuseni: Circuit din Glăvoi cu 3 obiective
short_description:
Acest traseu e o variantă mai lungă și mai diversă a circuitului Cetăților Ponorului - pe care le include parțial, dar le omite pe jumătate pentru a-ți arăta ceva mai multe peisaje și a face un ocol generos înainte de a reveni la Glăvoi.
Translate to English
long_description:
Pe scurt, traseul include următoarele puncte de reper din Munții Apuseni:
Cetățile Ponorului
Avenul Borțig
Piatra Galbenei
Ghețarul Focul Viu
La fel ca în circuitul Cetăților, drumeția începe și se încheie în Poiana Glăvoi. Ba mai mult, prima jumătate de drumeției este similară cu circuitul.
În a doua parte, însă, te lipsești de panoramele impresionante de deasupra formațiunilor carstice pentru a vedea alte fenomene carstice. La circa 20 de minute de urcuș ușor din punctul unde se despart traseele, te întâmpină gura uriașă de pâlnie a Avenului Borțig. Poți admira hăurile pâlniei din diverse unghiuri, cu grijă, apoi pornești mai departe.
Până la Piatra Galbenei drumul poate părea o interminabilă succesiune de suișuri și coborâșuri prin pădure. Însă e o ocazie bună de admirat pădurile virgine ale Apusenilor și a te bucura de umbră, dacă ziua e călduroasă. De pe piatră, ai vedere până departe spre Groapa Ruginoasă și pârtiile de la Arieșeni.
Ultimul obiectiv - ghețarul - s-ar putea să te dezamăgească. Mic, topit, ascuns sub noroi și crengi, aparent neîngrijit, anulează puțin din frumusețea a tot ce ai văzut până în acest punct. Nici măcar explicațiile fenomenului, de pe panourile informative, nu reușesc să îi spele onoarea ponosită.
Coborârea spre Glăvoi se face pe o potecă fermecătoare prin scările de rădăcinile și suprafețele generoase acoperite cu mușchi verde. 
Translate to English

images.caption: Marcaje între Cetățile Ponorului și Avenul Borțig
O parte din traseu e inclusă într-un semimaraton local

title: Thermal grassland from the foot of the Sopron Hills to the plain of the Drava
short_description: Soaking in the warm water after a long roll is always a turn off. This thermal loop connects 16 thermal spas in the western half of Hungary in a multi-day cycling tour.
long_description: This thermal pool leads from Balf all the way to Barcs. From Lake Fertő, we cycle through the Kisalföld, the Zala hills and the Inner Somogy to the banks of the Drava. We will visit the Sopron and Zala wine regions, and admire Lake Hévíz and Lake Balaton. On our way we can stop at the Sárvár arboretum, the Kemenes Volcano Park or the Batthyány Castle in Zalaszentgrót. After each stage you can take a rest in a thermal bath. The majority of these thermal baths are certified thermal waters, all of which are suitable for the treatment of musculoskeletal disorders, among others. Through this series of tours, we can indulge in our favourite hobby of cycling while maintaining our joints.

Hungary is waiting for you - Balf
Sonnentherme und Hotel Sonnenpark****S von oben

title: Jungholz - Ifenblick - hiking tour
short_description: Moderate hiking tour with scenic and cultural highlights in the Allgaeu Alps.
long_description: This hike in the Tyrolean and Allgaeu Alps offers far-reaching views of the alpine landscape, cultural highlights and pure nature. The well-maintained and signposted trails are a highlight for every hiker. Silence and tranquillity are pre-programmed, so that a lasting impression will be created by a moderately difficult walk on this tour.

title: Trail running up Pflumberg from Lenzkirch, Black Forest
short_description: If you're looking for relatively short trail runs in the Lenzkirch area, this route up the Pflumberg is a pretty good option. You could even hike it if running isn't your thing.
long_description:
This route is as decent enough as any in the nearby area for providing a taster of the Black Forest - plus you can be assured of some wonderfully fresh air.
The route is quite straightforward and takes you along forestry trails on a steady incline to the unmarked top of the Pflumberg, which has an elevation just shy of 1,100m. From here, you continue to circumnavigate the upper flanks of the hill until you eventually drop down to arrive back in Lenzkirch. 
One of the best parts of this route for me was the complete lack of people I encountered, despite doing the run on a weekend in decent weather. I guess you get spoilt for choice about where to go if you're surrounded by awesome forest. 
Have fun.

title: Marken walking route
short_description:
During this approximately 6-kilometre route, you will discover the Marken peninsula. 
.
long_description: Marken used to be really an island nowadays it is a peninsula. During this route you will have a beautiful view of the IJsselmeer. There is also a lot to see on the island. Residents used to build their houses on wooden stilts. This was done to cope with floods. Due to the construction of the afsluitdijk there are no more floods, but these yards, as these houses are called, still exist.

images.caption: The special houses on the island

title: Har Hanegev
short_description: A long linear walking route (trek) that starts in the settlement in Merhav with, passes by desert landscapes and ends at Mitzpe Ramon.
long_description: The Negev Mountain Trail is a linear experiential desert trek with a total walking length of about 65 kilometers. Due to the length of the route, it is customary to do it in a recommended number of 5 segments depending on the ability and fitness of the travelers.

images.caption: The view from Ben Gurion's tomb estate
Nahal Tzin as seen from the Ben-Gurion Midrash
A hiker looks at the Ramon Crater

title: Von Niedernhausen nach Wiesbaden
short_description:
Wir erleben eine kurzweilige Wanderung durch eine abwechslungsreiche Landschaft.
Translate to English
long_description:
Von Niedernhausen gelangen wir durch das Theißtal hinauf zu den Hügeln. Von dort wandern wir hinab in das Tal des Rambaches. Durch den Kurpark erreichen wir die Innenstadt von Wiesbaden.
Translate to English

title: Loferer Alm - Adventure Hiking Trail & Waterfall Trail
short_description: The "Auf der Alm" adventure trail at the Loferer Alm lifts offers interesting facts about the alpine pasture habitat and fascinating nature experiences along the waterfall trail, ideal for kids from 4 years
long_description: Take cable car I of the Loferer Alm-Bahnen up to Loderbichl, where we start with the adventure hiking trail "Auf die Alm". 12 interesting stations make the hike informative and very entertaining for children. On the one hand, the information boards provide interesting facts about the Loferer Alm and its habitat, but they also provide playful variety;

title: Apuseni: Circuit Peștera Cetățile Rădesei
short_description:
Circuitul Peșterii Cetățile Rădesei merită încercat pentru traversarea spectaculoasă a peșterii. Traseu presupune provocări mai ales pentru cei neantrenați sau cu rău de înălțime. Totuși, inclusiv familii cu copii fac acest traseu, deci se poate.
Translate to English
long_description:
Circuitul face parte dintr-un parcurs mai lung ce include și Cheile Someșului Cald, momentan închis accesului turistic. Așa că nu-ți rămâne decât să parcurgi peștera și apoi să revii la locul de unde ai pornit (probabil Șaua Vărășoaia) pe poteca circulară.
Pentru început, traseul îți face o scurtă introducere în peisajul sălbatic al pădurilor din Munții Apuseni, pe o potecă îngustă, umbroasă. Străbați în ușoară coborâre niște poieni cu multă vegetație și tufe de afine.
Aproape de peșteră, ajungi la o intersecție de poteci. Dacă o iei în jos, intri în peșteră. Dacă o iei în sus, vei continua traseul și vei coborî la capătul celălalt al peșterii, ca să o parcurgi din direcția respectivă. Nu există o variantă mai bună sau mai rea.

title: Short Walk in Polonezkoy
short_description: A short trip to take a breath of nature air and explore a few places
long_description:
Polonezk öy is a destination for many Istanbulites... It harbours the sounds of birds, the embrace of lush green nature and much more. In Polonezköy, you can get in touch with nature.
There are many things to do in this cosy region far from the city life. This short walking route takes us from the Church of Our Lady of Czestochova and back to the same location. We visit the church, which has a great historical value for Polonezk öy, before the route. After completing our journey in this region with its magnificent nature, we have the chance to see other places in Polonezköy. 
This route, which brings you together with nature and adds something in terms of culture and culture, is quite short. It can be completed in about 2 hours on a 7 km round-trip track, without rest periods. It is an ideal route for those who do not want to be separated from nature on Sunday and who do not want to be tired before going back to work.

title: Plimbare din Glăvoi la Izbucul Ponor
short_description:
Dacă ajungi la Glăvoi, o plimbare până în Poiana Ponor și apoi spre Izbucul Ponor sunt minimul de efort fizic pe care-l poți încerca în zonă. Unde mai pui că ponorul și izbucul sunt fenomene particulare Munților Apuseni.
Translate to English
long_description:
Din Glăvoi, urci puțin pe o cărare pietruită tăiată parcă anume pentru turiști prin mijlocul pădurii de conifere. Ieși la o magine de pădure, lângă pășuni străbătute de turmele din zonă. În nici 30 de minute ajungi în Poiana Ponor, un fenomen carstic fascinant prin culorile vii ale naturii și senzația de feeric pe care o lasă stâncile străjuitoare și prezența unui fir de apă de la un capăt la celălalt al poienii.
Pe un panou poți citi mai multe despre specificul acestei forme de relief și tot aici ai și direcția pe care trebuie să o urmezi: stânga pe lângă apă.
Izbucul fiind locul de unde țâșnește apa la suprafață, ideea e să urmezi cursul râului. Vei trece un podeț de lemn peste apă, iar aici cotește stânga pe lângă apă, chiar dacă semnele te îndeamnă să continui spre dreapta.
După câteva salturi din piatră în piatră, vei ajunge la locul de unde izvorăște apa, care nu e deloc un izvor ci un lac, Locul de ieșire la suprafață rămâne ascuns ochiului, în adâncul carstului.

title: Classic hike in Cindrel Mountains - Bătrâna Pass & Rozdești Peak
short_description: The fastest route to the ridge of the Cindrel Mountains starts next to the chairlift from Păltiniș resort; it reaches the Bătrâna Pass before meeting the main path. At least up to the pass, this is an ideal route for families with children who love hiking.
long_description:
Trekking from Păltiniș to Bătrâna Pass is pleasant and relaxing; you cover a coniferous forest for the most part. For children dying for a little activity, but also for those who are less accustomed to hiking, this easy trip is the ideal pretext to spend some time in nature. The signposts indicate about 2 hours to reach the pass.
The only difficult part might seem hiking in Poiana Găujoara (after about an hour since leaving Păltiniș). Looking backward when you're here, the wide views towards the resort and over the melancholy peaks of the Cindrel might make you forget your tiredness.
Moving onward, you pass a sheepfold. In summer, the landscape is probably idyllic and specific to this corner of the country. With the Bătrâna peak on the left and the Surdu peak on the right, the Bătrâna saddle leads you straight into the main ridge route.
From the saddle, we advanced for another hour (in winter conditions) to the top of Rozdești (1951m). On the way back, for variation, we also climbed the Bătrâna peak (1911m) - on an unmarked, but easy to guess route.

images.caption: Forest path from Paltinis to Poiana Gaujoara
The ridge path in Cindrel Mountains, with Rozdesti Peak in the far-end

title: Uboka Hidden Beach
short_description: The route describes the road between the parking place on the side of road 66 and the picturesque Uboka beach, hidden from view behind a coniferous forest.
long_description:
Uboka beach, like most beaches in Mosceniscina, was formed by torrential rivers flowing from Ucka to the sea, eroding the stony material and forming a beach. After rainy periods, you can still see the creek that bisects the beach in Uboka Bay, while in the sea it creates a great swirl of fresh water.
Uboka is more difficult to reach by land, especially before the construction of the road between Moscenika Draga and Brsec, which was completed in 1954 with the contribution of the locals.
The local population mainly fished for their own consumption. They built stone fishermen's houses (barracks) in which they stored their nets, fishing equipment and boats, which they pulled out of the sea to protect them from the strong north and south winds.

title: Apuseni: Cetățile Ponorului (circuit)
short_description:
Unul din cele mai populare trasee din Apuseni, chiar dacă nu neapărat unul din cele ușoare. testat cu succes de multe familii cu copiii pentru spectaculozitatea peisajelor este Circuitul Cetăților Ponorului.
Translate to English
long_description:
Traseul începe și se termină în Poiana Glăvoi, motiv pentru care multă lume alege acest loc ca „tabără de bază”. 
Dacă ar fi să asculți descrierile profesioniste, poteca nu e tocmai pentru începători și nici pentru cei cu rău de înălțime: traversează câteva pasaje tehnice - cu asigurări pe lanțuri - și ajunge deasupra câtorva doline („cetățile”) la o înălțime amețitoare.
Traseul coboară mult, pentru început, printr-o pădure de amestec de conifere cu foioase. Rădăcinile copacilor formează pe bucata asta niște trepte care ajută și fascinează totodată.
Se ajunge destul de repede la Dolina 2, deasupra ei. Ultimii 100 de metri sunt critici, cu scări, lanțuri și potecă foarte abruptă. Se poate coborî la dolină sau continua treaseul cu o urcare zdravănă și altă coborâre pe grohotiș.
De aici, urmează o ultimă urcare - poate cea mai grea, lungă și susținută. Odată ce ajungi la „balcoane” - punctele de belvedere -, te pomenești ca pe bulevard, mai ales în sezonul cald. căci toată lumea trage la priveliști. 
De-aici încolo, traseul e ușor, fără alte mari provocări, și te readuce în Glăvoi.

title: On the narrow-gauge railway line in the Runc Valley (Govăjdia) - Tunnel
short_description: This path is part of the narrow-gauge route that once linked all iron exploitations near Hunedoara - the Transylvanian mining railway.  It is perfect for a relaxing historic walk, and leads through the longest tunnel in the area.
long_description:
The trail is signposted at the beginning, then just follow the path. The path starts at the edge of the village of Cățănaș and climbs gently, offering interesting views of the dense forests that gave the area its name - Pădurenilor (Forests) Land.
The railway line reached its heyday around 1900, originally connecting the Retișoara (Ghelari) iron plant with the Govăjdia furnace and later extended to the iron plants in Hunedoara. Trains running on the 16-km long railway transported both for passengers (miners) and ore.
The last transport ran here in 2008, after which the railway and the locomotives were dismantled and sold as scrap. Today, only the wooden sleepers can be seen from the once very important railway track. It is also possible to go through all three tunnels on the route, the longest being an almost 800-meter tunnel at the end of this route. The trail connects the village of Cățănaș with the village of Zlaști.
The path is frequented by both curious hikers as well as cyclists and motorcyclists.

images.caption: Panel at the start of the route

title: Walk to Fontainebleau via Mont Aigu and the Franchard Gorges
short_description: This 10 km route plunges you into the heart of the Fontainebleau forest and its characteristic landscapes made up of woods, rocks and tall pine trees. It allows you to discover the Gorges de Franchard before enjoying a superb view from the Mont Aigu.
long_description:
This loop starts at the Fontainebleau forest initiation centre. After a good kilometre on trail no. 8 (blue), you follow the Rocher du Long Boyau among ferns, Scots pines and other granite chaos.
After a few minutes, you will be able to see the forest from the top.
After the crossroads of the Gorges du Franchard, you walk around a natural area where the Roche qui pleure (weeping rock) and the Sphinx des Druides (Druids' Sphinx), a rock with a strange shape, are located, before following the Mare aux Pigeons.
The hike continues in the direction of the Rochers et Platières des Gorges du Houx, passing the standard Gargantua rock on the path before reaching Mont Aigu by a hilly path. We then take a little height to contemplate the superb panorama of the Fontainebleau forest.
.

title: The Chamarande lookout
short_description: The Domaine départemental de Chamarande is a must-see destination in the département of Essonne. Nearby, the Belvedere forest, although less famous, offers an equally captivating experience.
long_description:
This forest enchants with its rocky ambience, creating a naturally picturesque and diverse landscape. The paths wind through rock formations, immersing visitors in an authentic, unspoilt environment.
One of the highlights of this forest is its belvedere, which offers a spectacular view over the Juine valley. The combination of untouched nature and tranquillity makes this an ideal place for hiking, contemplation and exploration.
The combination of the Domaine départemental de Chamarande and the Belvedere forest creates a complete experience, combining the rich heritage of the estate with the unspoilt natural beauty of the surrounding forest.

title: From Oberstdorf to the Kegelkopf
short_description: The Kegelkopf is a äußerst charming peak that can only be reached üüber unbeschilderte Steige. Surefootedness and a head for heights are essential.
long_description:
We start our tour in an environmentally friendly way at the railway station in Oberstdorf. After crossing to the Nebelhornbahn, we reach the ascent to Gerstruben  via the Rautweg on tar or gravel paths along the Trettach. Above the Raut meadows, the climb to the Kegelkopf begins. The steep path is strenuous and exhausting. After the Gündle, it often runs directly along the edge of the increasingly narrow ridge. Surefootedness and a head for heights are absolutely essential.
At the summit we find what is probably one of the most exposed resting places in the Allgäu Alps. This and the breathtaking panorama invite you to take an extended rest. Those who like the further ridge trail have to make friends with a very steep descent in grassy terrain behind the summit.
But we return to the Rautwiesen on the ascent path. Via Gerstruben and the Hölltobel we descend into the Trettachtal valley. Into Oberstdorf, we choose the variant via the golf course and the Loretto Chapel.
  The trail leads to Oberstdorf.

title: Pushpagiri (Kumar Parvat) Track, Karnataka, India
short_description: Pushpagiri is also known as Kumar Parvat or Subramanya Hills. It is located in Somwarpet taluk of Kodagu district. With a height of 5,617 ft, this mountain is the fourth highest peak in Karnataka.
long_description:
Pushpagiri (Kumara Parvat) is the second highest peak in Kodagu district after Tadiandamol. This peak, the fourth highest in the entire state of Karnataka, is located in the heart of the Pushpagiri Wildlife Sanctuary. At the foothills of Pushpagiri (Kumara Parvat) there is an ancient and famous temple called Kukke Subramanya. This historical temple is very important and popular.
Pushpagiri trek can be completed by two routes.
The eastern route can be accessed from Bidehalli.
The western route can be reached from Kukke Subramanya.
In this article, we have given the details of the western route as it is very beautiful and also a bit challenging. This trek is 22 kms long and is completed in 2 days. Pushpagiri (Kumar Parvat) trek is very much liked by trekkers and hikers because of its natural beauty and geographical diversity. Beginner or experienced, all hikers thoroughly enjoy this track. You too can plan this track soon.

title: Ernen - Hockmatta - Grengiols
short_description: Past the magical forest, over the impressive Binna through the fascinating hamlet of Hockmatta to Grengiols, this beautiful hike leads through the Binntal Landscape Park.

title: Circular hike Ernen - Mühlebach - Trusera - Ernen
short_description: A varied and culturally interesting hike in the Binntal Landscape Park.
long_description: The "Trusera" is the longest water conduit in the Binntal Landscape Park. It brings the glacial water from the Rappetal through the Ernerwald via Wasen to the dry meadows and fields of the Binnachra. In the summer of 2005, the Trusera was repaired after not being in operation for many years. Since 2006, the water has been running again along its entire length.

title: Suonen hike Trusera
short_description: Enjoy a hike in the shady forest, along the Suone Trusera. A Suone is an old water conduit that brings the glacial water from the Rappental through the Ernerwald over the Wasen to the dry meadows and fields of the Binnachra.
long_description: The start of the Suonen hiking trail is in Ernen and runs entirely in the Binntal Landscape Park. The trail leads along the Panorama Trail in the direction of Mühlebach. In addition to the view of the wonderful mountain panorama, you also have a great view of Ernen with the historic St. George's Church and the gallows. A short detour to Mühlebach with the oldest compact wooden village centre in Switzerland is very worthwhile. Shortly before Mühlebach, the steep, short climb to the Trusera begins. Once you reach the Suone Trusera, you walk comfortably along the flowing water (June-October) through the beautiful Ernerwald forest. There are secluded spots where you can have a wonderful rest. There is a bus stop at the hamlet of Wasen, from where you can take the bus back to Ernen or on to Fiesch.

title: Walking around Stuttgart-West
short_description: Take the chance to walk around the Stuttgart Forest, through Castles, Lakes and a lot of Trees!
long_description: An incredible route to walk through the forest through its tall trees, watch the Neuer See, take a break at The Bear Castle (Bärenschlössle) and take pictures at Schloss Solitude, then return to Botnang where you will find supermarkets, pharmacies, playgrounds, Bus and U-Bahn stop.

title: Opp Krokkleiva to the King's lookout point
short_description: A trip from up Krokkleiva to Kleivstua. Then follow a path all the way up to Kongens utsikt. At the top you meet a viewing platform.
long_description:
King Karl Johan visited this place in 1832, hence the name Kongens utsikt. During the tour there are several historical information boards from the time of the overthrow in the 1700s and more. The platform here was built a few years later in timber, but was demolished a few years later to be laid in stone. At the top of the King's View you are met by a fine view over Steinsfjorden, Tyrifjorden and large parts of Hole and Ringerike. The King's View is 484 metres above sea level and is one of Ringerike's most popular viewpoints.
This is a simple, but nice summit tour that suits everyone from families with children to older people and people who want a pleasant walk with a view. The tour is well signposted and marked all the way.

title: The Danube Delta, by bike
short_description: Exploring the Danube Delta by bike is one of those adventures to remember for many years. After this experience, you will know how and to whom to recommend it, because too few people try are willing to try it.
long_description:
Exploring the Danube Delta on a mountain bike, with all your belongings attached to it, means facing the sandy, thistle-filled landscape of the drylands, pedaling under the unrelenting sun rays (God forbid it rains!), sometimes facing strong winds, with few to zero water sources and very few options to buy food from. In short, a logistical and physical challenge altogether.
At the same time, this is your chance to cut through the Letea Forest (and see it differently than most do), stop in the small village of C.A. Rosetii, which seems and even is completely isolated from the rest of the civilized world, and bike from Sulina to Sf. Gheorghe as only the locals do.
The landscape is dominated by sand dunes, clusters of trees, and low vegetation. It is true that you'll only get a few glimpses of the Delta wetland, but you'll fully enjoy both the canals and the sea towards the end of the tour.

images.caption: Sand dunes between Periprava and C.A. Rosetti

title: Genusswanderung entlang der Weinberge bei Schnait (Stuttgart)
short_description:
Diese aussichtsreiche Spazierwanderung führt entlang wundervoller Weinberge bis zum Remstal Kino mit herrlichen Ausblicken. Die Skulpturen entlang der Wege runden diesen wunderschönen und erlebnisrecichen Spaziegang ab.
Translate to English
long_description:
Die Wanderung entlang der Weinberge bei Stuttgart bietet ein unvergessliches Erlebnis, das Natur, Kultur und Genuss harmonisch miteinander verbindet. Startpunkt ist Wanderparkplatz oberhalb der Ortschaft Schnait, bekannt für seine historische Weinbau-Tradition. Von hier aus führt die Route entlang des faszinierenden Weinbau- und Skulpturenwegs „Stein und Wein“, der sowohl Weinliebhaber als auch Kunstinteressierte begeistert. Verschiedene Skulpturen und Kunstwerke regionaler Künstler wurden harmonisch in die Umgebung eingefügt. 
Schon zu Beginn der Wanderung können Sie die Rebstöcke bewundern, die sich über die sanften Hügel erstrecken. Informationstafeln entlang des Weges geben Einblicke in die Geschichte und die Besonderheiten des hiesigen Weinanbaus. Der Weg führt weiter durch den charmanten Weinort Schnait. Hier laden zahlreiche Weingüter und Besenwirtschaften zu einer Rast ein, wo Sie die köstlichen Weine der Region verkosten können.

title: Walking across the Multinskiye Lakes
short_description: Hiking in the Altai, where the lakes are not warmed up to room temperature, is not a hobby for every hiker. The route «Multinskie Lakes» seems to be for those who have decided to divert themselves from the usual.
long_description:
This cascade of high-altitude lakes is remote from civilization, and lovers of outdoor activities will thoroughly enjoy their time here in the Altai Mountains. Multinskiye Lakes – is a chain of lakes echoing each other on the slope of the Katunsky Range. This place will transform all those who like active leisure.
  The Cascade family of Muntinska Lakes consists of the following names:
  Lower Multin Lake
Middle Multin Lake
Upper Multin Lake
Transverse lake
Early transverse lake
Glorious Girl's Lake
Firm Lake
The route also includes such lakes as Kuyguk, Akchan, Alla-Askyr, Kyrgyz and many others
The lake is also included in the map.
  The largest of the lakes is Nizhny Lake that is located at the height of 1700 m. For example, Lake Kuiguk is situated at the height of 2200 meters. The difference between them is 500 metres. What is not a cascade? Interested to see the cascade of wild lakes? Then come to Altai! And it does not matter what kind of activity you prefer, the assortment is vast: amateur hiking, mountaineering, horseback riding tours, bicycle rides, jeep rides and even cross-country trail runs.
The Maltese Lakes region – a symphonic paradise not only for sportsmen, nature lovers, but also for digital technology, which will leave a scenic memory for all to come.

short_description: This is one of the most beautiful hikes to do in the Verdon Regional Nature Park! A loop which is worth the diversions if you are passing through Quinson in the Basses Gorges.
long_description:
This route initially takes a succession of small steps located a few steps from the bridge separating the lake from the Basses Gorges in Quinson.
You quickly arrive at a belvedere which allows you to have a beautiful view of the turquoise waters and the impressive cliffs located on either side of the Verdon. This place is the regular crossing point for electric boats, canoes and pedal boats during the tourist season.
The most beautiful place in the world.
One of the most beautiful hikes to do... as these tasty landscapes accompany you much of the way. Take the time to take pictures, it will make beautiful memories. But be careful, this part of the route is sometimes narrow and slippery... You are following the GR99 here.
At km 4, you will see a number of narrow, slippery passages.
From km 4,5, you go into a luxuriant nature which seems to take over again. You continue your advance for 2 km before reaching the Chapelle Sainte-Maxime. From here, the 360° view is a great reward! We really appreciate the one on the Basses Gorges.
You are not, however, at the highest point (544 m) of this hike, 2 km away. The trail ends with a view of Quinson and the surrounding area.

Turquoise waters of the Basses Gorges
randonnée dans les Alpes: Circuit de randonnée dans les Basses Gorges
Viewpoint on the Basses Gorges while hiking around Quinson

title: Zion canyon overlook trail
short_description: This short walk offers a panoramic view of the valley and the large Zion park.
long_description: A great, interesting and varied hike with magnificent views of the Zion National Park. You will find an exciting path, which runs mainly on red rocks and leads you to a great panoramic view of the valley and the canyon. At the wide viewing platform, you can climb the many red rocks and simply enjoy the unique views of the park within a short walk. This is a great route to watch the sunset at the end of the day, for example. The route is only accessible on foot and is not accessible for wheelchairs or buggies but manageable for children.

title: Trip to Angels Landing
short_description: A slightly challenging hike that leads to a special, narrow and steep view of one of the most scenic valleys in Zion National Park in Utah
long_description:
A one-way hike that starts in the plain but very quickly begins to incline; further down the road, you can continue to the impressive view of the red rock known as Angel’s Landing. The following path is more challenging and dangerous as the trail is relatively narrow and requires rock/climbing, but the road is neat and not scary for those who are not afraid of heights and sure-footed. Because many travelers follow this route, there may be points where you have to wait until people coming from the other side pass by.
The first part of the track can be managed with a buggy but not recommendable, as it gets harder the longer the further the route leads to the summit.

images.caption: The sign marks the start of the route

title: Zion Narrows canyoning route
short_description: The hiking trail known as "the Narrows" is a very special waterway in Zion National Park, which flows directly into a river surrounded by huge red canyon walls.
long_description:
Equipped with special water shoes and hiking poles we rented early in the morning at a sports shop in Springdale village right at the park entrance, we take the shuttle to its last stop (station #9).
From here, the route starts with a leisurely walk along the Virgin River (following the signpost Riverside Walk). A short walk leads us to a point that seems to be the end of the route, but the number of people walking right into the river shows us where exactly the more interesting and challenging part of the route begins.
From here, we just follow the river. The depth of the water varies from season to season and from section to section. Always pay attention to warning signs.
In this one-way route, you can walk for many miles depending on your ability and stamina. Although not a particularly difficult route physically, over time, a long walk in the water, can be tiring (keep in mind: you also need energy for the way back). Also take into account that your feet, despite the special water shoes and socks, are wet throughout the tour and the water can be quite cool also during the summer months. Consider wearing/renting a wetsuit.
You can split the route at the Orderville Canyon or just keep walking along the road up the Virgin River. Getting to the river's origins involves walking for many miles and even going for a swim - just go to a point that is right for you and return the same way.
Along with all the instructions and warnings, this is a wonderful, beautiful and experiential route worth experiencing if the weather conditions allow it.

title: A trip to the Lower Emerald Pool
short_description: A relatively easy and flat hiking trail that leads to the Lower Emerald Pool in Zion National Park in Utah
long_description:
The trail begins at the fifth stop of the Zion National Park Lodge shuttle service and leads along a beautiful nature trail to the Lower Emerald Pool. The pool itself is not very impressive but the road leading there exposed some of the most incredible views. Cross a bridge over a flowing river, walk along red canyon walls, enjoy a panoramic view of one of the most impressive canyons in the park and pass an idyllic waterfall. This is a great hiking route for those who want to enjoy a special view within a relatively short walk.
  As this is a one-way trail, the walking time is only estimated from the starting point to the Emerald Pool.

images.caption: View from the lower end of the bridge leading to the beginning of the route

title: River Side Walk
short_description: An accessible, easy and short footpath along the Virgin River in Zion National Park, Utah. Follow a trail in the middle of outstanding nature with red canyon walls, running water and waterfalls.
long_description:
The hike begins at the last stop of the shuttle of the Temple of Sinawava, which is an impressive gorge running along the Virgin River. On a relaxed walk, we pass running water, small waterfalls and all kinds of animals.
The path is accessible for buggies and wheelchairs.

title: Poço Azul to Encanto Azul Trail
short_description: Trail that connects two of the greatest attractions of the Chapada das Mesas, the Poccedil;o Azul and Encanto Azul, with crystal clear blue pools that enchant all visitors.
long_description:
<The first place to visit is the Poço Azul complex, where besides incredible natural pool of same name, there are other unmissable waterfalls such as Santa Bárbara with its fall over 70 meters and Cachoeira dos Namorados.The entrance costs R$60 per person gives you right use whole structure place, which very well organized cared for. Access via wooden walkways with railings, making trip safer more accessible. Inside complex also a great restaurant for lunch toilets.
Leaving the site you walk six kilometers of dirt road to reach the Po Encanto Azul. There, the springs have created a beautiful natural pool with crystal clear water. The mirror of water becomes even more beautiful when reflecting the rock walls that protect the site. Depending on the weather and brightness on site, the well presents different beauties.

title: On the "Strada delle Abbazie" between Milan and Abbiategrasso
short_description: Tracing the history of the Church and monasteries in the Milan area: this is the "Strada delle Abbazie".
long_description: This tour is the result of an initiative of the Milan Metropolitan Region with the aim of bringing the culture and history of the cities in and around Milan closer to the public. For this purpose, a coherent route was chosen, which culturally interested people can follow on two routes. The highlights of the tour include the monasteries of Morimondo, Viboldone, Mirasole and Chiaravalle. At the same time, the tour offers some scenic highlights, as it passes through the Parco Agricolo Sud Milano and Ticino Valley nature reserves.

title: La côte sauvage du Pouliguen à Batz sur Mer
short_description:
Un bel itinéraire au départ de la Baie de La Baule le long de la Côte Sauvage jusqu'à Batz sur Mer. Le long du parcours il y a de nombreuses criques, plages, et panoramas sur l'océan à découvrir. L'itinéraire est sur celui du GR 34. Il peut se faire au départ du Pouliguen pour profiter de la vue sur la baie de La Baule. Le chemin longe la côte granitique et permets de découvrir de nombreuses criques.
Translate to English
long_description:
Ce parcours nécessite une bonne demi-journée en aller-retour. Très varié, il ravira les amateurs de photo pour la diversité des panoramas maritimes, des ambiances lumineuses et des couleurs en fonction de la météo et des marées. Il offre aussi une belle occasion de varier les activités, entre baignades, découverte de criques, de grottes et escapades dans les rochers.
Le Pouliguen propose de nombreux commerces et possibilités de parking. Batz sur Mer est une jolie petite cité de caractère au patrimoine préservé. Le chemin côtier est bien délimité.
Translate to English

title: Hiking Route on 15. October 2021
short_description: Kleiner Alpsee - Hub - See - Großer Alpsee - Konstanzer Ach - AlpSeeHaus - Naturpark Nagelfluhkette - Bühl a.Alpsee - St. Stephan - Loretokapelle - Freibad Kleiner Alpsee
long_description: Rest Stop Gasthaus zum Alpsee

title: Tumulus tour - Lauterbach
short_description:
A tour that is also suitable for children, but will be at least as exciting for adults.

Note: GPS-guided hiking!
long_description:
We start the hike from Ferienhof Zinn to the main road in the direction of the bridge, cross the country road and follow the ascending path into the field, enjoying the magnificent view. At the edge of the forest we can discover the Rhön, among others. We pass the Maar elevated tank and <brähike around the Hälsberg in a northerly direction. We turn left on next developed forest path and climb (414 m ü. NN). On plateau, there are hills to be
discovered.
The path continues to the former sports field, where rare grasses grow and which is surrounded by numerous juniper bushes. Here you have a magnificent view over a unique landscape. You can see the radio tower on the Hoherodskopf, the golf course near Sickendorf, the many windmills in the Vogelsberg and also the Rhön. A rustic bench invites you to have a picnic.
The trail continues along the elevated tank of Heblos / Rimlos, past the settlers' farm into the village. A great playground awaits children there. The way home leads over a narrow bridge,
vehicles have to drive through the ford. Then it goes to the railway crossing. One call is enough and the barrier is opened. Now Rimlos is in sight.

title: From Fichtenberg to Krichenkirnberg
short_description: Our hike takes us through a quiet valley, lots of forest and idyllic villages.
long_description: We start our tour in the Tälestraße in Fichtenberg. From here we follow it at the fork in the road to the left out of the village, through fields and into the forest. Always along the Tälestraße, we pass the "Hirschklinge" and the Glattenzainbach to Kirchenkirnberg. Here we can take a rest before we leave the village again via Spielhofstraße. We follow the road to Spielhof and enter the forest again after the village. Hornberg is the next small village on our route. After crossing the village, we turn right into the forest and follow the path to Langert. At the beginning of the village, we take the right-hand path "Zum Schützenhaus" and soon enter the forest again. Via Dappachstraße and past the shooting range and the shooting house, we return to our starting point in Fichtenberg.

title: Bad Salzuflen - Herford
short_description: From the spa town of Bad Salzuflen we enjoy an entertaining hike over to Herford.
long_description: In Bad Salzuflen we walk through the old town to the spa gardens. We admire the graduation house in particular. Through the woods we reach the Bismarck Tower near Herford. From there we descend to the foothills of the town. On side roads we reach the old town. On the other side is the railway station.

title: Hike Jungholz - Kühgundspitze
short_description: Scenic summit hike with views of the alpine landscape of the Allgäu and Tyrol.
long_description: Those who want to enjoy peace, quiet, nature and landscape are in good hands on this summit tour. On well-signposted hiking trails, we cross national borders to reach a far-reaching vantage point and at the same time the summit of the Kühgundspitze in the midst of Tyrolean nature. Here, the landscape, culture and tradition of the surrounding villages can be enjoyed.

images.caption: Blick über den Kühgundrücken auf die Kühgundspitze

title: From the castle to the zoo - Heidelberg
short_description: We experience the most beautiful sides of Heidelberg on one tour: the historic old town, the old castle, the green Neckar meadows and the zoo.
long_description:
The Karstorbahnhof is now only served by regional and suburban trains, but a cultural centre has been set up in the reception hall. Parties, concerts, film or slide shows and the like are held here almost every day.
After that, we go into the real old town of Heidelberg, the historic part of the main street, directly behind the Karlstor. Here we find houses built around 1700. A small shepherd's path takes us to the mighty old castle, but its garden is just as interesting. Under a Ginkgo Biloba tree stands the Goethe bench, on which the poet is said to have composed the famous poem by this very tree. Continuing through the woods of the Königstuhl, we reach Neuenheim via Bismarckplatz and the Neckar meadows. Especially in summer, they are a meeting place for countless pupils and students who party, do sports or just lie in the sun here.
Along the Neckar we then come to Neuenheimer Feld and can visit the botanical garden of the university here or see the bears, monkeys or an aviary for sea birds in the zoo.

title: Laranjeiras to Praia do Sono Trail
short_description: Trail in the middle of the Atlantic Forest, having as destination the beautiful Praia do Sono, one of the major attractions of the region that attracts many adventurers and visitors all year round.
long_description:
The trail to Praia do Sono begins at the Laranjeiras condominium, in Vila Oratório. Right at the beginning of the trail and already amid the exuberance of the Atlantic Forest, you can find a stall of the team working in the Cairuçu Environmental Protection Area, where you can receive information on the trail and accommodation on the beach.
The trail has a level of difficulty easy, having on much of the way steps on the ground and handrails to assist mainly on descents. After a small waterfall, which marks the halfway point, the path becomes more closed and dense forest, where you can contemplate the beauty of the forest on this stretch. In the rainy season the path is slippery and with a lot of mud, so it is worth to be informed about the state of the trail and be with ideal clothes for hiking, such as a good hiking boot and shoes. At the end there is a viewpoint with a beautiful view of the beach and then after a staircase, you reach the beach.
