title: Tour to the Mosenberg near Homberg (Efze)
short_description: Jogging tour through the Homberg highlands over the Mosenberg mountain
long_description: A varied jogging tour in the municipal area of Homberg (Efze), mainly on field and gravel paths. The highlight and also the highest point of the tour is reached on the Mosenberg, where there is an airfield.

images.caption: Ausblick auf Homberg (Efze) vom Startpunkt in der Panoramastraße

title: Trip to Lake Freiberg (Freiberg-See)
short_description: A relatively easy route that goes up through a wooded mountain towards the magical Freiberg-See located in the heart of the mountain.
long_description: A relatively easy and short uphill walking trail that goes up through a wooded mountain and ends at the magical Freiberg lake. Near the lake there is an organized bathing beach as well as a cafe/restaurant.

title: Meshimoriyama
short_description:
Wanderung vom höchsten Bahnhof Japans auf dem Mt Meshimori, welcher eine fantastische Rundumsicht, bis zum Mt Fuji ermöglicht.
Translate to English
long_description:
Die Tour startet am höchstgelegenen Bahnhof Japans und führt die ersten Kilometer durch den Ort.  Die weitere Tour verläuft über gut ausgeschilderte Wanderwege bis zum höchsten Punkt dem Mt Mesimori, von wo aus man ein herrliches Gipfelpanorama genießen kann.
Translate to English

title: A visit to the hospitable Kuskovo estate
short_description: A short walk around Kuskovo Manor will introduce you to the history of past centuries. The manor house captures the historical spirit of the time very beautifully.
long_description:
A romantic place and very close to Moscow – Kuskovo Manor. The manor's gardens are so magnificent that at one time it was called the Versailles of the Moscow suburbs. <For over 300 years the mansion has belonged to family of Sheremetev family. But after events 1917, estate was renamed a museum.
Popular buildings of the manor — they are Grotto, Dutch House, Italian House, Hermitage, and many others.
The main buildings of the manor are the Grotto and the Dutch House.
All attractions warmly welcome their visitors and as they say in the museum – «offline» and «online».

images.caption: Вид с пруда на Усадьба Кусково
Вид с пруда на Усадьба Кусково

title: An experiential route for children in the Werdensteiner Moos reserve
short_description: A circular, light and experiential hiking route for families next to water marshes in the Werdensteiner Moos reserve. Activities for children are offered along the route as well as a short sensory route.
long_description: An easy circular and wide track on a plain that passes water swamps inside a nature reserve. During the route there are activities for children, observation points and a short sensory route. In the reserve you can observe several species of animals, among them many frogs that jump in the swamps.

title: Lempeș Hill - easy trek near Brașov on an autumn day
short_description: Lempeș Hill is a good alternative for tourists looking for outdoor activities around Brașov. Located near the city, Lempeș Hill is perfect for picnics, hiking, trail running, MTB tours, or photo sessions.
long_description:
Although the paths on Lempeș Hill are preferred by locals rather than tourists, they never disappoint a trekker eager to unwind a little. Following the paths quite clearly outlined, even if they are not marked, you can make a long circuit through the deep, quiet forest.
Due to the alternation of deciduous and coniferous trees, the forest acquires a beautiful color in the autumn months. From place to place, clusters of flowers can be seen and photographed.
The highest point on the route is Dealul Cetății - Fortress Hill (704m) where you can see traces of a former fortress in the area.
This proposed route can be shortened, cutting through the forest just near the fortress, following alternative paths that lead to the main ones.

title: Ciucaș - Tigers' Saddle, from Babarunca (circuit)
short_description: The hiking trails that start from Babarunca are less frequented and wilder. However, they are a good option to see another side of Ciucas Mountain.
long_description:
This circuit route can be done in any direction. But if you start the other way around, the beginning will be very steep and desolate, due to logging.
The ascent through Babarunca Gorges is easy. After the first half, the landscape becomes very wild, and the invading burdock plants make room for the juniper towards the end.
The descent is almost entirely through the forest, with some wide meadows that should show beautiful views over the Ciucaș craggy edges. In foggy weather, orientation could be a problem.

images.caption: Wide forest road in the Babarunca Gorges
Very wild landscape as we tried to reach Saua Tigailor

title: Salt nature trail, Sovata
short_description: The Salt nature trail - one of the educational trails in Sovata - aims to educate children or grown-ups trekking around the resort about the main natural resource in Sovata - salt.
long_description:
The route runs near the Bear Lake and reaches some interesting sights in the resort, such as an observatory, or the Snake Lake, little known by tourists.
Although apparently short, the route can be extended depending on the stops, the deviations (because there are other secondary paths separating from the main one), and the pace. The route is easy, ideal for children who will surely find quite interesting the nature, the bridges, the wooden paths, and the short explanatory texts. Note the sinkholes created in the salt mountain and the wildness of nature in some areas.
The route can be combined with the other didactic hike in the area - the Bear Lake trail.

images.caption: Small bridges and wooden pathway on the trail

title: Ås til Åsleden - Åstorp to Hålebäck
short_description: The first stage of the s til Åsledens goes from Åstorp to Hålebeck.
long_description: We hike along easily accessible hiking trails on the northern shore of the Söderåsen mountain range. Our path leads through dense, almost jungle-like deciduous forest and past the idyllic Maglaby Kärr moor lake and a huge stone wall, behind which is a grazing area for deer. The picturesque park of the small castle Vrams Gunnarstorp invites you to visit. We also pass early burial grounds and cairns that were piled up when the land was converted into farmland.

title: Hiking at Mount Baïgura
short_description: A very nice hike in the heart of the Basque Country, to climb Mount Baïgura and enjoy a beautiful view of the Pyrenees.
long_description:
You'll be walking through grassy areas, rocky areas and beautiful beech forests and will come across many pottoks and vultures.
The outward journey is the most difficult section with a steep climb, but we recommend you do the hike in this direction, as the descent can be difficult otherwise.

title: Winter trail, Baiului Mountains (Sinaia Circuit)
short_description: A day tour, with the classic climb up through the Câinelui Pass and down an unmarked trail to the Sinaia halt. It can be an interesting alternative to the classic trails going to Baiul Mare. Slight orientation problems when guessing the unmarked trail; the snow was OK.
long_description:
The climb up the Câinelui Peak is one of the most preferred ways to reach the crest of the Bai Bai Mountains. Depending on the time of winter, the snow may be a little heavier on the way out of the forest towards the alpine hollow; it is equally possible that, towards the ridge, the snow is more likely to be blown away by the wind, given the total exposure of the ridge.
A stop on the ridge at the trail junction is welcome for a sip of tea and possibly a snack.
The route continues to the Mierlele ridge, following the very wide off-road trail characteristic of the Bai mountains. Even though there are no markers here, orientation is not a problem.
On the other hand, a bit of attention is needed to find the exact spot where you have to turn left in order to start descending the unmarked trail.
Drop down through a saddle where the snow cover becomes quite deep again; you should be able to see the traces of a station close by. You can make a stop (with a small detour) on the Gagu Mare pass (1578m).
In the forest, just follow the trail.
It would help to have the route on a GPS device to make sure it's the right path.
The descent is a reasonable one, with one very steep section; if there's no ice, you should have no problems.

images.caption: Urcarea prin pădure spre Piscu Câinelui
Traseul vizibil în golul alpin, Munții Baiului

title: The Millstone Path
short_description: A pleasant hike to discover the old millstone factories in the heart of the red rocks and magnificent views!

title: Hike to the Purification Waterfall in the Vale do Capão - Chapada Diamantina
short_description: Easy and beautiful trail, suitable for those who are in the Vila do Capá do Capá o and wish to contemplate the beautiful nature of the region and dive into the waters of the coldest waterfall of the Chapada Diamantina.
long_description: The trail to the Purification Waterfall begins only 6 kilometers from the Central Square of Caetéé-Açu. When you arrive in Bomba village, you will see some restaurants and car parks near the trail entrance. You will also have a beautiful view of Morro Branco. It?s about 4,5 kilometers (total) on a path along the banks of the river that forms the waterfall, considered the coldest in the Chapada Diamantina. After enjoying the waterfall, return by the same path and stop for a swim in Poço Angélica.

title: Wumblsalmen
short_description: Discover Ratschings: Hike to the Wumblsalmen.
long_description: Rough, untouched landscapes, ancient, shingle-covered alpine huts and a far-reaching view all the way to the glaciated peaks of the Zillertal Alps: the hike from Ratschings to the Inner and Outer Wumblsalm is a particularly pristine experience.

title: Around the Mafate Valley (GR R3) - Stage 1
short_description: Stage 1: From the car park at Col de Boeufs to Aurère
long_description:
The first stage of the five-stage Mafate circumnavigation leads from the Col de Bœufs pass to the small settlement of Aurère in the north of the valley basin. The route is mainly downhill on a beautiful hiking trail, the Sentier Scout. The path is partly secured with a steel rope.
Every time we step out of the dense forest, impressive views of the northern basin and the pointed summit of Piton Cabris open up during the stage.
At the end of the stage we come to the oldest settlement in Mafate, Aurère. Once founded by an escaped slave, the village is now home to less than a hundred people. There are several small gîtes, which offer simple but cosy öts for hikers to stay overnight.

title: Gaustatoppen
short_description: Southern Norway’s tallest peak
long_description:
The majestic Gaustatoppen is considered one of Norway's most beautiful mountains. Telemark's highest peak can be found in the serene Tinn municipality. Many believe that the top of Gaustatoppen provides the best view Norway has to offer. In fact, on a clear day you are gazing out onto one-sixth of Norway’s landscape. You can see the mountain peaks and forest of Telemark, Oslo, and Buskerud municipalities as well as large parts of the Hardangervidda National Park. Talk about an absolutely stunning sight!
There are nice spots to pitch your tent along the Heddarsvatn Lake. The closest campsite is Bøen Camping, which is a 15-minute drive away to Tuddal.

title: Stoltzekleiven
short_description: Get you heart pumping
long_description: Stoltzekleiven is definitely going to get your heart pumping with its almost 800 steps up to Sandviksfjellet. As one of the most popular trails in Bergen you will not be alone and the trail is one-way only.

title: From Mt. Rokko to Arima Hot Spring
short_description: Introduction of mountain trails that are loved by many people in Kobe
long_description:
The night scenery of Kobe, Hyogo Prefecture is known for being one of Japan’s three most famous night views. From Mount Rokko, you can see a panoramic view of nighttime Kobe. Mount Rokko is renowned as a tourist attraction and for having scenic roads, but it is also a fantastic mountain to climb. The mountain, which is easily accessible not only from Kobe but also from the Kansai area, is a good choice for beginning climbers.
I visited Kobe on a solo trip when I was a student. I remember noticing the big mountains of Rokko while I was on the train and looking at them from the window gripping the Seishun 18 Ticket in my hand. I’m now taking the Hankyu Railway again. It’s just like that time when I traveled across Japan by train because I wanted to see different places.

title: Rundemanen
short_description: Hike one of Bergen's famous seven mountains
long_description: Rundemanen is one of the most famous peaks around Bergen. The peak is part of what is called the Seven Mountains around Bergen. It is easy to access this peak from the top of Fløyen.

title: Knutshøe
short_description: Enjoy Besseggen’s younger sibling with a spectacular view of the delta Øvre Leirungen and Gjende river
long_description:
Knutshøe, towering 1,517 meters above sea level, is known to many as Besseggen’s tough younger sibling. The trip gives you breathtaking views of the green Gjende river. You’ll even pass a sandy beach and be able to see the masses of hikers scrambling across the Besseggen Ridge. At the top, you get beautiful views of Besseggen, Besshø, Gjendevann, Bukkehåmaren, and Surtningssue.
The hike is quite challenging and you’ll need to scramble through some parts of the hike, so we don’t suggest to hike it if you’re afraid of heights. It’s very important that you only hike in good weather. The trail is not marked, yet it’s relatively easy to follow the path. Avoid veering too far left at exposed places, it is steep and there is a danger of "getting stuck" at a dead end. So, we recommend you do not go alone.
Please note this trip is very demanding for dogs. Dogs who have been on challenging trips, and have experience climbing through loose rock will be better prepared. You will need to assist your dog multiple times throughout the hike, no matter the dog’s size.
Gjendesheim Tourist Lodge is very popular place to stay before and after hiking Besseggen, and it’s conveniently located close to Knutshø. The Gjendesheim bus stop is located very close by and it has plenty of parking available.
Hindsæter Hotel is a small cozy hotel known for their great food. Located only 10 minutes by car north towards Vågå.
The right to roam enables you to camp anywhere for free as long as you follow some basic guidelines.
With the Right to Roam, you are able to camp anywhere for free as long as you follow the guidelines.

title: Băile Felix educational trail
short_description: The Băile Felix educational route offers visitors an interactive journey into the forest world, with an emphasis on the Băile Felix Forest and its importance in the wider context of environmental protection.
long_description:
The route includes 10 information points, consisting exclusively of QR codes. So trekkers must have a mobile phone and internet access. Along the way, you learn about trees and forests in general and their role, as well as about the flora of the forest. You might also see deer along the route!
Although access to Baile Felix Forest was possible before on delimited paths, this route certainly makes the walks much more interesting.
This route also adds to all the recreational activities available in Băile Felix resort.

title: Dolomites high trail 10
short_description: The Dolomites High Altitude Trail no. 10 starts in Bolzano and ends on the shores of Lake Garda, in Gardone Riviera. The route leads through mountainous areas to the west of the Adige Valley.

images.caption: In der Großen Scharte unterhalb des Gantkofel Gipfels
Passo Grostè - Rif. Graffer - sentiero della Corna Rossa – Vallesinella

title: Beach walk at Stakendorf beach
short_description: Charming contrasts await us on this hike: wide views of the Baltic Sea, flora and fauna rich in species in the Schmoel nature reserve as well as a time-honoured manor house can be experienced along the 14 km long route.

title: Husfjellet
short_description: Discover possibly Senja’s most rewarding hike
long_description:
Husfjellet is possibly Senja’s most rewarding hike. The hike is moderate, with a gradual uphill climb, but the views are simply stunning.
A trip to Husfjellet is a great alternative to Segla if you want to avoid a steep and crowded trail but still want some of the classic Senja views. The only exposure is towards the top and it’s possible to keep a good distance from the edges.
Hamn i Senja and Mefjord Brygge both offer hotel rooms as well as apartments with self-catering possibilities. Each has a restaurant serving breakfast, lunch, and dinner, and a bar.

images.caption: View to the south along the trail.
View to the south towards Finnsæter.
View along the mountain range from the top of Husfjell.

title: Bruviknipa
short_description: Visit one of the Bergen region’s finest mountains
long_description:
Bruviknipa is by many considered the finest mountain in the entire area around Bergen.
The peak which is often called Brøknipa is located on the south-east side of the Osterøy Island, north of Bergen.

title: La Vallée de Saint-Pons à pied (Gémenos)
short_description:
Une promenade facile permettant de découvrir le Parc de la Vallée de Saint-Pons avec la chapelle Saint-Martin, l'abbaye Saint-Pons et d'anciens moulins.
Translate to English
long_description:
Accessible à tous, ce parcours de randonnée est très ombragé et bien "damé". On découvre en chemin l’usine du Paradou (17ème siècle) qui témoigne de l'activité de production de papier à cigarettes, abandonnée au 20ème siècle.
L'ensemble moulinier est complété par le Foulon et le moulin de la Cascade le long du Fauge, affluent de l'Huveaune.
À mi-parcours, l'abbaye de Saint-Pons du 13ème siècle se dévoile sous vos yeux.
Translate to English

title: The customs officers' path - Ajaccio
short_description: This coastal path allows you to link the Sanguinaires site to the beach of Saint-Antoine further north.
long_description:
In the middle of the maquis, you will walk along a steep and wild coastline.
This hike is very easy to do.
This hike does not involve any technical or physical difficulty except for a little endurance especially for children. The path is flat with very little gradient. It takes a little more than 2 hours to complete the round trip.
The trail is flat with very little elevation change.
On this coastal path that cuts through the maquis, the fauna and flora are in a wild state. The maquis is mainly composed of cistus of Montpellier, but also of heather or hairy calico. More surprising before arriving at Capo di Feno, the presence of some olive trees topped by the winds.

images.caption: randonnée autour d'Ajaccio: Sentier Des Douaniers

title: Heilhornet
short_description: Hike to the top of Southern Helgeland’s highest mountain
long_description:
Reaching 1,058 meters above sea level, Heilhornet Mountain is a great adventure for experienced hikers. Having balanced your way up the ridge, you’re awarded a view over the surrounding mountains and the many arms of fjords that zig-zag the area.
For centuries, Heilhornet has been an important seamark. Coming in from the shipping lane in the west, it looks like a sharp-edged cone or a horn. The name probably derives from the old Norse word “heill,” meaning luck or good omen and can be tied to the mountain’s significance as a seamark.
This trail is demanding for children. Bring your dog only if it’s an experienced climber. Towards the peak, there are some steep and exposed sections, which can be challenging for people with a fear of heights.
The final part of the trail can be covered in snow even in summer. Watch your step in these parts since you can easily step through the snow and lose your footing. This means that you may have to take little detours, but be sure to keep as close to the trail and markings as possible.
Bogen Feriehus is a 15-minute drive away from the Hornelva river rest stop. They offer cabin rental and apartment accommodation.

title: Vidden
short_description: Hike along the plateau between Bergen’s famous mountains, Ulriken and Fløyen
long_description:
Tackle two of Bergen's most known mountains in one adventure with the hike along the famous trail, "Vidden". This hike takes you across the plateau providing incredible views of the surrounding mountain tops and the beautiful city of Bergen below. 
Start the trail from either Fløyen or Ulriken and trek the nearly 13 kilometers to the other end. Vidden is a "must" during your stay in Bergen.

title: Hike Jungholz - Schnitzlertal Alpe in Wertach and back via Unterjoch
short_description: Hike in the foothills of the Alps with great prospects on interesting, easy-to-navigate paths with places to stop for refreshments on several Alps.
long_description: There are magnificent views on the circular trail - and yet the tour is suitable for everyone, because the lush green meadows and pastures over which our path leads are mostly only moderately steep. The start of our tour is in Jungholz and we arrive at our first destination, the Schnitzlertal Alpe, in about 2.5 hours. In several rustic alps along the way, such as the Vordere Sorg Alpe or the Buchel Hütte, we can stop for refreshments at any time. A spectacular panoramic view of the Allgäu Alpine landscape awaits us at several waypoints on the tour. On the way back, we pass through the small community of Unterjoch. There we can still enjoy rustic and genuine Allgäu culture. The finish point after a good 5-hour tour is again the Jungholz car parking lot in the village centre.

title: From Lago del Narét over the Passo Cristallina
short_description: Following in the footsteps of the Römer, we hike on this scenically rewarding high mountain tour über Pässe and along crystal-clear mountain lakes around the almost 3000 m high Cristallina peak.
long_description: On this tour around the Cristallina peak, we cross three peaks and visit numerous crystal-clear mountain lakes in which the magnificent high-mountain landscape is reflected. New perspectives of the surrounding mountains and the high alpine scenery make this round tour particularly attractive. If you want to stop for a bite to eat along the way, you can pay a visit to the Capanna Cristallina, which is architecturally quite idiosyncratic.

title: Brushytten
short_description: Easy walk from Fløyen
long_description: Brushytten(the soda drink cabin) is a cafe up on the mountains behind Fløyen in Bergen. It is open every Sunday and public holidays from 1100 to 1600. The cafe serves hot dogs, waffles, hot drinks and of course brus (soda).

title: Gullfjelltoppen
short_description: Hike to the highest peak in the Bergen region
long_description:
Gullfjelltoppen is Bergen's highest peak at 987 meters above sea level. The peak is a part of the wider Gullfjellet area, an area that is very rugged with lots of cliffs and small lakes and ponds. 
From Gullfjelltoppen you will on days with good weather see the ocean to the west and the Folgefonna glacier in the east. Note that weather up here can be noticeably worse than in Bergen,  so make sure you check the weather forecast before you go.

title: Løvstakken
short_description: Hike one of Bergen’s famous seven mountains
long_description: Løvstakken is one of the most famous peaks around Bergen as one of the Seven Mountains. From the top are views of the city center and surrounding mountains including Ulriken and Fløyen.

images.caption: Løvestakken peak right next to the city center

title: Lyderhorn
short_description: Hike one of Bergen's famous seven mountains
long_description: Lyderhorn is one of the most famous peaks around Bergen. The peak is part of what is called the Seven Mountains around Bergen. From the top you will have magnificent views of the ocean and other seven mountains like Løvstakken.

title: एलीफैंट फॉल्स साइकिल दौरा
short_description: मेघालय राज्य की खूबसूरत राजधानी शिलांग में बहुत से आकर्षक स्थानों तक स ाइकिल दौरों के अवसर हैं जैसे की एलीफैंट फ ॉल्स जो शिलांग से करीब 12 किलोमीटर दूर स्थित एक 3 स्तरीय झरना है।
long_description:
यह साइकिल दौरा शिलांग शहर के प्रसिद्ध चर्च 'कैथेड्रल ऑफ़ मैरी' से शुरू होकर एलीफेंट फॉल्स तक जाता है। झरना फर्न से ढकी चट्टानों से तीन स्तर में नीचे गिरता है। पहला स्तर आम तौर पर घने पेड़ों के कारण छिपा रहता है जिसके वजह से यह झरना दो स्तरीय झरने जैसा दिखता है। एलीफैंट फॉल्स झरना शिलांग शहर से लगभग 12 किलोमीटर दूर है और राष्ट्रीय राजमार्ग 106 से थोड़ी दूरी पर स्थित है। शिलांग पीक के पास एक छोटा सा साइनबोर्ड है जो झरने की तरफ जाने वाली सड़क को चिन्हित करता है। यह छोटी सड़क एक पार्किंग में समाप्त होती है जहाँ से झरने में उतरने के लिए सीमेंट की सीढ़ियों बानी हुई हैं। झरने के प्रत्येक स्तर पर आराम करने के लिए बेंच बनी हुई हैं। झरने के आखिरी तीसरा स्तर बहुत सुन्दर है जहाँ पर गिरते हुए ठंडे पानी से एक छोटा तालाब भी बना हुआ है। 
एलीफैंट फॉल्स में प्रवेश के लिए 20 रूपया प्रति व्यक्ति का टिकट लगता है। डिजिटल कैमरा ले जाने पर 25 रुपये का कैमरा शुल्क भी लिया जाता है।

images.caption: शिलांग के पास त्रि-स्तरीय (3-टियर ) एलीफैंट फॉल्स झरना, मेघालय, भारत।
शिलांग का कैथेड्रल ऑफ़ मैरी चर्च इस साइकिल दौरे का आरम्भ बिंदु है, मेघालय, भारत।
शिलांग के एलीफेंट फॉल्स के पास एक ऑफ रोड साइकिलिंग हिस्सा मेघालय, भारत।
शिलांग के एलीफैंट फॉल्स झरने के नाम की असली कहानी, मेघालय भारत।
इंटरेक्टिव 3D उड़ान : एलीफैंट फाल्स साइकिल दौरा

title: Nortinden
short_description: Hike to Kvaløya's northern panoramic peak
long_description:
A hike to the top of Nordtinden, the largest peak on the northern part of the island Kvaløya, covers a variety of terrain and rewards hikers with fantastic panoramic views of the surrounding Norwegian sea, Arctic islands, and impressive mountain tops.
Nordtinden is located just 25 km northeast from downtown Tromsø, on the island of Kvaløya. The first 3 km of the hike will follow a well-maintained dirt road with a gradual incline and the second half will be a rocky, free-climbing hike with a more demanding incline following Nordtinden’s ridgeline. The best time of year for hiking in the Tromsø area is between May and September. The average summer temperatures range from 10-15 C with the lowest amounts of rainfall, less than 10 cm of precipitation per month, in comparison to the rest of the year.
Kvaløya, “whale island”, is located within the arctic circle and is the 5th largest island off of Norway’s mainland. This island boasts several fjords and 10 peaks higher than 700 moh, 3 of which are over 1,000 moh. 
Tromsø and Kvaløya both provide a variety of nice hotels and Airbnbs. If you are looking for a special Norwegian summer accommodation, we recommend checking out Sommerøy Arctic Hotel, although this is located about an hour drive from Nordtinden.

title: Segla
short_description: Tackle Senja’s most famous mountain
long_description:
Segla is Senja’s most popular hike. A steep trail leads up the southern side of the mountain to the peak 639 meters above the ocean below. At the top, there are wonderful views of Mefjord and the surrounding mountains. The sheer western cliff will give an adrenaline kick to anyone game enough to peer over the edge.
The trail is steep but does not have a lot of exposure, just stay to the right as your climb up the mountain. Be aware of rocks loosened by other hikers above you. The top can feel a bit scary if you have a fear of heights, particularly when it’s crowded. Try an evening hike to watch the sunset and you might even get the peak to yourself, for a little while at least.
Due to Segla’s popularity the trail has become very worn. While the view is very nice, the hike itself is not that exciting and the peak can be busy. For an alternative trail that still has amazing (and arguably better) views, consider some of the nearby trails which are popular with locals, such as Barden and Keipen.
Avoid this hike in wet and windy weather as it could be quite dangerous and frankly, not much fun. Hiking boots or shoes with good grip are highly recommended.
Important: If you want the classic picture of Segla, you need to hike up the neighboring mountain called Hesten.
Hamn i Senja and Mefjord Brygge both offer hotel rooms as well as apartments with self-catering possibilities. Each has a restaurant serving breakfast, lunch, and dinner, and a bar.

images.caption: Blick auf den Segla auf der Insel Senja

title: Agva Kilimli Hiking Trail
short_description: When it comes to Istanbul nature trail, it is a trail that should definitely be added to the list, where you can walk with breathtaking views.
long_description:
Istanbul and its neighbourhood, Ağva Kilimli Yürüyüyüyüş Parkour is definitely included in the list of places to do nature walks. After setting off from Istanbul and arriving in Ağva, we find ourselves on this track in a magnificent nature where blue and green meet.
We start this approximately 4.5 km long walking track from Kilimli Restaurant, follow the track and finish our route at Kilimli Restaurant, which is also our starting point. The track takes approximately 1 hour, not counting the rest or photo planting periods. We first walk the part of the track located on the seaside side. As we continue on the track, we proceed like a ring until our target point. The route is a medium difficulty route with ups and downs and rocks. There are places that should not be entered or travelled, let's be careful in this regard.
The route offers such beautiful views that it fills us with peace. This route, which is ideal for those who want to do sports accompanied by the scenery, is ideal for everyone who wants to do sports accompanied by the scenery. If you are looking for places to do yürüyüş in Istanbul, you can set off on this route with your friends.

title: Brosmortinden
short_description: An easy and rewarding hike
long_description:
Brosmortinden, the mountain located on the northeastern side of Kvaløya, is an easy and rewarding hike for outdoorsmen and women of all ages. 
Tromsø and Kvaløya both provide a variety of available hotels and airbnb’s. If you are looking for a special Norwegian summer accommodation we recommend checking out Sommerøy Arctic Hotel, located on the western coast of Kvaløya.

title: The coastal path between Bandol and Saint-Cyr-sur-Mer
short_description: A beautiful 12 km itinerary to follow the customs path on its most western part, passing through magnificent coves.
long_description: This section of the coastal path offers beautiful views and opportunities for swimming. After a few kilometres from Bandol, you can see the Rousse island in the distance before heading towards the Port d'Alon cove and the Pointe du Dufens. The route ends at the Pointe Fauconniere and the Pointe du Grenier before reaching Saint-Cyr-sur-Mer. A succession of ascents and descents punctuate the route but the setting is motivating!

images.caption: On the coastal path between Bandol and Saint-Cyr-sur-Mer
On the coastal path between Bandol and Saint-Cyr-sur-Mer

title: Apremont Gorge and Caverne des Brigands from Barbizon
short_description: A beautiful, family-friendly, signposted walking loop that takes in the Apremont Gorges and the Caverne des Brigands.
long_description:
From Barbizon, you start to walk through the forest along the Denecourt path (no. 6) and climb the first rock piles. You then pass the Rocher de l'Elephant before coming across the Grotte des Barbizonni. At km 2.2, you will not miss the superb view of the Apremont Gorges. Turn left at km 3.5 following the path 6-6 for about 500 m.
The second part of the trail is called the "Grotte de Barbizonni". <The second part of the route takes you to famous Caverne des Brigands. According legend, this work Claude-François Denecourt would have been used by brigands share their booty after having robbed honest people.<The circuit ends by going along the Allée des Vaches to reach car park.

images.caption: Stone chaos in the Apremont Gorge

title: दिलववाड़ा जैन मंदिर ट्रैक
short_description: यह ट्रैक माउंट आबू बस स्टेशन से शुरू होकर दिलवाड़ा जैन मंदिर समूह तक जाने वाला एक शहरी द ौरा है।
long_description:
दिलवाड़ा मंदिर समूह राजस्थान के सिरोही जिले के माउंट आबू हिल स्टेशन पांच श्वेतांबर जैन मंदिरों का एक समूह है। ये मंदिर 11वीं और 16वीं शताब्दी के बीच चालुक्य स्थापत्य शैली में बने हैं। सफेद संगमरमर और शानदार नक्काशी के लिए प्रसिद्ध ये मंदिर जैनों का एक मुख्य तीर्थ स्थान हैं। इसके अलावा माउंट आबू आने वाले बाकी पर्यटक भी बड़े शौक से इन्हें देखने आते हैं। वैसे तो राजस्थान में बहुत सी दूसरी जगहों में भी कई जैन मंदिरों हैं, लेकिन दिलवाड़ा मंदिरों को सुन्दर और शानदार माना जाता हैं
दिलवाड़ा मंदिरो का यह ट्रैक सुविधा के लिये माउंट आबू बस डिपो से शुरू किया जा सकता है। बस डिपो के पास बहुत सारे अच्छे होटल हैं और ज्यादातर टूरिस्ट इन्ही होटलों में रुकते हैं तो यहाँ से ट्रैक शुरू करना आसान रहता है। इस ट्रैक की एकतरफा लंबाई लगभग 3.5 किलोमीटर है और आना-जाना मिलाकर पूरा दौरा 7 किलोमीटर लम्बा हो जाता है। यह पदयात्रा मार्ग असल में एक बढ़िया डामर वाली पक्की सड़क है जो दो और चार पहिया वाहनों के लिए भी खुली है और इसका कुछ हिस्सा बाजार क्षेत्र से भी गुजरता है। इसलिए इस ट्रैक को एक शहरी दौरे के तौर पर भी देखा जा सकता है। पूरे पदयात्रा मार्ग में हलके उतार-चढाव हैं। यह सभी स्तरों और उम्र के पैदल यात्रियों और तीर्थयात्रियों के लिए उपयुक्त है और 2 घंटे में आसानी से पूरा किया जा सकता है।

images.caption: सिरोही जिले के माउंट आबू हिल स्टेशन में दिलवाड़ा जैन मंदिर, राजस्थान, भारत।
राजस्थान में पदयात्रा मार्ग: दिलवाड़ा जैन मंदिर ट्रैक

title: Briksdal Glacier
short_description: Discover breathtaking scenery deep inside the Briksdal valley
long_description:
The Briksdal glacier is an arm of the 486 square kilometer Jostedal glacier, Europe’s largest. The glacier is situated at the end of one of Norway’s most beautiful valleys, surrounded by tall mountains and impressive waterfalls. At the foot of the glacier lies a small turquoise lake, which feeds the river rushing alongside the path to the glacier.
Even the bus journey up the valley is spectacular. From the fjord village of Olden, the road travels around 20 kilometers up towards the glacier, passing along the shore of Oldevatnet lake. Camping grounds and small farms line the lush Oldedalen valley floor.
Once you step off the bus at the mountain lodge the majesty of the location begins to sink in. The towering Volefossen waterfall with its 300 meter free fall would be the highlight on many other journeys.
While it is possible to buy passage on small vehicles named “Troll cars” it is recommend to walk so you can stop and take photos as you wish and enjoy the scenery. Walking the trail is arguably as beautiful as the glacier and lake itself.
A key highlight on the way to the glacier is crossing the bridge in front of Kleivafossen waterfall. When the waterfall swells from the glacial melt further upstream it offers a powerful experience as you feel the raw energy of the water pounding down on the rocks before you. Standing on the bridge with the glacial spray hitting your face will literally take your breath away.

images.caption: The glacier and lake at the top of the trail.

title: Segestad Mountain Farm
short_description: Take in lake and mountain views after a short, steep hike near Hjelle
long_description: The Segestad Mountain Farm has an idyllic location overlooking Oppstrynsvatnet Lake. A short, steep hike brings you to the farm, perched on a clearing at the mouth of the Glomsdalen Valley, 300 meters above the lake. The views of the lake and surrounding mountains from this peaceful viewpoint simply stunning. Pack a picnic to enjoy at the farm while you soak in the landscape.

title: Lembert Dome
short_description: An easy dome hike for the entire family
long_description:
This dome is surely worth your visit. The hike up to Lembert Dome is maybe not the most interesting the first kilometers, but it gets more and more interesting the closer you get to the dome.
The dome is pretty grand and if you are scared of heights you will maybe choose not to hike all the way to the top. But just getting up to the dome will give you a great feeling and amazing views of Yosemite National Park and Tuolumne Meadows.

title: मैक्लॉडगंज शहर से डल झील की हाइकिंग
short_description:
नेचर ट्रेल से होने वाली एक हाइक, जो मैक्लॉडगंज से करीब दो किलोमीटर दूर स्थित सुन्दर डल  झील और उसके किनारे बने मदिरों तक जाती है।

title: Trekking to Charyn Canyon
short_description: Charyn Canyon – the most popular route in the Almaty region of south-eastern Kazakhstan. The Tien Shan mountain branches of the canyon are excellent competitors to the Grand Canyon in the USA.
long_description: Charyn Canyon – a place favoured by tourists and although it is located 200 km from Almaty, it is the starting point of hiking for many connoisseurs of natural beauty. Sandy cliffs, formed as a result of shallowing of the Great Lake 12 million years ago along the river Charyn – are fond of the Kazakh people. The most popular place of the canyon is the Castle Valley, which is about 2 km long. Charyn canyon itself, or as it is also called «Little Brother Grad Canal» stretches for 154km, and its height reaches 300m. The shifting locations of the canyon and the shapes of its cliffs – are more impressive than any feature film. And the long-standing narrative secrets with which the canyon is covered occupy all attentive listeners on guided tours. <In 2004 Charyn Canyon became a part of the National Park, and now it is under close supervision state. On territory park «Eco Park» with places for delicious stops accommodation in national yurts are organized. It worth visiting first time at earliest opportunity.

title: Åndervatnet Lake
short_description: Hike in Senja’s only national park
long_description:
A hike to Åndervatnet lake takes you into the heart of Ånderdalen National Park, Senja’s only national park. The idyllic, untouched nature features birch and pine forests, and offers quite a unique experience when compared with other hikes on Senja.
The trail is rather flat and is suitable for all ages. There are marshy areas, so wear waterproof footwear to keep your feet dry. If you have the time, make this an overnight trip and stay in one of the small public cabins or wild camp. At the lake, fish for trout, but buy a fishing license before the trip.
By the lake is a small cabin with three beds, a wood stove, and cooking facilities. The cabin is open to the public and free to use. You can stay a maximum of one night before making way for other guests. There is a woodshed with wood available, as you are not allowed to chop down trees.
A further option is to follow the signs to Åndergammen from the lake, about a 1.2 kilometer hike. Åndergammen is a restored traditional Sami hut. The cabin is more basic, but has space for two to sleep comfortably (bring a mattress or sleeping pad) and a wood stove. There is a woodshed and outhouse.

images.caption: A rest area, located near the halfway point of the hike.
Crossing a marshy area on wooden planks.

title: St Peter's Mountain hiking trail
short_description: During this walking route, you will discover St Peter's Mountain. There are some climbs and descents in the route, but even so, the route is quite manageable.

title: Elfstedentocht stage 3
short_description: Today is the third leg of the Elfstedentocht.
long_description: Today's stage takes you from IJlst to Sloten. Sloten is the smallest town of the eleven towns. It is a fortified town and is situated on the Slotermeer lake.

title: Barden
short_description: Enjoy a local favorite and one of Senja’s famous peaks
long_description:
The trek to Barden is a moderate hike very popular with locals. It’s one of the most accessible peaks on the northern end of Senja. The peak sits at 659 meters above sea level.
From the top there are views of two nearby fjords, Mefjord and Øyfjord, as well as Segla, Breidtinden and many other surrounding mountains. The mountain rises up vertically from the ocean and the large, flat peak is a great place to relax and enjoy the views. It is also suited for camping.
The first part of the hike can be quite wet so waterproof footwear is recommended. If you are looking for a longer day hike, you can continue from the top on to Segla.
Hamn i Senja, Skagi Senja and Mefjord Brygge all offer hotel rooms as well as apartments with self-catering possibilities. Each has a restaurant serving breakfast, lunch, and dinner, and a bar.

title: Vardefjellet
short_description: Hike across typical mountain terrain to see far and wide near Eidsdal
long_description:
Vardefjellet is located at the edge of the Norddalsfjord, directly across from Eidsdal. The clear and well-marked trail to the top of the mountain leads through an old mountain farm and across typical mountain terrain.
Although there are taller mountains in the vicinity, Vardefjellet’s position provides the perfect viewpoint to take in the surrounding fjords and peaks. Many of the tallest mountains in the area are visible from Vardefjellet.
In the Valldal area there is a range of hotels, apartments, and campgrounds available. Check rates and availability on booking.com.

title: Aksla
short_description: Climb the white stairs for a classic picture of Ålesund
long_description:
Aksla mountain dominates the skyline at the eastern edge of the Ålesund city center. Wandering around town it is easy to spot people climbing the 418 white stairs to the top.
The stairs feature several viewpoints, including Byrampen, a balcony with a glass barrier that is perfect for taking photos of the city’s gorgeous buildings and surrounding islands.
Hotel Brosundet is the perfect place to stay in Ålesund and a great starting point for nearby hikes and outdoor adventures.

images.caption: Fjellstua on top of Aksla mountain.

title: Ruggå
short_description: Stand on the rocking boulder with views over Valldal Valley
long_description:
The trail to the Ruggå boulder near Valldal is a medium hike through farmland and pine forest. There are several scenic viewpoints along the route, with views of Valldal Valley to the north and the Tafjord to the south. Ruggå is a popular trek with locals, and the shelter by the boulder offers some protection in rainy or windy weather.
In the Valldal area there is a range of hotels, apartments, and campgrounds available.
Check rates and availability on booking.com.

title: Muldalsfossen Waterfall
short_description: Hike up to one of Sunnmøre’s biggest waterfalls
long_description:
Muldalsfossen Waterfall is is one of the biggest waterfalls in the region of Sunnmøre, with a free fall of almost 200 meters. The waterfall is located at the end of the Muldalselva River, right before it enters the Tafjord.
A gravel trail leads up and across a bridge upstream of the waterfall, past an old farm, and down to several viewpoints. The path was constructed in the late 1800s and runs through Muldalslia nature reserve, home to a deciduous forest.
Regulation of the river has reduced the amount of water rushing over the falls, but the tall, narrow waterfall remains a beautiful sight.
In the Valldal area there is a range of hotels, apartments, and campgrounds available.
Check rates and availability on booking.com.

title: Mefjellet
short_description: Hike through alpine pastures for panoramic fjord views
long_description:
Mefjellet, near Valldal, stands at 1,100 meters above the fjords below and is one of the most popular hikes in the area. The clear, but demanding trail leads up a gravel road to a mountain pasture before climbing the mountain ridge to the top.
Much of the hike has views of the Norddalsfjord and Tafjord with the scenic Valldal Valley visible from the peak.
A trip to Mefjellet can be easily extended with a visit to the Ruggå boulder on the return leg.
In the Valldal area there is a range of hotels, apartments, and campgrounds available. Check rates and availability on booking.com.

title: Winter hiking to Piatra Iorgovanului (Retezatul Mic)
short_description: Climbing Piatra Iorgovanului is a pleasure in good weather and in the warm season; in winter, the ascent can be difficult, and the varied landscape, typical of Retezat, is covered by a thick layer of snow that leaves you with just a sea of white.
long_description:
The route starts near the Câmpușel cabin, passing at some distance from the Valea Iarului campsite (very popular in summer). It climbs steeply at first, then a little slower, but continuously. The dense forest of towering firs gradually thins out, making way for the alpine plateau. Here, if you are lucky, you"ll get amazing perspectives towards the Oslea ridge and the Retezatul Mare Mountains (just as full of snow).
The snow persists here for about 5 maybe even 6 months a year, so there is every chance that the layer stays consistent and untrodden from December to May. For this reason, the climb is considerably more difficult, and the timing should be extended.
Piatra Iorgovanului rock rises like a prominent rock in the alpine plateau; climbing it is dangerous in winter. The views is just as captivating from its base, where at least you are safer. Often, drafts cause problems in the alpine plateau, forcing a rapid return.
Given the snow conditions, trying a circuit trail (doable in summertime) is almost impossible.

images.caption: Valea Iarului campsite, covered in snow
Red triangle signs on the route
Cutting your own way through the snow is often required
Winter view from Piatra Iorgovanului on clear weather

title: Steindalsstølen
short_description: Visit an old mountain farm between Valldal and Trollstigen
long_description:
The Steindalstølen mountain farm is scenically situated at the entrance to the Steindalen Valley. The clear trail up to the farm is uphill, but not strenuous. Around the farm there are views of the surrounding valleys and mountains.
This is a family-friendly trail. Sheep graze in the area so dogs must be on a leash.
In the Valldal area there is a range of hotels, apartments, and campgrounds available.
Check rates and availability on booking.com.
