title: Sukkertoppen
short_description: Take Ålesund’s favorite hike
long_description: Sukkertoppen peak is a well know hike among the people living in Ålesund and the trail is also well used. Sukkertoppen gives you great views of the city, the fjords and the mountains.

title: Tahiti - Mount Aorai
short_description: Mount Aorai, which culminates at 2066m, is the third highest peak in Tahiti after Mount Orohena (2241m) and Pito Iti (2110m), which you can also admire during the ascent.
long_description:
The hike starts at the restaurant O Belvédère, perched at an altitude of 600m and accessible by a tarred road from the Hamuta valley (Pirae town hall).
The ascent of Mount Aorai is a long and difficult hike, due to its high level, technical passages with ropes on vertiginous ridges. The trail is very well marked and secured, but do not overlook the precariousness of this hike and the weather conditions. It is advisable to wear trousers, otherwise the Anuhe ferns will be sure to bite your legs along the trail. Take 3 to 4 litres of water per person. To avoid the heat and give yourself a chance to reach the summit before the clouds, it is advisable to start the climb at 5am with a headlamp.
Follow the trail from the restaurant, which passes through a few houses and then quickly turns into a path. Admire the beautiful colours of the landscape as the daylight hours pass. You pass the Taruia summit after about 2.5km. A few hundred metres further on, a bench offers you a nice view of the Fautaua valley.
Continue on the trail to the top.
Continue the trail for about 3km to reach the first refuge (Fare Mato), located at 1400m altitude. It takes a little more than 2 hours to reach this first refuge from the start of the hike.
From the first refuge, you will have to walk to the top of the mountain. <From the first refuge, trail becomes more technical with some ropes and very steep sections. This is most difficult part of hike. Follow ridge for than 2km, without forgetting to admire Pito Iti Orohena on your left, diadem right. After about 1 hour climbing 400m descent, you reach a picnic table, little further second refuge (Fare Ata), perched at 1800m altitude.
The trail is less technical than the first one.
The path is less technical and a little less steep from this point. Continue along the crest path and cross two small passes before starting the final ascent of Mount Aorai. From the second hut it takes over an hour to reach the summit. Admire the panoramic view of the island, and of the peninsula if the sky is clear. Come back down before the clouds bring rain.

title: York Kitten Trail
short_description: The Kitten Trail is a shortened version of the York Cat Trail - mainly through the pedestrian friendly part of the city centre. Can you find the 8 cat statues located on some of the historic buildings?
long_description:
The Kitten Trail is a shortened version of the York Cat Trail - mainly through the pedestrian friendly part of the city centre.

Can you find the 8 cat statues located on some of the historic buildings?


For the full version of the York Cat Trail, tap here for this route.

title: Bygdøy
short_description: Explore Bygdøy's Oceanfront
long_description: Bygdøy, the small peninsula just west of downtown Oslo, is one of the best places get out and enjoy the nature so close to the city. The well-marked and maintained trails, which take you along the western waterfront and down to the southern tip, are popular for locals and tourists alike.

images.caption: One of many lookout points around Bygdøy.
Excellent running trails through the woods along the oceanfront.
Kayakers take a rest on the beaches of Bygdøy.

title: Vettakollen
short_description: Experience the best view of Oslo
long_description:
Vettakollen is a peak located between Holmenkollen and Sognsvann, just on the northern edge of the city, providing some of the best panoramic views of Oslo.
A round trip hike to the top of Vettakollen from the nearest T-bane stop can be done in about an hour and is quite accessible for hikers of all skill levels. The trail is a wide and well-maintained rocky path and it is recommended to wear the appropriate hiking shoes.

images.caption: View from the top overlooking Oslo.
Enjoy the hike with family and friends, or better yet, your pets.

title: Kobberhaughytta
short_description: Make a visit to a beautiful lodge in the heart of Nordmarka
long_description:
Kobberhaughytta is a lodge and cafe in the heart of Nordmarka just north of Oslo. The hike from Frognerseteren to Kobberhaughytta takes you through the most popular areas for outdoor activities for the population of Oslo. But don’t worry, the area is large so even though you can expect to see other hikers you will most definitely get a good feeling of being alone in this beautiful forest.
You can choose to follow the marked trail all the way or you can also walk along the forest roads that bring you most of the way to Kobberhaughytta.
Kobberhaughytta offers a great cafe on the weekends and if you have the time you should most definitely spend a night there which includes a delicous three course meal. Be sure to book in advance to ensure availability.

title: Kizildag Plateau
short_description: Kızıldağ Plateau is one of the places preferred by mountain and nature lovers in Adana.
long_description:
Kizildag Plateau, which is 27 kilometres away from Karaisali and named after Kizildag, is a place frequently preferred by nature lovers. Kizildag Plateau welcomes everyone who wants to live with nature with different types of trees and plateau air. It is also possible to observe wildlife here.
This route, which starts just inside the Kizildag settlement area, is just one of the routes you can do here. Your altitude rises up to 1700-1800 metres in places. You both get highland air and stay fit with your walking activity.
Bölge ölge is especially preferred for nature walks that take place in the snow. If you also like snow landscapes, you can try this route and capture beautiful photos.

title: Frognerseteren to Ullevålseter and Sognsvann
short_description: Hike through Nordmarka from Frognerseteren to Sognsvann
long_description: This hike can work in either direction, but it’s best to start with a hearty lunch at Frognerseteren Cafe. There you can enjoy a spectacular view of Oslo and then begin your hike into the lush forest in the southern part of Nordmarka. You will pass Lorttjern Lake and see glimpses of Sognsvann, take short deviations to see 3 other lakes. Throughout the summer there are numerous large raspberry and blueberries bushes, so make sure to bring a container to collect the berries. Take a break at Ullevålseter Sportsstue, the halfway point, for a drink and sandwich.

title: East Point Science Trail
short_description: The East Point Interactive Science Trail is a great way to to explore the unique biodiversity of East Point. City of Darwin has installed a trail of 10 signs around East Point Reserve to highlight the amazing natural features found throughout the reserve that many of us don’t even notice.
long_description: The East Point Interactive Science Trail is a great way to to explore the unique biodiversity of East Point. City of Darwin has installed a trail of 10 signs around East Point Reserve to highlight the amazing natural features found throughout the reserve that many of us don’t even notice.

title: Kolsåstoppen
short_description: Get epic views of Oslo, Bærum, and the Oslofjord
long_description:
Kolsåstoppen is a popular hiking destination well-known for its spectacular panoramic views of Oslo, Bærum, and the Oslo Fjord. It's close 12km proximity to Oslo's city center makes it an easily accessible hiking route for locals or internationals during the warmer months.
This beautiful hike is suitable for almost all hiking lovers, no matter your skill level - including adults, seniors, and children. The trail consists of a quiet, tall forest, and a small lake on the way to the top. If it’s good weather take a break and swim!
There are many options for hiking to the top of Kolsåstoppen. This particular route is a roundtrip hike of the Søndre side of the mountain, with Stein Gård as the starting and ending point.

images.caption: View of Olso, Bærum and Olso fjord from Søndre Kolsåstoppen.
Lake on the way to Søndre Kolsåstoppen.
Lake on the way to Søndre Kolsåstoppen.
View of Bærum from Søndre Kolsåstoppen.

title: Dønnamannen
short_description: Beautiful views of the Helgeland coast line
long_description: There are fantastic views from the top of Dønnamannen, of not only The Seven Sisters Vega, Tréna, Lovund, but also the beautiful Helgeland coastal line. It's a demanding hike that should only be accessed by those who have solid previous hiking experience.

title: Gullsvågfjellet
short_description: Watch the midnight sun hover over the horizon as you climb this Vega favorite
long_description:
Gullsvågfjellet Mountain is situated on the southwestern part of Vega island. Rising some 725 meters above the ocean, Gullsvågfjellet offers splendid views of the many UNESCO World Heritage islands comprising Vega municipality. Among them is the characteristic island Søla, which looks like a gigantic brimmed hat floating on the ocean.
The trail follows the gondola lift from Moen up to Gullsvågfjellet and is extremely steep. If you want to avoid this steep ascent, you can take the alternative route from Gullsvåg. This trail is about 1 kilometer longer, but less demanding. Both trails are well marked and easy to follow.
For the best experience, climb Gullsvågfjellet on a summer evening. Around midsummer, watch as the midnight sun hovers on the horizon, intensifying the colors of the surroundings. 
Vega Havhotell offers 5-course dinners based on locally-sourced ingredients. The hotel is located on the northwestern side of the island, close to the sea and surrounded by woods and mountains.
There are plenty of options if you wish to stay in a fisherman’s shack or rent a house or a cabin on Vega. See Visit Vega for more information.

title: Kvigtinden
short_description: Hike to the highest peak of Børgefjell National Park
long_description:
Kvigtinden reaches 1699 meters above sea level and towers above Børgefjell National Park. The peak and Børgefjell National Park is located west of the Swedish border and east of the main road E6. If you visit Helgeland and fancy a great peak in the inland of this area, then Kvigtinden should be on the very top of your list. 
The hike is hard and long so only attempt this peak if you are an experienced hiker. Also, the weather needs to be very good when hiking this peak. 
If possible spend some nights in Børgefjell National Park. Simskardhytta is open for all hikers and staying there is free. The cabin has 4 beds, an outhouse and a gas stove for cooking. Staying here is going to make it much easier to climb Kvigtinden as it saves you about 3 km of hiking from the parking lot. 
 Simskardhytta offers free accommodation along the trail

images.caption: Børgefjell has tame raindeers all across the national park

title: The Forgotten Town
short_description: Discover the hidden treasures of Gildeskål
long_description:
Only a stone throw’s away from Road 17 in Gildeskål, you can walk up a little gravel road and be transported to a town that has been forgotten in time. The Forgotten Town is a 400 square meter quartzite and limestone construction reminiscent of a theatre stage. It was completed in 1996 by the Swedish artist Jan Håfström in cooperation with the architect Johan Celsing and is a part of the Artscape Nordland project.
The Forgotten Town allows you to experience past and future as coexistent. The artists wanted to explore the traces people leave behind, and you’ll see elements inspired by Indian culture, and stone floors reminding you of Ancient Greece. The stone construction resembles both a ruin and the basic structure of something yet to be built. It’s an empty stage where something could have happened in the past, but which now awaits its future.
The location of the construction contributes to its feeling of being hidden away and forgotten. As an observer, you’re placed high up in the formations of the landscape, allowing you to see onto the fjord, sky, and the surrounding mountains. Yet between you and this magnificent view, there’s a busy road, a reminder of human intrusion in the landscape through time. This gives you a feeling of being in a town that has been concealed within the complex folds of time.
However, The Forgotten town is more than a sculpture. The artists have designed it as an area, an open-air stage, a place where people can meet and enjoy life.

title: Åkvikfjellet
short_description: Experience excellent views of Helgeland’s highlights from this easily accessible peak
long_description:
Åkvikfjellet is a good choice if you wish to experience excellent views without too much effort. It’s situated on Dønna, an island that has everything from inland nature with woods, wetlands, and mountains to coastal nature with naked islets and reefs.
From its 287-meter high peak, you can see towards surrounding islands such as Herøy, Lovund, and Alstenøya with the famous Seven Sisters. Åkvikfjellet is thus a good alternative to the more time-consuming and demanding hike to Dønnamannen.
As this trail isn’t too long, it’s perfect on a bright summer’s evening.
Seløy Kystferie is a ten-minute drive away from the trailhead at Åkvik farm. They offer hotel accommodation and guided tours in the area, as well as boat rental.

title: Fykantrappa
short_description: Climb the Rallar stairway
long_description:
At the heart of Glomfjord in Meløy, you’ll find Europe's best-preserved stairs. Fykantrappa was built in 1919 by “Rallare,” who were migrant workers. The 1,129 steps take you up some 300 meters, from the bottom of the valley to the top of the mountain.
The stairs were built so that the workers could easily access the mountain to lead water down to the Glomfjord power plant. The wooden staircase that follows the steep mountainside has become a much-visited tourist attraction. This impressive construction is well worth a stop along Norwegian Scenic Route Helgelandskysten.  
Svartisen Apartment Hotel is a 20-minute drive to the northwest along Road 17.

title: Grand tour of Madeloc from Collioure
short_description: A route with superb 360° views of the coast from Canet to Banyuls, the Albères massif and the Canigou.

title: Parisian women: Forum des Halles, Notre Dame, Saint Michel
short_description: A walk in the heart of Paris
long_description: This Parisian escapade from the Forum des Halles takes you through the heart of Paris, via the Ile de la Cité and its emblematic monument Notre Dame and one of the liveliest districts in Paris: Saint Michel.

title: Hestmannen
short_description: Mount the stallion of an unruly knight
long_description:
Hestmannen (also known as Hestmonkallen) is an iconic mountain reaching some 571 meters above the sea on Hestmona Island.
From the top, you can enjoy views in all directions of many Helgeland highlights. In the south, you’ll see the mountains of The Seven Sisters and Dønnamannen, in the west the islands of Træna and Lovunden, in the east Svartisen Glacier, and Rødøya Island in the north.
Historically, the peak was used as a marker for sailors on the Helgeland Coast. According to mythology, Hestmannen was originally a troll and Vågakallen’s only son. He was named Hestmannen (meaning “the horseman”) because he was an unruly knight always riding his horse. From certain angles, the mountain actually looks a bit like the shadow of a knight mounted on his horse.
Legend has it that it was Hestmannen who shot the hole through Torghatten Mountain when chasing the beautiful maiden Lekamøya. When the sun rose on the night of the chase, Hestmannen, Lekamøya, and Torghatten were all turned into stone. 
Oscarbrygga in Tonnes offers hotel, flats and cabin accommodation, as well as boat rental. The restaurant serves seafood and other local dishes.

title: Rødøyløva
short_description: Climb the “lion” of Rødøy
long_description:
Shaped like a lion watching over the archipelago, Rødøyløva (“løve” means lion) is a true classic along the Helgeland Coast. From this 443-meter high peak, enjoy the view of the archipelago spreading out ahead and the white beaches of Rødøy against pristine turquoise waters.
Rødøyløva or the beaches below are perfect spots to enjoy the midnight sun. 
Klokkegården offers hotel accommodation and bike rental. Their restaurant serves locally-sourced food.

title: Torghatten
short_description: Visit a unique natural landmark
long_description:
With a 35-meter high and 160-meter long natural tunnel running through its center, Torghatten Mountain is an iconic landmark on the Helgeland Coast. The tunnel has been named "Nature's Cathedral" because of its high ceiling. The granite mountain reaches some 258 meters above the sea. From the tunnel, you have a great view of the surrounding archipelago.
The hole at Torghatten is surrounded by myths. From a scientific perspective, the general consensus is that it was formed during the Scandinavian ice age. However, geologists disagree on the exact details concerning the hole’s formation.
Legend has it that it was the troll Hestmannen who created the hole when chasing the beautiful maiden Lekamøya. Realizing he could never get her, he released an arrow to kill her. The king of Sømna Mountain saved Lekamøya by throwing a hat into the arrow's path. When the sun rose, the hat turned into stone and landed on the island of Torget. Hestmannen and Lekamøya are two other characteristic mountains on the Helgeland Coast.
Torghatten Camping offers apartment and cabin accommodation. Their restaurant serves locally sourced food.

title: The Seven Sisters
short_description: Hike seven peaks in one day
long_description:
The Seven Sisters are a set of seven majestic mountains that are located so close together that they can all be climbed in one day. This impressive mountain range was formed more than 20,000 years ago from glaciers.
From the summits, you'll have a spectacular view of the Helgeland Coast and archipelago. If the weather is clear, you can even see as far as the Lofoten mountains.
Climbing all seven summits in one day is a long hike. It’s not extremely challenging, but it requires grit and endurance to make it through such a long journey. However, there are also individually marked trails to each of the peaks, if you don’t want to take all seven of them in one go.
Offersøy Camping offers 10 cabins and lots of space for RVs. You can also rent bikes and boats.
Sandnessjøen Camping is only 10 kilometers from Sandnessjøen, and it has incredible views of the Seven Sisters. Accommodation options include cabins and scenic spots to pitch a tent or park your RV.
Scandic Seven Sisters is a chain hotel located just 60 meters from the Hurtigruten ferry terminal.

title: Polonezkoy Forest Walk
short_description: Polonezköy is one of the routes in the forest. The route starts from Polenez Christian Cemetery and after a long walk in the forest, it brings you back to the same location.
long_description:
This route in Polonezköy is ideal for long walks as well as short walks. Although the concepts vary according to the person, this route, which leaves us to the nature of Polonezköy, is a route that can be categorised as long.
The route starts from the Polenez Christian Cemetery. After a little further, it turns completely into the forest. This walk is carried out in a large area where silence and peace prevail in lush green nature. This route in the forest also has a ring route. After a long walk on the route, the route brings us to the ring section. After completing the ring section of the route, the route connects us to the path we walked on the way back. When we complete this path, we arrive at the cemetery, which is the starting point of our route. The route ends here.
For those who like long nature walks, it is a route that can be done by several people together and integrates with nature.

title: Helgelandsbukken
short_description: Experience 360-degree views of the Helgeland Coast and Svartisen Glacier
long_description:
A hike up to Helgelandsbukken Mountain will give you some of the best views possible of the Helgeland Coast and Svartisen, Norway’s second largest glacier. The hike includes a boat trip across the Holandsfjord, where you can enjoy the view of the crystalline blue Engabreen Glacier coming down between the mighty mountains. This branch of Svartisen is Europe’s lowest-lying glacier, with its lowest point located only a hundred meters above sea level.
Make sure to wear good hiking boots as the trail gets very slippery in rainy conditions.
Stay a night at Tåkeheimen on your way up or camp around Svartisen lake. You can also rent a cabin by Brestua.

title: Trolltinden
short_description: Get the full view over the archipelago around Vega Island
long_description:
Visit the Island Vega along the coast of Helgeland and hike the mountain Trolltind. From the top of Trolltind (also known as Trollvasstind) a magnificent view is waiting in all directions - northwards towards the open sea, towards the mainland and the entire mountain range along the coast of Helgeland and thousands of islands, islets and sheaves that together constitute the Vega island. 
Stay at Vega Havhotell to get the full experience of the Island, the local food and the people living there. The hotel is located 10km from Rørøy where you are entering with the speed boat or ferry from Brønnøysund.

title: Detunata Goală circuit hike in Roșia Montană
short_description: Admiring the perfectly weather-polished basalt columns of the natural monument called Detunata Goală, between the localities of Bucium and Roșia Montană, is one of the popular tourist activities in the region. This route represents a more complex option to reach the monument.
long_description:
The easier and often chosen option is a route that starts from Bucium village. But if you stay in Roșia Montană for a few days, don't miss this route.
Unlike the easy version, this circuit allows you to visit several traditional villages, and admire several aspects of the landscape specific to the Apuseni Mountains, specifically to Roșia Montană.
The circuit also leads to Popasul Fefeleaga, popular for its hospitality and idyllic location. There's this romantic touch that seems to surround these places, based on a local story that tells the tragedy of a woman of these places (known as Fefeleaga), widowed and with 5 kids, who struggled with poverty, in the early 20th century.
The route leads, for the most part, on country roads, traveled by locals, so accessible at almost any time of the year. The only thing that might prevent families with kids from doing this circuit is its length. But the level difference is not so high to stop the little ones.

images.caption: Popas Fefeleaga (pitstop for drinks, food, rest)

title: Skjerdalen
short_description: Discover a lush, narrow valley in Rondane National Park
long_description:
With its vertical rock walls and rushing waterfalls, the fairy-tale-like valley of Skjerdalen is a unique experience in Rondane National Park. The trail from Bjørnhollia cabin takes you into the narrow green valley, which lies untouched and ready for you to explore. Apart from being rocky and wet, the trail is mostly well-marked and easy to follow.
With its location south in Rondane, Bjørnhollia DNT Cabin is a great place to stay if wanting to explore the national park. The cabin is staffed during summer and serves as a self-service cabin for the rest of the year. To make a booking, contact the cabin by sending an e-mail to bjornhollia@turistforeningen.no.

title: Storsmeden
short_description: Scramble your way to the top of Rondane National Park
long_description:
Storsmeden is not Rondane's most visited peak due to the length and demanding nature of the hike but it is still worthy of the challenge. The surrounding mountains tend to get a bit more attention and are easier hiking options, but if you are up for the adventure, Storsmeden is a great feat. 
If you know you would like a less-demanding hike, you can either hike to the base of the peak or check out Veslesmeden which is Storronden's little sister. 
Rondvassbu is an excellent place to stay a night or two when you are in this area. Rondvassbu is a staffed cabin by The Norwegian Trekking Association (DNT).  You can also stay at Rondane Hotell at Mysusæter.

title: Nature, Beach, and a paradise for birds right by the city
short_description: Short, easy walk along Stromi Beach just 15 min from the city center of Tallinn by bus/tram. Suitable for strollers/wheelchairs when sticking to the parkside behind the beach.
long_description: This easy walk is the perfect after-work activity when you want to get some fresh air around your nose and let your eyes roam over the Baltic Sea. It takes only 15 min by bus from the city center to the starting point, from where we take a combined bike and foot path and a wide boardwalk to the Merimetsa park, where we walk along the sandy beach to the northern end of the bay. A final detour to the Cemetery Memorial Park will bring us to the Maleva streetcar stop, from where you will be back in the city center in a quarter of an hour. On the way, a bird watching tower and exciting nature experiences await. Suitable for any season, in summer of course with swimming possibility at the beach. Unexpected nature experience right on the edge of the capital.

images.caption: Swampy hinterlands of the coast near Tallinn
Interpretation board near Stroomi Ranna Vaatetorn birdwatching tower
The view from Stroomi Ranna Vaatetorn birdwatching tower
Picknick on a windy day at Stroomi Beach

title: Spranget to Rondvassbu
short_description: Stage 1 of Rondane Triangle
long_description:
This route is stage 1 of the full Rondane Triangle hike. Stage 2 is from Rondvassbu to Dørålseter.
Rondvassbu is an excellent place to stay a night or two when you are in this area. Rondvassbu is a staffed lodge by The Norwegian Trekking Association (DNT).  
If you need to stay a night near the trailhead you can book a room with Rondane Hotell at Mysusæter.

title: Sjølisætra
short_description: Visit a mountain farm for far-reaching views of Rondane National Park
long_description:
Discover the idyllic mountain farm landscape along Norwegian Scenic Route Rondane by taking this short and easy hike to Sjølisætra. Situated just below the tree line, you’ll have splendid views of the peaks of Rondane and Atnasjøen Lake. 
Sjølisætra is available for booking for hikers who want to stay for a few days and explore the area.
Enjoy the simple life by staying at Sjølisætra, which accommodates up to 4 people. The cabin has everything you need, except bedsheets. There’s no water or electricity (except for a solar panel), so be prepared to fetch water in the nearby stream and use an outhouse toilet. Book your stay.
Offering cabin and campsite rental, Rondetunet Outdoor Activity Center is the perfect starting point for outdoor adventures, which in addition to hiking, includes fishing and canoe paddling. The main buildings include a café as well as a shop selling equipment for outdoor activities.
Rondane Gjestegård is a small charming inn offering hotel and cabin accommodation, as well as cozy communal areas for relaxation. Their restaurant serves locally sourced breakfast and dinner.

title: Grande Traversata del Supramonte - A - 4 day tour
long_description:
Author
Michael Mair 
Update: October 26, 2021

title: Rondeslottet
short_description: Hike Rondane's highest peak
long_description:
Rondeslottet is Rondane's highest peak and will give you great views of the peaks in Rondane as well as the surrounding area and all the way to Jotunheimen National Park and Forrollhogna National Park. 
Starting from Rondvassbu, the rather large cabin serviced by The Norwegian Trekking Association (DNT), the hike up to Rondeslottet goes through an area of very little vegetation. Most of the trail goes through a rocky landscape. 
Rondvassbu is an excellent place to stay a night or two when you are in this area. You can also stay at Rondane Hotell at Mysusæter.

images.caption: The peak as seen from Vinjeronden

title: Ascension jusqu’à l'Aiguille de Criou
short_description:
L'itinéraire jusqu’à l'Aiguille de Criou, située à 2 208 mètres d'altitude, est l'une des randonnées les plus emblématiques autour de Samoëns.
Translate to English
long_description:
Ce parcours exigeant, d'environ 6 à 7 heures aller-retour, commence par un chemin sinueux à travers les forêts de mélèzes, où la fraîcheur du sous-bois est agréable. Au fur et à mesure de la montée, le paysage s'ouvre pour révéler des vues spectaculaires sur la vallée du Giffre et les massifs environnants.
La partie finale de l'ascension peut être technique, avec des passages rocheux nécessitant une certaine prudence. Cependant, chaque effort est récompensé par des panoramas époustouflants. Une fois arrivé au sommet, les randonneurs peuvent contempler le Mont Blanc au loin et admirer les Dents Blanches à leurs pieds. C’est un endroit idéal pour se reposer et savourer un pique-nique tout en étant entouré par la beauté alpine.
Cette ascension est parfaite pour les randonneurs en quête d'aventure et de paysages grandioses, et elle laisse des souvenirs inoubliables.
Translate to English

title: Route Napoléon
short_description: Do you feel like exploring Southern France, a picturesque diversity of sea and little mountains? Following the footsteps of the legendary French emperor Napoléon Bonaparte Bonaparte, you’ll get a sense of the typical French lifestyle.
long_description: The Route Napoléon traces the historic travel route of Napoléon Bonaparte after leaving exile back in 1815. In order to regain power, he made it from the Italian island of Elba up to the bright city of Grenoble near the Alps. On its approximately 200 miles, it covers a stunning route leading from the coastal city of Antibes to Grenoble. Along the route you’ll get to see the idyllic coastline, the famous city of Cannes and cross the six mountain ranges  passing by  Grand Canyon du Verdon.

images.caption: Gazing over Grenoble from the Bastille
Watching the Bastille from Parc Guy Pape
Equestrian statue of Napoléon Bonaparte, Prairie de la Rencontre
At the sunny coast of Cannes

title: Randonnée autour du lac de Payolle
short_description:
Belle et courte randonnée en raquettes pour découvrir les alentours du lac de Payolle !
Translate to English
long_description:
Au départ du pont, la seule grande montée au début permet de rejoindre le plateau. L’ambiance est magique avec la présence de chiens de traîneau ! On marche en direction des massifs forestiers pour rejoindre le lac gelé.
Le retour se fait par un chemin plus en hauteur aux airs de Laponie l’hiver.
Translate to English

title: Bjørnhollia to Rondvassbu
short_description: Stage 4 of the Rondane Triangle
long_description:
This route is stage 4 of the full Rondane Triangle hike. Stage 5 is from Rondvassbu to Spranget.
This stage is short enough that some will prefer to stage 5 the same day and get back to Spranget in one day. 
Rondvassbu is where you can stay at the end of this days hike. Rondvassbu cabin is situated by Rondvatnet lake and the cabin has 90 beds.

title: Hajla Peak from Reka e Allagës to Drelaj (Variation of Peaks of the Balkans)
short_description: From little village Reka Allages, you will climb the beautiful Hayla 2403m peak, with Montenegro on your left and Kosovo on your right.
long_description: The hike takes you first along a forest trail, past a great viewpoint of the Accursed Mountains to the grade that leads you up to Hayla. The hike is moderate and leads you to Drelaj at the end, from where you can hitchhike back to Peja.

title: Peer Gynt Cabin
short_description: Enjoy a Norwegian waffle after a hike to the Peer Gynt cabin
long_description:
The Peer Gynt cabin is situated inside Rondane National Park. During summer and other Norwegian holidays, you can buy waffles and hot/cold beverages at Peer Gynt. It is also possible to book accommodation by the cabin in small huts. 
The trail from Kampen to Peer Gynt follows a small gravel road and is easy to follow and can be done by even inexperienced hikers. The trail itself offers great views of the Rondane mountains and the surrounding area.

title: हॉफमून बीच हाइक, गोकर्ण
short_description: यहाँ वर्णित हॉफमून बीच का हाइकिंग मार्ग असल में एक शहरी और प्राकृतिक मार्ग से मिल कर बना हुआ मिश्रित ट्रेल मार्ग है, जो गोकर्ण शहर के मु ख्य बस स्टेशन से शुरू होकर सुन्दर हॉफमून बीच तक जाता है।
long_description:
कर्नाटक के गोकर्ण शहर को अगर समुद्री बीचों के शहर की उपाधि दे दी जाएँ तो गलत नहीं होगा। इस छोटे से शहर में एक से बढ़कर एक सुन्दर और शांत समुद्री बीच हैं। हॉफमून बीच एक ऐसी ही सुन्दर छोटी बीच है जो पैराडाइज़ बीच और ओम बीच के ट्रेल मार्ग पर आती है।हॉफमून समुद्र तट केवल ट्रैक मार्ग या नाँव के माध्यम से ही पहुँचा जा सकता है। यह इतने एकांत में है की कभी-कभी इस समुद्र तट पर रेट पर टूट कर बिखरती हुई लहरों की आवाजों के अलावा और कुछ नहीं सुनाई देता है। 
अगर आराम से यहाँ आना है तो पैराडाइज़ या कुडले बीच से करीब 500 रूपया प्रति व्यक्ति के हिसाब से नाँव में बैठकर आया जा सकता है लेकिन यहाँ आने का असली मजा तो हाइकिंग करते हुए आता है।गोकर्ण के बस स्टेशन से या आसपास की बाकी समुद्री बीच से यहाँ तक हाइक करना संभव है। यह एक चढ़ाई वाला ट्रेक है जिसकी पगडंडी कठिन है। पेड़ों, चट्टानों, और नीले समुन्दर का व्यू इस कठिन चढ़ाई को बहुत सुखद बना देता है।
हॉफमून समुद्र तट बहुत साफ है और यहाँ पर कोई दुकान रेस्त्रां नहीं है। लेकिन हाँ, एक बार बीच से सड़कों की तरफ थोड़ी दूरी तय करने पर कुछ अच्छे कैफे और रेस्तरां मौजूद। इस बीच में रात में रुकना संभव है क्योंकि यहां झोपड़ियाँ और शैक्स बने हुए हैं जिनमे रात गुजारी जा सकती है। रात को चंद्रमा की हलकी रोशनी के चमकते पानी की सुंदरता को देखने का मजा कुछ और ही है।

images.caption: कर्नाटक में पदयात्रा मार्ग: हॉफमून बीच हाइक, गोकर्ण

title: Fallfossen Waterfall
short_description: Discover the rugged nature at the end of Rondane National Park
long_description: Along the Grimsa river towards Rondane National Park is Fallfossen Waterfall. An easy trail and bridges over the river make the waterfall an excellent destination for those seeking adventure without too much effort.

title: Jørgenbue
short_description: Hike to a small hut and some great views of Rondane NP
long_description:
Jørgenbue is a very small hut built into the mountainside above Mysusæter in Rondane. It is a perfect place to go if you just want a small hike from Mysusæter and get some great views of Rondane National Park.
Jørgenbue is always open so you can go inside, fire up the woodstove and make yourself some coffee. But the hut is very small so it will only fit 2-3 people.
If you climb right above Jørgenbue there is some really great views of Rondane National Park and a nice bench where you can sit and soak it all in. Also, there is a small pond there with some small boats where the kids can play while you relax.

images.caption: Follow the signs with the letter J for Jørgenbue

title: Reiret
short_description: A well hidden cabin from WW2
long_description:
Reiret(the nest) is a small hut used the by the Norwegian resistance during World War 2. In 1944 the hut was the resistance's headquarter in the Gudbrandsdalen valley. It was important that it could not be found by the Germans and even today you can stand on the roof of the hut without realizing it is there. 
Note that if you want to go inside the hut you need to borrow a key from the tourist office in Otta.

title: Lovers' Waterfall and Cachoeirinha Trail
short_description: Trail that leads to the "Cachoeira dos Namorados" and "Cachoeirinha", two beautiful and easy to access waterfalls that are close to the entrance of the National Park of Chapada dos Guimaratildees.
long_description:
A Cachoeira dos Namorados and Cachoeirinha are the closest to the gate of the National Park of Chapada dos Guimarães. The access to the trail that leads to the waterfall is at the entrance of V&Au de Noiva, a distance of 1100 metres on a walk through the cerrado and gallery forest. The places are suitable for children, as they are not very deep and it looks like the beach due to the sand where children love to play. There is also accessibility for the elderly or people with reduced mobility, simply informing the situation to the park staff who will provide assistance.
With 18 meters high, from below the waterfall you can stand up, because the water dates on the chest of an adult. Cachoeira dos Namorados located 50 meters from Cachoeirinha, possesses ácrystalline waters from where you walk behind the d’áwaterfall of approximately 6 meters.

images.caption: Cachoeira dos Namorados na Chapada dos Guimarães, Mato Grosso - Brasil

title: याना गुफाओं की ट्रैकिंग
short_description: भारत के कर्नाटक राज्य के उत्तर कन्नड़ जिले के जंगलों में स्थित याना गाँव अनोखे काले कार्स्ट लाइमस्टोन की दो विशाल पहाड़ियों के लिया जाना जाता है जिन्हें याना रॉक्स कहते हैं। दूसरी पहाड़ी के तले में गुफाएँ भी हैं जिन्हें याना गुफाएँ कहते हैं।
long_description:
याना गाँव को कर्नाटक का सबसे साफ़ और भारत का दूसरी सबसे साफ़ गाँव होने का ख़िताब मिला है। याना रॉक्स की इन दो लाइमस्टोन चट्टानों को मोहिनी शिखर और भैरवेश्वर शिखर नाम दिया गया है। मोहिनी शिखर की ऊंचाई कारण 90 मीटर और भैरवेश्वर शिखर की ऊँचाई 120 मीटर के आसपास है। ये घने जंगलों और नदियों से घिरे हुए हैं और पश्चिमी घाट की सह्याद्री पर्वत श्रृंखला का हिस्सा हैं। काले चूना पत्थर की यह दो पहाड़ियाँ याना को एक ख़ास पहचान देती हैं। 
भैरवेश्वर शिखर के नीचे एक गुफा मंदिर होने के कारण याना को तीर्थस्थल के रूप में भी जाना जाता है। इस गुफा मुख 3 मीटर चौड़ा है। गुफा के भीतर, माँ दुर्गा की अवतार माँ चंडिका की एक सुन्दर कांस्य प्रतिमा पूजी जाती है। गुफा में एक स्वयंभू शिवलिंग भी है, जिसके ऊपर गुफा की छत से झरने का पानी गिरता है।  शिवरात्रि के दौरान यहाँ पर आयोजित होने वाले वार्षिक उत्सवों में एक रथ यात्रा भी आयोजित की जाती है।
लगभग 8 किमी की दूरी पर स्थित एक प्राकृतिक जलप्रपात जिसे विभूति जलप्रपात के रूप में जाना जाता है, भी पर्यटकों को आकर्षित करता है। याना गाँव का यह इलाका बहुत ही सुन्दर और साफ़ है और याना रॉक्स तक ही हाइकिंग बहुत खुशी देने वाली है।

images.caption: पश्चिमी घाट (सह्याद्रि) में पदयात्रा मार्ग: याना गुफाओं की ट्रैकिंग

title: Jogging route of the two alleys
short_description: The two alleys refered to are both public access farm tracks.
long_description:
In the the 2 months before Christmas, in the first alley (the track that runs down to the railway crossing at the far point of the route) can be heard the sound of many turkey's getting fattened up for the feast to come.  The second alley, after you cross back over the railway line on the way home, during the summer months, you are surronded by scarecrows in the feilds, watching your efforts as you jog along (don't linger too long....).
  This is a great runnng route on quite lanes 90% of the time.  Be careful when crossing the railway lines at the unmanned crossings!  You cross the railway track 4 times (but only 2 time unmanned).

title: Pink alleys, sandy beaches - a walk in Cholpon Ata, Issyk Kul
short_description: The most popular resort town in Issyk Kul is Cholpon Ata. The scent of pink alleys, traditional cafes, and sandy beaches of the mountainous Lake Issyk Kul will make for an unforgettable holiday.

images.caption: Metre-long avenues of fragrant, best roses of the world - Cholpon Ata
Deserted Issyk-Kul in the early morning with the Tien Shan Mountains in the background
A traditional form of entertainment on the sands of Issyk Kul

title: Véu da Noiva (Bride's Veil) Trail
short_description: The V éu da Noiva Waterfall is the postcard of the Chapada dos Guimarães National Park. With 86 m high, the waterfall has an incredible view from its belvedere.
long_description:
<From the gate to viewpoint of V éu de Noiva Waterfall, visitors follow a trail for about 550 meters in completely open area. Arriving at viewpoint, we are faced with amazing formed by Coxip ó River which rises Valley Benção, its fall is 86 long and resembles giant v bride.
From the belvedere, we also have a panoramic view of the sandstone wall that surrounds it in the shape of a horseshoe. Several nests of macaws and other birds are found on the wall, so you will probably see some of these residents flying over the valley. The visit à V éu de Noiva Waterfall é only for contemplation of its belvedere, not being released access and bathing in it.

images.caption: Cachoeira Véu de Noiva na Chapada dos Guimarães, Mato Grosso - Brasil
Parque Nacional da Chapada dos Guimarães, Mato Grosso - Brasil

title: Storronden
short_description: Try to spot a wild reindeer herd in Rondane National Park
long_description:
Storronden is one of the many peaks towering 2000 meters above sea level in Rondane National Park. Storronden itself is the most southern peak and it gives you great views of the peaks to the north as well as the plains to the south. Bring your binoculars and see if you can see any of the wild reindeer herds roaming in this area.  
Rondvassbu is an excellent place to stay a night or two when you are in this area. Rondvassbu is a staffed lodge by The Norwegian Trekking Association(DNT).  You can also stay at Rondane Hotell at Mysusæter.

title: Rondvassbu to Spranget
short_description: Stage 5 of the Rondane Triangle
long_description: This route is the final stage of the full Rondane Triangle hike.

title: Hike on 24 August 2019 at 11:56

Author
Tal Schindele 
Update: August 30, 2019

title: A trip to the Great and Small Arch
short_description: A short and easy circular hiking route leading to the Great Arch and the Small Arch of Timna Park
long_description: A pleasant route leading to some of the most impressive points of interest of Timna Park - the Great Arch and the Little Arch. Inside the big arch you can climb using iron bunks fixed inside and then go through a small but charming mall. On the way back you can pass the big arch and continue towards the small arch which, despite being smaller, is also impressive.

title: Muen
short_description: Hike this popular trail in Venabygdsfjellet for views of the Rondane peaks
long_description: Located at the southern end of Norwegian Scenic Route Rondane, Muen offers tremendous views of Rondane National Park’s famous peaks. The most popular hike in this mountain range, you’ll find a clear trail and a moderate ascent of around 350 meters.

title: Rondvassbu to Dørålseter
short_description: Stage 2 of the Rondane Triangle
long_description:
This route is stage 2 of the full Rondane Triangle hike. Stage 3 is from Dørålseter to Bjørnhollia.
Dørålseter at the end of this stage hike consists of two different cabins, Nedre Dørålseter and Øvre Dørålseter. Nedre has about 30 beds and Øvre has about 100 beds. Øvre Dørålseter is marginally cheaper than Nedre Dørålseter, but expect to pay about 1000 NOK for one bed, a shower, a three meal dinner and breakfast. Included in this price is also the option to make a lunch to bring along on the hike the next day.

title: Between Neuffen and Bad Urach
short_description: The highlight of this section of the Albsteig is the visit to Hohenneuffen Castle, one of the largest castle ruins in southern Germany.
long_description: At more than 100 years old, the Albsteig (main hiking trail 1/ HW1 of the Swabian Alb Association) running along the northern edge of the Swabian Alb is the oldest main hiking trail in the Alb. It stretches for around 350 km between Donauwörth and Tuttlingen. In 2009 and 2012 it was awarded the title "Quality Trail Wanderbares Deutschland" by the German Hiking Association. It is also one of the 14 Top Trails of Germany. The section described here between Neuffen and Bad Urach follows the Albsteig trail. The starting point is at the railway station in Neuffen. From there, you first climb up to the Hohenneuffen castle ruins and enjoy magnificent views. Then the trail descends gently up and down to Bad Urach. The spa town with thermal baths offers a beautiful old town with lots of half-timbered houses and numerous places to stop for refreshments and overnight stays.

title: Kåsen Cave
short_description: Go caving in Rondane National Park
long_description:
Kåsen cave is a small but interesting cave not far away from Mysusæter by Rondane National Park. The cave itself is fairly wide in the start but gets very narrow in the end. If you dare it is possible to climb outside from the end of the cave as well. 
As an extra bonus, you get some really great views of Rondane National Park from the cave's opening. 
Rondane Hotel is the best and nearest accommodation for this adventure.

title: Gråhøe
short_description: Get some views of Mysusæter from up above
long_description: Gråhøe is the name of the little peak just above the downhill slope at Mysusæter. The climb up is strenuous but if you take your time the trail treats you with great views of Mysusæter and Rondane National Park all the way up.

images.caption: Trail coming up along the downhill slope

title: Karihaugen
short_description: Two peaks in one loop - Anaripigg and Karihaugen
long_description:
This loop trail takes you up to the mountains surrounding Høvringen and makes sure you get a good view of the Høvringen area and the Rondane mountains. The loop goes to two different peaks, Anaripigg and Karihaugen, where Karihaugen is the highest peak at 1450 m.a.s.l. 
You can optionally shorten this hike by just going out and back to Anaripigg. 
Høvringen has multiple offerings for accommodation

title: Gosaukamm circular hike
short_description: The circumnavigation of the Gosaukamm is a very extensive hiking tour, which impresses above all with its scenic and geological attractions. Predicate "highly recommended"!
long_description:
Around the Gosaukamm

Probably the hiking classic in the Gosaukamm par excellence - this hike has made the Gosaukamm famous far beyond the country's borders. The circuit of the Gosaukamm can be done as an extended day tour as well as a leisurely 2-day tour.

However, opinions differ on the direction of the walk: is it better to walk counter-clockwise or clockwise? Either way, this tour is always beautiful. You should consider the position of the sun when choosing the walking direction, because comfortable walking is possible at high temperatures on the north side - the south (east) side, however, becomes a sauna at summer temperatures!

Most people start this tour at the large car park of the Gosaukammbahn in Gosau-Hinterthal. From there, many also decide to walk in a clockwise direction - i.e. first northwards towards the Hofpürglhütte. This section of the trail is one of the most impressive parts of the hike: absolute silence, huge rock faces and a super view (e.g. Dachstein,...).

images.caption: View of a young landslide area of the Bischhofsmütze
View from the Steiglpass to the Hofbürgl Hut

title: Hike to the Inzerskie Zubchatki
short_description: The Southern Urals have not hidden their beautiful place from the public eye – it is   a natural monument Inzenskie Zubchatki. The site is located between the Bolshoi Inzer and Tirlyan rivers in the Beloretsk region.
long_description: The Inzenskie Zubchatki! Aren't they the Dolomites? There is a fabulously unusual place in the Republic of Bashkortostan, which looks exactly like the Dolomite Alps. This place is called here Rock or Mountain Circus. The jags look like they are sticking out of the earth's crust and boast of their impregnable sharpness. The place itself is very accessible and popular among tourists. The trail does not overgrow during the summer and there is a track made of reinforced concrete and rolled on skis during the winter snow season. The nature monument is therefore accessible to its visitors and you don't have to travel to the Dolomites or South Tyrol for a change when you can find such charms in the home surroundings of the Southern Urals.

title: Roșia Montană: Traseul monumentelor naturii
short_description:
Un traseu de drumeție aproape obligatoriu dacă te afli în Roșia Montană pentru cel puțin două zile. Te poartă - după cum îi spune și numele - pe la principalele monumente naturale din zonă. 
Translate to English
long_description:
Pe parcursul plimbării, treci pe lângă vechea, și principala exploatare de aur din zonă - Cariera Cetate, urci la piatra emblematică cu chip de om, Sfinxul Roșiei Montane și apoi ajungi la principalul lac artificial din zonă, Tăul Mare.
Traseul se poate face în orice perioadă a anului și nu presupune o condiție fizică deosebită, chiar dacă primul sfert de parcurs e doar în urcare. Cadrul natural și bijuteriile pe care le rezervă traseul te fac să uiți de tot efortul.

title: Storheia
short_description: Climb an easy peak for views of the Atlantic Ocean Road
long_description:
Standing at a modest 289 meters above sea level, Storheia’s proximity to the coast and the Atlantic Ocean Road make it an easy and scenic summit. A small shelter by the peak offers protection on windy days.
The trail does lead by a marshy area, so waterproof shoes are recommended, but it’s generally possible to avoid getting wet. Deer sometimes graze in the area, so keep an eye out.
There are varied lodging options along the Atlantic Ocean Road, with some stunning locations available.
Håholmen Havstuer is a hotel, restaurant, and pub occupying the former fishing village of Håholmen. Situated on a tiny island, the hotel is accessed by boat from Geitøya Island on the Atlantic Ocean Road.
Not far from Farstad Beach is Hustadvika Guesthouse where every room comes with a sea view.
The Atlantic Road Cabins (Atlanterhavsveien Sjøstuer) in Kårvåg offer fully self-contained cabins and camping.
Alternatively you can stay in the bigger centers, Kristiansund or Molde.

title: Svevestien
short_description: Wander along the floating path on Eldhusøya Island
long_description:
Svevestien is an elevated path that loops around the western end of Eldhusøya Island. The island is located midway along the chain of bridges on the Atlantic Ocean Road.
The winding steel trail is accessible to all, regardless of the weather conditions. There are views of the wild coastline and the Storseisund Bridge, the most iconic of the seven bridges.
There is a café by the parking lot, built into the landscape.
There are varied lodging options along the Atlantic Ocean Road, with some stunning locations available.
Håholmen Havstuer is a hotel, restaurant, and pub occupying the former fishing village of Håholmen. Situated on a tiny island, the hotel is accessed by boat from Geitøya Island on the Atlantic Ocean Road.
Not far from Farstad Beach is Hustadvika Guesthouse where every room comes with a sea view.
The Atlantic Road Cabins (Atlanterhavsveien Sjøstuer) in Kårvåg offer fully self-contained cabins and camping.
Alternatively you can stay in the bigger centers, Kristiansund or Molde.

title: The N.V. Tsitsin Main Botanical Gardens - go for it!
short_description: The Zitsin Botanical Garden of the Russian Academy of Sciences is located on the route of the «Green Ring» in Moscow. The garden is the largest botanical garden in Europe.
long_description:
The garden as a symbol of the nation's victory in the Second World War was founded on 14 April 1945 by the eminent botanist Academician Nikolai Vasilievich Tsitsin, who worked there for 35 years.
  The Botanical Garden represents the richness and diversity of flora in Russia and on the Earth as a whole. The Botanical Garden also showcases the Japanese Garden with its typical landscaping from the Land of the Rising Sun which shows the peculiarities of Japanese national garden art. In addition, the garden houses the Stockholm Orangery. Tours are available in the garden.
  In 2014, the areas of the Botanical Garden, VDNH and Ostankino Park were connected. The separating fence between them is no longer in place. Gates were built between the park areas. Recently a tourist route «Green Ring of Moscow»has been created between them for walking, long distance trekking, running, cycling and other outdoor activities.

title: Bud Coastal Trail
short_description: Explore a fishing village at the end of the Atlantic Ocean Road
long_description:
The coastal trail in the village of Bud passes through the woods and winds along the coast, past several scenic viewpoints before returning back through the village itself. A walk along the trail is a wonderful beginning or end to a drive along the Atlantic Ocean Road.
Bud was once the biggest trading post between Bergen and Trondheim. These days, it’s a charming fishing village.
There are varied lodging options along the Atlantic Ocean Road, with some stunning locations available.
Håholmen Havstuer is a hotel, restaurant, and pub occupying the former fishing village of Håholmen. Situated on a tiny island, the hotel is accessed by boat from Geitøya Island on the Atlantic Ocean Road.

title: Innerdalstårnet
short_description: Towering over Innerdalen and Trollheimen
long_description:
The Innerdal tower (Tower, Dalatårnet) is possibly the most powerful and legendary peak in Trollheimen and Central Norway. As you drive up the valley from Ålvundeid, it is exciting to see the beautiful peak coming closer and closer. And on the hour-long walk from the parking lot at the end of the road in Innerdalen to the cabins Renndølsetra and Innerdalshytta you will be excited of the majestic mountain rising in front of you.
Ascending the Innerdal Tower is one day can be tiresome. Instead, spend the night at one of the wonderful cabins, Renndølsetra or Innerdalshytta.

title: Hiking around the lakes near Roșia Montană
short_description: This is a circuit meant to show you most artificial lakes around Roșia Montana, while also unveiling some of the enchanting landscapes this place, so marked by history and legends, hides.
long_description:
All lakes were built in the early 20th century to help increase the flow of streams in the area and be used by the water mills that washed the ore.
The route passes by four of the lakes: Tăul Țarinii, Tăul Mare, Tăul Anghel, and Tăul Brazi. The first is located at the highest altitude, 1000 meters, in an open space from where you can admire several traditional households, as well as the nearby Vulcan Peak from the massif of the same name.
The other lakes stand at an altitude of about 930 meters. Tăul Mare is the widest.
The circuit can be done in any season, including by those with less physical training.

title: Melen
short_description: Hike up high above the Atlantic Ocean Road
long_description:
Melen is the highest peak this close to the Atlantic Ocean Road. Reaching 768 meters above sea level, the hike to the peak is demanding, but the views out towards the ocean are spectacular.
The plateau connecting the peaks is popular with mountain bikers, providing a technical but thrilling ride. For a slightly less demanding hike in the same area, but still featuring wonderful views, see Stemshesten.

title: Vevang Coastal Trail
short_description: Discover the Transatlantic Column along the Atlantic Ocean Road
long_description:
The Vevang coastal trail is at the western end of the chain of bridges along the Atlantic Ocean Road. The short and easy-going dirt trail hides a surprise, a marble sculpture known as the Transatlantic Column. The column is in many pieces, lying amongst the rocks and in small ponds.

title: Snowshoe Trail Hospental
short_description:
Easy snowshoe trail with varied terrain and beautiful views
.
Important: Walk on the signposted snowshoe trails at your own risk. Please pay attention to the current avalanche situation and game rest zones
.
long_description: The start of the marked Hospental snowshoe trail is at Hospental railway station. From there, head west, over the railway track and the old Roman bridge. Past the shooting range and abandoned stables in the hilly terrain, you soon climb up to the small plateau above the winter hiking trail. Superb views of the villages of Hospental and Andermatt, but also of Gemsstock and Oberalp Pass. Now go back down to the farms and across striking hills, past the ventilation shaft and the old armoury.

title: Vale do Rio Claro and Crista do Galo Trail
short_description: Trail inside the National Park of Chapada dos Guimarães, which has excellent places for bathing, besides offering a 360 degrees view of the Chapada dos Guimarães walls and an incredible view.
long_description: The Chapada dos Guimarães National Park covers 33 thousand hectares and has several trails, as well as incredible natural attractions available to the public. However, it is compulsory to be accompanied by a licensed tourist guide or driver in almost all of them. <The Crista de Galo and Vale do Rio Claro trails have incredible views crystal-clear swimming pools. It is a 4km walk, where it possible to observe the diversity of cerrado vegetation, rocky formations with panoramic view Chapada's walls also refresh yourself in Pole Anta Verde, formed by Claro. The trail considered moderate due sandy stretch at beginning end trail, but rest easy.

title: Nordneset Coastal Trail
short_description: Wander the windswept coastline by Farstad Beach
long_description:
By the village of Farstad is the white sandy Farstad Beach and the beginning of the Nordneset Coastal Trail. A stroll along the beach is worth it in any weather, and a looping trail continues around the point to the north.
There are varied lodging options along the Atlantic Ocean Road, with some stunning locations available.

title: Upper Falls Trail
short_description: Tackle one of Bandelier’s most popular trails
long_description:
Though many of Bandelier National Monument’s most popular hikes are focused on ruins and history, the Falls Trail is much more about the geology and scenery. This short but steep trail descends from the Visitor Center parking lot to the Upper Falls of El Rito de Los Frijoles (“Little River of Beans”), also called Frijoles [free-HOH-lace] Creek.
The highlight of the trail is the 90-foot waterfall, which cuts through a dramatic and rugged portion of the canyon. Along the way, you’ll find tent rocks formed by volcanic eruptions 1.2 to 1.5 million years ago, evidence of human activity dating back centuries, ponderosa pine trees, many different kinds of rocks and plants, and more.

title: Snowshoe Trail Andermatt
short_description:
Very beautiful snowshoe trail in romantic terrain and wonderful views of Andermatt
.
Important: Walk on the signposted snowshoe trails at your own risk. Please pay attention to the current avalanche situation and wildlife rest zones
.
long_description: The charming circular tour starts at the Andermatt village bridge and leads past the tennis courts in the direction of Unteralp Valley to Mettlen. The turning point is on the highest hill of the tour. Don't miss taking a photo of the impressive icefall of the Gurschenbach stream. On the way back, you hike past Schützenhaus "Brunnen" and enjoy seeing Andermatt from a different perspective for once. The path back leads past the Mariahilf Chapel.

title: Tsankawi Trail
short_description: Tackle one of Bandelier’s most popular trails
long_description:
The Tsankawi [sank-ah-WEE] Trail offers visitors the chance to climb to the ruins of an ancient village the way Ancestral Tewa Pueblo people did hundreds of years ago. As you climb onto the top of the mesa to hike toward the village of Tsankawi, the sounds of the highway below quickly begin to fade and it becomes easier to imagine what life may have been like here when the village was at its height. Modern-day descendants of the Ancestral Tewa Pueblo people live in San Ildefonso Pueblo, just a few minutes’ drive to the east.
From the mesa top, you can see mountains in every direction: the volcanic Jemez Mountains, the Sangre de Cristo Mountains (Spanish for “Blood of Christ”), which extend north into Colorado, and the Sandia Mountains near Albuquerque. The Rio Grande Valley is below you.
Unlike the homes and structures you see on the Main Loop Trail in Frijoles Canyon at Bandelier, Tsankawi has not had much excavation. You will see the village as time and nature have altered it over the past 600 years, and it takes some imagination to recreate the town in your mind. But this is part of the magic of this trail. As you hike into what was once the center of the village, you can see the ruins of 275 ground-floor rooms in buildings once up to two stories high. At first, you may not notice much. But look closer and you can see the cornerstones of these buildings poking out through the bushes and grasses that have grown over them. If you crouch down on the ground and look closely by your feet, you’re bound to see sherds of pottery and maybe even bits of obsidian once used as arrowheads that have survived the elements for hundreds of years.
As you hike down from Tsankawi, you will walk through extremely narrow areas that have been carved over time by footsteps. The same volcanic tuff that lent itself so well to forming cliff dwellings in Frijoles Canyon was carved into homes here, too. Hundreds, if not thousands, of years of people walking between homes and climbing up and down from the mesa top have worn deep paths in this soft rock that’s knee-deep (and deeper) in some places. It’s important to continue to hike through these areas even though they are narrow. Shoes of today are harsher on the rock than the footwear of generations past, and walking off-trail can cause new impressions that lead to damage and erosion. In the 1990s, some parts of this trail were so badly broken in that they were waist-deep. The park filled in these areas in an attempt to repair them.
As you walk along the mesa top, you can see the effects of centuries of footprints if you look closely. It’s pock-marked with narrow foot paths.
The park suggests two hours for this trail, but when it’s not crowded you can complete it much faster unless you take lots of time to linger, crawl up and into the cavates, and contemplate history. If you’re looking for a different kind of hike, through carved rock pathways and ancient homes, this is a great trail.

title: On the South Downs Way from Eastbourne to Alfriston
short_description: The first stage of the famous South Downs Way takes you from Eastbourne over spectacular cliffs and along a tranquil river to the historic village of Alfriston.
long_description:
The start of this attractive coastal walk is at the pier of the British seaside resort of Eastbourne. First it goes out of the town and then in a constant up and down over the impressive chalk cliffs Beachy Head and Seven Sisters, always spectacular along the sea to the mouth of the Cuckmere River. From there the walk follows the valley inland to the historic village of Alfriston. Apart from the initial section in the town of Eastbourne, you always walk in the South Downs National Park, which was established in 2011.
This is the first stage of the multi-day South Downs Way, which is well signposted and stretches over a hundred miles and eight to nine day stages from Eastbourne to Winchester. While cyclists, horse riders and walkers mostly share the same path on the other stages, this section is for walkers only. Cyclists and riders take a different, less spectacular route for this part, which makes the walk all the more attractive.

images.caption: The path is very well signposted.
The mouth of the Cuckmere River.

title: Le Tour des Dents Blanches
short_description:
Le Tour des Dents Blanches est une randonnée spectaculaire qui fait le tour du massif des Dents Blanches, traversant la frontière franco-suisse.
Translate to English
long_description:
S'étendant sur près de 50 km, ce trek exigeant se réalise généralement en 4 à 5 jours, avec des dénivelés significatifs et des passages en haute montagne. Les randonneurs empruntent des sentiers variés, traversant des forêts de conifères, des prairies fleuries et des zones rocheuses, tout en profitant de vues panoramiques à couper le souffle.
Chaque étape du parcours révèle des paysages différents : des lacs alpins aux glaciers, en passant par des alpages pittoresques. Les refuges jalonnant le chemin offrent une pause bienvenue pour se reposer et savourer la cuisine locale.
En chemin, il n'est pas rare d'apercevoir des animaux sauvages, comme des bouquetins et des chamois. Cette randonnée est réservée aux marcheurs expérimentés, car elle nécessite une bonne condition physique et une certaine habitude des terrains montagneux. 
Translate to English

title: Lower Stuiben Falls
short_description: A short and easy hiking route that will take you to the foot of the lower Stuiben Falls in the Tyrol region
long_description:
This itinerary is relatively simple, short and easy and it will take you to the foot of the chain of stunning Stuiben Falls, also a few more meters of walking will lead you to an observation path of the falls from above. Those who want to continue beyond that (definitely worthwhile) can continue to continue to the next section that goes up towards the Upper Stuiben Fall (not accessible for strollers).
This section is suitable for walking even with strollers.
Click here to view the route that groups all the segments of the trip .

title: From Ettensberg to Gunzesried, Blaichach and back
short_description: With this circular walk you have a good view of the mountains and in addition partly a beautiful nature trail.
long_description: You have a beautiful view of the mountains on this adventurous circular hiking trail. At the same time, you also have a beautiful nature trail from Gunzesried back to Blaichach. Normally, this trail can be used in winter as well as in summer. On the way there, you can also stop off at the Sennalpe Derb for a snack. However, this is not open all year round.

title: Walking route Utrechtse Heuvelrug
short_description: During this route you will discover the northern side of the Utrechtse Heuvelrug. The route is about 30 kilometres. So you will be on the road for a while, but the route is definitely worthwhile.
long_description:
The Utrechtse Heuvelrug is a national park, and for good reason, of course. The area has existed for centuries and is a place of relaxation for many people. Nature there is beautiful. You will find ancient forests, moors and fens. Besides the wonderful nature, you will also find many special animals. For example, badgers and deer live here. 
.

title: Sendero agua y vida - through the high Páramo to the hot springs
short_description: A stunning day hike among the wide, open páramo, pristine mountain lakes, impressive waterfalls, and a wild river down to the famous hot springs of Papallacta.
long_description: Thanks to the high starting point at the mountain pass "Virgen del Páramo de Papallacta", this rewarding day hike takes you deep into the Andean highlands above 4,000 meters without having to cover any major ascents. Stunning views of the snow-covered volcanoes Antisana, Cotopaxi, and the two Illinizas alternate with those of wild lagunas, bizarre rock formations, and vast high plateaus. The hike itself is not very diffcult, although recent rainfalls can make the path soggy and slippery at times. The long descend down to Papallacta includes a section along the wild mountain river Río Papallacta that should not be skipped. At the end of the trail, the famous hot springs of Papallacta await you - so bring your swimwear! Surely one of the most varied and beautiful day trips into the high Andeas near the Ecuadorian capital and, thanks to the few meters of ascent, a great acclimatization tour for those who have only just arrived in Quito.

images.caption: The mighty volcano Antisana behind a nameless laguna near the Antenas de Papallacta
Trail in the Páramo near Antenas de Papallacta
Trail in the Páramo above Papallacta
The Iliniza twin volcanoes in the distance

title: Kvitskriuprestinn Natural Monument
short_description: Moraine pyramids more than 6 meter tall
long_description:
Kvitskriuprestinn is one of nature's little wonders. These 6-meter tall moraine formations are slowly washed away by the rain. The rock at the top of the pyramid serves as a protection against rain and erosion. 
The pyramid formations at Kvitskriuprestinn can only be found here in all of Northern Europe and the current pyramids are estimated be between 100 and 200 years old.

title: Dørålseter to Bjørnhollia
short_description: Stage 3 of the Rondane Triangle
long_description:
This route is stage 3 of the full Rondane Triangle hike. Stage 4 is from Dørålseter to Bjørnhollia.
Bjørnhollia is where you can stay at the end of this days hike. The cabin is situated just below the treeline and has 90 beds.

images.caption: The eastern end of the Langglupdalen valley

title: Høgronden
short_description: Hike up high for views of three national parks
long_description:
“Høg” means high in Norwegian, and as the name suggests, Høgronden (2,115 m.a.s.l.) is one of the highest mountains of the Rondane Mountain Range. From the top, you’ll experience wide-ranging views of no less than three national parks: Rondane, Dovrefjell, and Jotunheimen.
The trail begins from Strømbu rest stop and is well-marked. Because of its length and considerable elevation gain, this is a very demanding hike. As you pass the tree line, the terrain becomes increasingly steep and rocky, so be sure to wear proper hiking boots. Check the forecast before heading out, and do not undertake the hike in harsh weather.
Offering cabin and campsite rental, Rondetunet Outdoor Activity Center is the perfect starting point for outdoor adventures, which in addition to hiking, includes fishing and canoe paddling. The main buildings include a café as well as a shop selling equipment for outdoor activities.
Rondane Gjestegård is a small charming inn offering hotel and cabin accommodation, as well as cozy communal areas for relaxation. Their restaurant serves locally sourced breakfast and dinner.
With its location south in Rondane, Bjørnhollia DNT Cabin is a great place to stay if wanting to explore the national park. The cabin is staffed during spring and summer and serves as a self-service cabin for the rest of the year. To make a booking, contact the cabin by sending an e-mail to bjornhollia@turistforeningen.no.

title: Ulafossen
short_description: Get close to the Ulafossen waterfall
long_description:
When you travel to Rondane National Park through Mysusæter it is hard not to be amazed by the Ulafossen waterfall plunging down from the national park itself. The waterfall has multiple falls, but the main fall is about 50 meters high.
Hike up and along the waterfall to see it up close. 
Rondane Hotel is the best and nearest accommodation for this adventure.

title: Ås til Åsleden - Hålebäck to Krika Skog
short_description: The second stage of the Ås til Åsledens goes from Hålebäck to Krika Skog.
long_description: We continue along the Söderåsen mountain range, first on flat gravel paths, then uphill on narrower paths to a plateau. Maglaby is a so-called row village, as they were often found in Sweden in the past. The houses and the surrounding farmland and pastures are arranged in rows.

title: कलसुबाई पीक ट्रैक
short_description: भारत के महाराष्ट्र राज्य में पश्चिमी घाट में स्थित कलसुबाई पर्वत शिखर 5400 फ़ीट ऊँची चोटी हैं जो की महाराष्ट्र का सबसे ऊँचा स्थान भी है।
long_description:
कलसुबाई पर्वत श्रृंखला कल्सुबाई हरिश्चंद्रगढ़ वन्यजीव अभयारण्य के अंदर स्थित है। यहाँ पूरे साल ट्रैकर्स, टूरिस्टों, तीर्थयात्रियों, और वन्यजीव पसंद करने वाले लोगों का ताँता लगा रहता है। आमतौर पर यह माना जाता है कि इस पर्वत चोटी का नाम कल्सुबाई नाम की एक कुलीन महिला के नाम पर रखा गया है जो तीन बहनों में एक थी- बाकी दो बहने रत्नाबाई (जिसके नाम पर रत्नागढ़ पर्वत चोटी का नाम पड़ा) और कटराबाई (जिसके नाम पर कटराबाई पर्वत चोटी का नाम पड़ा) थी।
कलसुबाई शिखर तक पहुंचने के लिए दो मुख्य ट्रैकिंग मार्ग हैं -
बारी गाँव वाला ट्रैकिंग मार्ग
इंदोरे वाला ट्रैकिंग मार्ग (ध्यान दे - यह मध्य प्रदेश का इंदौर शहर नहीं है)
बारी गाँव के बेस-कैंप वाला हाइकिंग मार्ग लोगों द्वारा ज्यादा पसंद किया जाता है। यह मार्ग गांव बारी से शुरू होकर पर्वत के पूर्व-मुखी हिस्से से होकर जाता है। इस मार्ग में आसान से कठिन चढ़ाई के अलावा चट्टानी ऑउटक्रॉप्स मिलते हैं। हालिया सालों में हाइकर्स की बढ़ती संख्या को देखते हुए महाराष्ट्र पर्यटन विभाग ने खड़ी पहाड़ी ढलानों पर लोहे की सीढ़ियाँ बनाई है जिनसे हाइकर्स को सुविधा और सुरक्षा मिलती है।
दूसरा ट्रैकिंग मार्ग इंदोरे से आता है। यह ट्रैकिंग मार्ग ज्यादा लोकप्रिय नहीं है क्योंकि ज्यादातर लोगों को इसके बारे में पता नहीं है। यह रास्ता कठिन भी है और इसका रखरखाव भी बहुत कम या नहीं के बराबर है।

title: Veslesmeden
short_description: Rondane's most accessible peak
long_description:
Veslesmeden is perhaps the most accessible peak in Rondane. The hike to the top is fairly easy as it gradually climbs up from Rondvassbu to the peak itself. Except for at the very top, there are no steep cliffs or dangerous sections along the trail.
Rondvassbu is an excellent place to stay a night or two when you are in this area. Rondvassbu is a staffed cabin by The Norwegian Trekking Association (DNT).  You can also stay at Rondane Hotell at Mysusæter.

title: Bjørnhollia
short_description: Visit a tourist cabin at the edge of Rondane National Park
long_description:
Trek to Bjørnhollia DNT cabin for a moderate hike into the edge Rondane National Park. Make it a day trip with a stop at the cabin to enjoy a packed lunch, or stay overnight and explore the park further. Possible destinations from Bjørnhollia include Skjerdalen and Rondeslottet or the round-trip Rondane Triangle.
You can also cycle to Bjørnhollia along an alternate route, a gravel road from Gammelgarden.
The cabin is staffed from 19th July to 13th September 2020.
With its location south in Rondane, Bjørnhollia DNT Cabin is a great place to stay if wanting to explore the national park. The cabin is staffed during summer and serves as a self-service cabin for the rest of the year. To make a booking, contact the cabin by sending an e-mail to bjornhollia@turistforeningen.no.

title: Vardhøe
short_description: Nice loop from the heart of Høvringen in Rondane NP
long_description:
The hike to Vardhøe is a nice loop from Høvringen and up on the nearest mountain near Øigardseter Mountain Lodge. It can be accomplished by most hikers, even small children. If you hike up in the late afternoon you can catch the sunset from here as well. 
Høvringen has multiple offerings for accommodation

title: Waterfalls Trail in the Engordador Nucleus of the Cantareira Park
short_description: Beautiful trail located in the Engordador area of the Cantareira State Park, in the north of the city of S São Paulo.
long_description:
The trail is only 4km long (round trip) and well signposted, and can be done without the presence of a guide. The place é a true natural refuge, a large preserved area of Atlantic Forest, located in the middle of the metropolitan region of SP. The trail passes by the beautiful Engordador Dam, three waterfalls and the Casa da Bomba, a historic construction that was inaugurated in 1907 to pump water from the Engordador River to the city of São Paulo. Nowadays, it is possible to visit the site, which still has the old boiler and the steam and diesel machinery.
The Núcleo do Engordador was the second núcleo of the Cantareira State Park opened for visitção pública, in 1992. The Park offers good infrastructure with parking, toilets, ápicnic areas, playground, a Visitor Center.

title: Wild forest tour around Красная Поляна (Krasnaya Polyana) in Sochi National Park
short_description: Beautiful forest with various panorama views.
long_description: Going up, the second half gets a bit wild. It is advisable to announce your presence with some noises or chants, in the altitude range from 1000m to 1300m. This prevents surprises. Don't overstay in those places either, no need to annoy the "owner". Going down, there is an excellent picnic place at 1425m with amazing views over the whole valley. Then a steep path takes you through a forest with a few rocky promontories. Alternatively you can stay on the comfortable forest road, and/or pay a visit to the Keyva waterfall nearby.

images.caption: Wild forest tour around Красная Поляна (Krasnaya Polyana) in Sochi National Park

title: Knappen
short_description: Experience sweeping views of Atnasjøen Lake and Rondane National Park
long_description:
Hiking to the top of Knappen Mountain allows you to experience far-reaching views without too much effort. Upon passing the tree line and reaching the top, you’ll see Atnasjøen Lake in the north, with the mountains of Rondane National Park to the west of the lake and Gravskardhøgda to the east of the lake.
The well-marked trail travels gradually uphill to the top, with plenty of opportunities to lie down and take a break in the soft reindeer moss along the way.  
Offering cabin and campsite rental, Rondetunet Outdoor Activity Center is the perfect starting point for outdoor adventures, which in addition to hiking, includes fishing and canoe paddling. The main buildings include a café as well as a shop selling equipment for outdoor activities.
Rondane Gjestegård is a small charming inn offering hotel and cabin accommodation, as well as cozy communal areas for relaxation. Their restaurant serves locally sourced breakfast and dinner.

title: Waterfalls Circuit
short_description: One of the most recommended tours in the Chapada dos Guimarães National Park, full of fantastic landscapes, breathtaking viewpoints and waterfalls that invite you to take a bath.
long_description:
<The route has about 6,5km and passes by six waterfalls: 7 de Setembro, Pulo, Degraus, Prainha, Andorinhas Independecirc;ncia. Between Prainha waterfalls there are two incredible natural pools the whole circuit is free for bathing, except Independecircence Waterfall, also known as Crazy People Waterfall. On way back, it worth stopping at rock formation Casa Pedra (Stone House), with inscriptions. 
The trail is quite open, with low vegetation, not offering much shade along the way. So do not forget your cap and sunscreen. Só é possible to do the trails with an authorized guide  who needs to give official entry into the National Park of Chapada dos Guimarães. The trail lasts all day, so reserve a full day to do it.

title: Vinjeronden
short_description: Rondslottet's little brother
long_description:
Most people visit Vinjeronden on their way to the highest peak in Rondane, Rondslottet. However, Vinjeronden is worthy of a visit all by itself. The peak itself is nestled between Rondslottet and Storronden and gives you great views of these peaks and the surrounding areas. 
The last part of the hike up to the peak is a bit steep, but the very top is very flat and a great place to enjoy the view. 
Rondvassbu is an excellent place to stay a night or two when you are in this area. Rondvassbu is a staffed cabin by The Norwegian Trekking Association (DNT).  You can also stay at Rondane Hotell at Mysusæter.
