title: संकरी-केदारकंठा ट्रैक
short_description: उत्तराखंड के उत्तरकाशी जिले के गोविंद वन्यजीव अभयारण्य में 12500 फीट की ऊंचाई पर स्थित केदारकंठा शिखर, गढ ़वाल हिमालय की एक भव्य पर्वत चोटी और हाईकिंग का एक शानदार गंतव्य है ।
long_description:
केदारकंठा ट्रैक भारत के सबसे लोकप्रिय हिमालयी मार्गों में से एक है जो अनुभवी और नौसिखिया दोनों किस्म के हाइकर्स को बहुत पसंद आता है। यह और चद्रशिला शिखर ट्रैक संग मिलकर यह उत्तराखंड राज्य के दो सबसे सुहावने पर्वत शिखर ट्रैक की जोड़ी बनाते है।
केदारकंठा ट्रैक देवदार, ओक, बाँझ, और बुरांश के जंगलों से होकर गुजरता है और केदारकंठा की बर्फीली छोटी पर समाप्त होता है। बहुत ध्यान से यह ज़रूर समझ लें की केदारकंठा एक शिखर ट्रैक है जो की केदारनाथ के तीर्थयात्रा ट्रैक से बिल्कुल अलग है। इस बारे में भ्रम की कोई गुंजाईश ना रखें।
सांकरी गांव इस ट्रैक का बेस कैंप है और केदारकंठा चोटी वहां से करीब 10 किलोमीटर दूर है। लगभग 2 किलोमीटर के बाद इस ट्रेल पर 'जुडा का तालाब' की तरफ जाने वाली ट्रेल भी निकलती है जो बाद में बहुत आगे जाकर आखिरकार फिर से केदारकंठा वाली ट्रेल में मिल जाती है। हमने यहाँ 'जुडा का तालाब' जाने के लिए लिए एक अलग ट्रैकिंग मार्ग बनाया है।
केदारकंठा की ट्रेल पर कई आश्रय स्थल (कुटिया/झोपडी/शेड) मौजूद हैं जहां इस बहु-दिवसीय दौरे के दौरान रात बितानी चाहिए। शिखर के शीर्ष पर भी एक शिविर स्थल है जहाँ पर तम्बू लगा कर हाइकर्स आराम से रात बिता सकते हैं और सुबह का शानदार सूर्योदय भी देख सकते हैं। अगर पर्वत शिखर पर रात गुजारनी की इच्छा नहीं हो तो फिर नीचे उतरकर ट्रेल मार्ग में थोड़ी दूर स्थित आश्रय स्थान (कुटिया/झोपडी/शेड) में रात गुजारी जा सकती है।

images.caption: मेराकी होमस्टे हाइकर्स और परिवारों के बीच संकरी गांव में  रुकने की पसंदीदा जगह है। उत्तरकाशी, उत्तरांचल। भारत
केदारकंठा ट्रेल मार्ग पर गर्मियों की रात में अकेला तंबू, उत्तरकाशी, उत्तराखंड, भारत।

शीतकालीन मौसम में बर्फ से ढकी केदारकंठा चोटी पर पहुँचते हुए हाइकर्स, उत्तरांचल, भारत।

title: On the European Long Distance Trail E3 through Belgium
short_description: On the Belgian stage of the European Long Distance Trail E3, you hike from Martelingen via Habay-la-Neuve, Anlier, Marbehan, Chassepierre, Saint-Cécile, Bouillon, Alle and Membres to Les Hautes-Rivières.
long_description: The European Long Distance Trail E3 runs for several thousand kilometres from the Black Sea through Central and Western Europe to the Iberian Peninsula. Not all parts of the trail have already been completed and marked. The route is planned to start in Turkey and run through Bulgaria, Serbia, Romania, Hungary, Slovakia, Poland, the Czech Republic, Germany, Luxembourg, Belgium, France and Spain to Portugal.

title: Moulin de Vertain circuit
short_description: A year-round walk to explore the Templeuve countryside.
long_description:
The station is the starting point. In wet weather, waterproof footwear is recommended, as there are farm tracks and wetlands along the way.
The Moulin de Vertain, or Moulin Blanc, is a unique windmill in Templeuve-en-Pévèle, northern France. Built in the late 15th century and now restored, it resembles a tower mill but operates as a post mill.

title: Fuglesteg
short_description: Visit a traditional farmhouse perched above the scenic Fortun Valley
long_description:
Sitting 630 meters above the green Fortun Valley, Fuglesteg is a wooden and stone farmhouse dating back to the mid-seventeenth century. The farm was abandoned and later destroyed by a fire, but in 2004 it was rebuilt and turned into an unstaffed DNT cabin. With its scenic location, it’s now a popular place to spend the night—within a year after its opening the old farmhouse had more than 2,000 visitors.
With an elevation gain of 600 meters, the final part being particularly steep, the hike to Fuglesteg is demanding. However, there are benches and tables along the way, so you’ll be able to have a rest and soak up the magnificent views. The trail runs through a lush landscape and is excellent for birdwatching.
Although the trail is open all-year-round, it can get icy, and there may be a danger of avalanches during the winter months. 
Fuglesteg is an unstaffed DNT cabin with 31 beds, open from May through October. Bring food and a sleeping bag to use the cabin, as well as a DNT key to access it. However, if you’re not a DNT member, but interested in staying at the cabin, contact Stein Bugge Næss (Luster Fjordhytter), tel. +47 57 68 65 00.
Another option is Turtagrø Hotel, which is located alongside Road 55, about 10 kilometers northeast of Fortun. It dates back to the 1880s but was recently renovated. They serve breakfast, lunch, and three-course dinners. Campsite rental is also available, which includes access to showers, toilets, and a common area. The Lodge is open between Easter and mid-September.

title: Fannaråken
short_description: Witness a magnificent sunrise or sunset at 2,068 meters above sea level
long_description:
Fannaråken is known as one of the most classic routes in Jotunheimen. Reaching the top, you’ll be surrounded by highlights such as the Hurrungane mountain range, and the Smørstab and Jostedal glaciers. Stay at Fannaråkhytta, the Norwegian Trekking Association’s (DNT) highest cabin at 2,068 meters above sea level, and witness a stunning sunset and sunrise over the mountains.
The hike is challenging as parts of the trail are steep and jagged, but the perk is that you’ll be enjoying spectacular views the entire way.
This mountain is known by several names: Fannaråken, Fanaråken, Fannråki—the list goes on. However, DNT’s official name is Fannaråken.
Stay at Fannaråkhytta, a traditional DNT staffed lodge dating back to 1934. The lodge is open in summer, serving hearty three-course Norwegian dinners every day. The best part about staying here is that you can watch the sunrise or sunset with a 360-degree view. Make sure to book a bed in advance as there are only 32 beds. 
If you prefer to hike up and down Fannaråken the same day, or would like to stay in the area before hiking, stay at Turtagrø Hotel. It dates back to the 1880s but was recently renovated. They serve breakfast, lunch, and three-course dinners. Campsite rental is also available, which includes access to showers, toilets, and a common area. The lodge is open between Easter and mid-September.

title: Agur Waterfalls and Prometheus Rock
short_description: Agur Waterfalls – a scenic trail near Sochi. Here: A 3-4 hour hike along a natural forest trail will add colour to a seaside holiday.
long_description: Southern Russia, Black Sea coast, resort city – Sochi and a hike along the trail «Agur Waterfalls and Eagle Rocks». South of Sochi, a 10 km long river with a woman's name, the Agura, flows into the Black Sea. Our route «Agura Lakes» runs along this river. The trail was put in order and for general hiking purposes by workers of Sochi Mountain Club as far back as 1911. The river gives us viewing platforms, from which you can see and hear three waterfalls, one of which is up to 30 metres high. Also along the route further on, one encounters «Rock Prometheus» at Eagle Rocks. It is not yet clear what legends have brought Prometheus to the Sochi region.

title: Mirante da Janela Trail in the Chapada dos Veadeiros
short_description: The Mirante da Janela trail passes through the outskirts of the Chapada dos Veadeiros National Park and takes you to a natural belvedere with one of the most beautiful sceneries in the region.
long_description: The Mirante é a beautiful natural window, formed by stones that frame the impressive 120 meters high waterfall of the Chapada dos Veadeiros National Park. In rainy periods, it is possible to bathe in the Abyss Waterfall. The car park and the starting point of the trail to reach the Mirador are located on a private property, so an entrance fee is required. The trail is well signposted, has about 8 kilometres and does not require a guide. Well frequented during weekends and holidays, try to do the route on weekdays.

images.caption: Mirante da Janela na Chapada dos Veadeiros, Goiás - Brasil
Mirante da Janela na Chapada dos Veadeiros, Goiás - Brasil

title: Macuco Trail in Cantareira Park
short_description: Easy trail, great for children, in the Engordador area of Cantareira State Park, in the north of the city of São Paulo;
long_description:
The trail is only 1.8km long (round trip) and well signposted, and can be done without the presence of a guide. The place is a true natural refuge, a large preserved area of Atlantic Forest, located in the middle of the metropolitan region of São Paulo. The trail is very quiet and passes by the beautiful Engordador Dam and the "Casa da Bomba", a historic construction that was inaugurated in 1907 with the purpose of pumping water from the Engordador River to the city of São Paulo. Nowadays, it is possible to visit the site, which still has the old boiler and the steam and diesel machinery.
The Núcleo do Engordador was the second núcleo of the Cantareira State Park opened for visitção pública, in 1992. The Park offers good infrastructure with parking, toilets, ápicnic areas, playground, a Visitor Center.

Represa no Núcleo Engordador do Parque Estadual da Cantareira, São Paulo - Brasil
Represa no Núcleo Engordador do Parque Estadual da Cantareira, São Paulo - Brasil

title: Through the cooling
short_description: From Kühlungsborn we hike almost 14 km through the idyllic landscape of the Kühlung. Restful tranquillity, the scent of the forest air, unspoilt paths and beautiful views await us time and again.

images.caption: View of the pier in Kühlungsborn.

title: Around the Thanninger Weiher
short_description: We experience an entertaining, very varied tour.
long_description: We first walk through the village of Thanning, then follow a path through meadows and fields, cross a section of forest to the Thanninger Weihern and walk along the three ponds back to Thanning.

images.caption: Ivy on the church tower in Thanning.
Path down to the Thanninger Weiher pond at the back.
Wet meadow at the back of the Thanninger Weiher.
Cross at the church in Thanning.

title: Köprülü Canyon National Park
short_description: This route in the Köprülü Canyon National Park, which is located within the borders of Antalya province and is flooded by local and foreign tourists every year, must be tried
long_description:
There is no one who has not heard of Köprülü Canyon National Park. Even if you have not heard of it, you have definitely seen photos of it and you have travelled to be there. In this park, which cannot be described in words, you can realise wonderful nature walks and admire the blessings of nature once again.
This route through the Köprülü Canyon National Park is one of the unique routes you can try in this region. The route reveals so many beautiful görüntüntüs that you will be waiting for the time to come here again. The route starts from Perge Nature Houses. This is also a facility worth seeing. Starting from here, the route takes us and we firstly walk along the long canyon. On the route, you come across many places for rafting etc. activities. After leaving Büğrüm Köprüsü behind you, you take a full tour on a circular line. 
After taking a full tour and taking great photos, you can walk back along the route where the facilities are located and the route ends again at Perge Nature Houses.

title: Andreas Canyon Trail
short_description: The parking lot and picnic area in the Indian Canyons nature preserve are surrounded by hundreds of palm trees, as is much of the easy and scenic Andreas Canyon Trail.
long_description:
Andreas Canyon is one of the more popular routes in this region, home to the world’s second-largest California Fan Palm oasis . The first section of the trail runs along the Andreas Creek, while the second half takes you up a gentle sloping hill to look down on the palms tucked into the rocky landscape.
ndian Canyons in Palm Springs consists of Palm Canyon, Andreas Canyon and Murray Canyon. Palm Canyon offers hikers a moderately graded foot path that leads down to a stream perfect for picnicking. Be sure to visit the Trading Post for hiking maps, refreshments and souvenirs. Andreas Canyon offers a more serene, scenic route perfect for photography and bird watching. Murray Canyon is an easy to moderate hike boasting abundant wildlife encounters and is less visited, so tends to be more secluded. Indian Canyons is open daily from October through June and weekends only July through September.

images.caption: hiking trail in California: Andreas Canyon Trail

title: Randonnée à la découverte des aiguilles de Valbelle
short_description:
Au départ de la Chartreuse, sillonnez la magnifique forêt domaniale de Morières-Montrieux et partez à la conquête des mystérieuses aiguilles de Valbelle !
Translate to English
long_description:
Autour de la chartreuse de Montrieux-le-Jeune, où reigne le calme et le ressourcement, l’érosion a donné naissance aux superbes aiguilles de Valbelle.
Se dressant au milieu d’un vallon, ces pierres rocheuses attirent la curiosité des randonneurs. Résultant des effets du vent, de la pluie et du froid, elles sont considérées comme de beaux témoins des transformations géologiques millénaires.
 Translate to English

title: Yaroslavl's first church - The Church of Elijah the Prophet
short_description: Yaroslavl is an important pivot of Russia's Golden Ring, and the Temple of Elijah the Prophet  is an important pivot in Yaroslavl.
long_description:
It is known that Yaroslav the Wise fought a bear and defeated the powerful predator of the forest. And the legend says that the day on which the battle between the man and the animal took place was the day of Elijah the Prophet. In honour of the victory they named the church in Yaroslavl after Elijah the Prophet. This church was the first at that time, now it is impossible to count churches in Yaroslavl thousands of years old on the fingers. But the main and central church is still the Church of Elijah the Prophet.
  Our walking route leads to a significant temple in the city, and it begins nowhere else than on Ushinsky Street at the monument and public garden of Peter and Fevronia. All hiking is desirable in love and care for each other, or without, but in the same greater love, both for people and nature, or for yourself – as a greater friend. And on the way back on the route we will look into another not insignificant church – the Church of Michael the Archangel, and return again to Ushinsky Street to Peter and Fevronia for further instructions.
The church of Michael the Archangel is the most important church in the world.

images.caption: Church of Elijah the Prophet, Yaroslavl
Church of St Michael the Archangel, Yaroslavl

title: The Prelate's Way
short_description: Birnau, Salem and the Affenberg - these three attractions of the Lake Constance area are on our way during this walking tour.
long_description: Three attractions of the Lake Constance region are on our way: From the pilgrimage church of Birnau we walk along the Prälatenweg to Salem Castle and the Affenberg. Via Mendlishausen we finally hike back to Birnau via the Prälatenweg.

title: Harzer-Hexen-Stieg
short_description: The fairytale-like, mystical world of the Harz can best be explored on the Harzer-Hexen-Stieg. The legendary Brocken is just one of the many highlights of this exciting long-distance hiking trail that crosses the Harz National Park.
long_description: But it is not only friends of fairy tales and legends who get their money's worth here. The „enchanting“ Harz landscape also delights nature lovers and pleasure hikers. The Harzer-Hexen-Stieg (Harz Witches' Trail) combines themes from nature, geology, history and culture to create an exciting cross-section of Germany's northernmost low mountain range. Green mixed and coniferous forests, rocky gorges and steeply rising cliffs, millennia-old moors and medieval half-timbered towns lie along the way. Evidence of more than a thousand years of mining history can be found at every turn. For example, the narrow footpaths of the „Oberharzer Wasserregal“, a water collection system built in the 16th –18th century for mining. The Harzer-Hexen-Stieg (Harz Witches' Trail) leads from Osterode in the west to Thale in the east, but of course it can also be done the other way round. The trail splits at two points and allows for different route variants.

images.caption: Soon the water from the iron spring bubbles vigorously and colours the stones of the stream bed brown due to the iron content.
The Great Peat Bog with its unspoilt landscape is the highlight of our tour.

title: Bicycle tour to Bilpudi Waterfalls
short_description: This is a beautiful seasonal tour with a mix of road cycling, trail cycling, and hiking. A perfect trip to enjoy the monsoon season.
long_description:
बिलपुडी साइकिल दौरा गुजरात के वलसाड जिले के धर्मपुर शहर के बस डिपो से शुरू होकर बिलपुडी मंदिर और बिलपुडी झरने तक जाता है। इस ट्रैक का शुरुआती हिस्सा साइकिलिंग और अंतिम चरण पैदल चल के पूरा होता है यानी की यह मिक्स प्रकार की आउट-एंड-बैक ट्रेल है। मार्ग एकतरफ़ा 7 किलोमीटर और दोतरफा आना-जाना मिलाकर 14 किलोमीटर लम्बा है।
ट्रेल शुरुआती 5.5 किलोमीटर तक लगभग समतल है। ट्रेल का यह पूरा हिस्सा डामर वाली सड़क पर पड़ता है और साइकिलिंग के लिए बहुत अच्छा है। इसके बाद बाकी बची 1.5 किलोमीटर की ट्रेल हलकी चढ़ाई वाली है। यहाँ से हाईकिंग भी शुरू होती है जो की कच्चे रास्ते, घास, और अंत में चट्टानी इलाके से होकर झरने तक पहुँचती है।झरना मानसून के दौरान बहुत सुन्दर लगता है और इसलिए यह ट्रैक खास तौर पर एक मानसून ट्रैक की श्रेणी में आता है।

images.caption: वलसाड ज़िले के धरमपुर शहर में बिलपुडी मंदिर से बिलपुडी जलप्रपात की ट्रेल, गुजरात, भारत।
वलसाड जिले के बिलपुडी झरने से कुछ दूर स्थित हरीभरी बिलपुडी पहाड़ियाँ, गुजरात, भारत।
वलसाड जिले के धरमपुर शहर के लोकप्रिय बिलपुडी झरना का दृश्य, गुजरात, भारत।
भारत में साइकिल दौरे: बिलपुडी झरने का साइकिल दौरा

title: From Starnberg via Andechs to Herrsching
short_description: On this tour we roam through the lovely hilly landscape between Starnberg and Herrsching. The highlight is a visit to Andechs Monastery.
long_description: First we visit the Bavarian State Institute for Fisheries before we hike through the valley of the Maisinger Bach. In the Maisinger Gorge we get more detailed information on numerous boards, e.g. on geology. We visit the nature reserve around Lake Maising. Over the hills, past the Rothenfeld correctional facility, we reach Andechs Monastery. During the descent through the Kiental to Herrsching, numerous information boards provide further information.

images.caption: House on Weilheimer Straße in Starnberg...
Brook on the Seven Springs Trail.
The Maisinger Bach stream in Starnberg.
Maisinger Bach in the Maisinger Gorge
The Maisinger Bach in the gorge.
The Maisinger Bach in the gorge.

title: Circular hike from the Alpe di Siusi to the Schlernhaus
short_description: Long but easy circular tour from the Alpe di Siusi via the Mahlknechthütte and the Tierser-Alpl-Hütte below the Rosszähne to the Schlernhaus.
long_description: From Europe's largest high alpine pasture, the Alpe di Siusi, this hike takes us into the Schlern-Rosengarten Nature Park. On wide paths along picturesque alpine meadows we first hike to the Mahlknechthütte. Then we head up to the modern but cosy Tierser-Alpl-Hütte, which lies directly below the jagged rocky peaks of the Rosszähne. From here we hike on to the Schlernhaus. The hut is located on the green south-eastern slopes of the Schlern plateau and offers a well-deserved stop and a fantastic view over the nature park in the middle of the Dolomites. Afterwards, we return to the Alpe di Siusi via the rustic Saltner Hut.

title: Jogging around the Niedersonthofen Lake
short_description: Once around the Niedersonthofener See lake: the jogging circuit offers beautiful views of the water and the Allgäu mountain peaks to the south.
long_description: With the Niedersonthofener See lake always in view, we run a beautiful loop here, mostly on pleasant gravel paths. The gradients are easy, the nature around the lake beautiful in every season. Past the "Insel Campingplatz" (island camping site), we pass the pretty white Schutzengelkapelle (guardian angel chapel) before passing between Mitterinselsee and Oberinselsee. Nearby, the jogger enjoys the view of rocking small boats in the shallow water; here is the small boat harbour of the Oberinselsee. After a slight climb, we are rewarded with the great panoramic view over the lake towards the southwest. The south side of Niedersonthofener See is forested: Here we enjoy a run directly along the water through the woods.

title: On the Bremmer Calmont
short_description: This challenging day hike takes us across Europe's steepest vineyard to the Roman tombs of Nehren. We return along the other bank of the Moselle.
long_description: Europe's steepest Wienberg, the 378 m high Bremmer Calmont, offers a magnificent view of the Moselle loop. In the course of the hike we encounter Roman temples and enjoy the rich flora and fanua in the Moselle meadows.

title: Drafted on May 17, 2021
short_description: Walk near Welzheim with a beautiful panoramic view, through the Swabian-Franconian Nature Park
long_description: The path runs across fields, through small sparse woods and offers a wonderful panoramic view. In good weather, you can see as far as the Schäbische Alb. Large parts of the tour are on tarmac or gravel paths. A small section leads over a wide path through the forest and can be muddy. This is not really suitable for prams.

title: La Rhune loop from Ascain via the Miramar ridge
short_description: The itinerary allows you to make a relatively original loop with passage on the Miramar crests and the Ihizelai plateau. The views are magnificent. A must do.
long_description:
No time to warm up, we go straight up on a sandy path in the rocks then join the main track.
At the exit of the 1st path in épingle, do not miss the path that climbs on the right. It continues to climb quite steeply. The view of Saint-Jean-de-Luz and the Nivelle river unfolds on your right.
You pass piles of rocks in the shape of slats and the célèbres pottoks grazing quietly. Arriving on the ridge, we walk along the cliffs, with always striking views.
The path joins the mountain of the same name.
The path joins the main climb to the summit at the Ihizelai plateau, with its surprisingly isolated trees that provide welcome shade in the summer.
Then the final climb through the scree is followed, with the option of following the path always marked in yellow or cutting off as you wish, all paths leading more or less to the clearly visible goal. The climb is relatively physical and technical.
At the top, you join the rails of the Rhune train and at the top you can enjoy a breathtaking 360° view of the French and Spanish mountains and hills.
<A small variation on the way back allows you to enjoy magnificent plateau a little more.

images.caption: Rails of the little train going up to the top of the Rhune

title: Erlebnisreiches Alpenhopping über Juget und Siedelalpe am Alpsee
short_description:
Tourstart in Bühl am Alpsee. Dann weiter über Wald und Wiesenwege hinauf zu der Siedelalpe, weiter zur Jugetalpe und schlussendlich wieder bergab Richtung Alpe Schönesreuth und Alpsee.
Translate to English
long_description:
Die Wanderung beginnt im charmanten Bühl am Alpsee und führt über idyllische Wald- und Wiesenwege hinauf zur Siedelalpe. Dieser erste Anstieg bietet eine wunderbare Gelegenheit, die Ruhe und Schönheit der ländlichen Gegend des Allgäus zu genießen. Die Siedelalpe, ein beliebtes Ausflugsziel, ist bekannt für ihre urige Atmosphäre und köstliche Brotzeiten, die Wanderer zu einer Rast einladen. Der kurze Abstecher zur Jugetalpe lohnt sich, da man auf dem Weg herrliche Ausblicke auf die Allgäuer Alpen hat. Hier kann man die frische Bergluft genießen und ergattert sogar den ein oder anderen Blick auf den unten liegenden Aplsee.  Nach einem etwas steileren Abstieg erreicht man die Alpe Schönesreuth. Der letzte Abschnitt der Tour führt entlang der Alpsee Promenade zurück nach Bühl. Hier bietet es sich an, einen Sprung ins kühle Nass des Alpsees zu wagen. Der Alpsee ist zudem ein beliebtes Ziel für Wassersportler und Naturliebhaber. Der Weg Richtung Bahnhof folgt einem schönen Flusslauf.
Translate to English

images.caption: Ländliche Gegend beim Aufstieg Richtung Juget Alpe
...in der Ferne sieht man schon die Siedelalpe

title: Parco di Brenno
short_description: Walk inside the Parco di Brenno, past Baggero and Costa Masnaga
long_description: The short hike is very easy to walk and suitable for families with children. Inside the park there are large green spaces and some playgrounds. A large part of the trail is in the shade, as it runs through an extensive wooded area with many boutiques. This makes the tour recommendable even on hot summer days.

title: Wanderung zum Shucto Canyon
short_description:
Der Shucto Canyon befindet sich im Bezirk Canchayllo, Jauja in Junín. Diese unglaubliche Touristenattraktion ist eine Felsformation, die über Millionen von Jahren durch die Erosion des Flusses Piñascocha entstanden ist und beeindruckende Wände von bis zu 60 Metern Höhe aufweist. Der Shucto Canyon liegt im Landschaftsschutzgebiet Nor Yauyos-Cochas.
Translate to English
long_description:
Die Wanderung beginnt im Dorf Canchayllo. Es gibt geführte Touren, die von der Stadt Huancayo aus als Ganztagestour angeboten werden. Die Fahrzeuge fahren direkt in die Schlucht hinein, so dass du etwa 2 bis 3 km der Strecke zurücklegen kannst. In meinem Fall entschied ich mich jedoch für einen langen Spaziergang auf eigene Faust, um die Route besser genießen zu können und mehr Zeit zu haben, die in den Wegpunkten beschriebenen Orte in der Nähe zu erkunden. Die Möglichkeit, das archäologische Zentrum von Corivinchos, die Höhle mit dem Puquial und andere Orte zu erkunden, war faszinierend.
Im Dorf Canchayllo findest du Unterkünfte, Restaurants und verschiedene Geschäfte. Ich empfehle das Hospedaje Natty, dessen Kontaktdaten auf einem der Fotos zu finden sind. Es ist ein gemütlicher Ort, um sich auszuruhen und zu essen, und es bietet auch das beste WLAN-Signal im Dorf. Mein Movistar-Signal reichte nur für Telefonate aus und ich hatte keine Internetdatenverbindung. Daher war der Zugang zum WLAN-Signal am Veranstaltungsort für mich ausgezeichnet.
Der Shucto Canyon befindet sich im Bezirk Canchayllo, Jauja in Junín. Diese unglaubliche Touristenattraktion ist eine Felsformation, die über Millionen von Jahren durch die Erosion des Flusses Piñascocha entstanden ist und beeindruckende Wände von bis zu 60 Metern Höhe aufweist. Der Shucto Canyon liegt im Landschaftsschutzgebiet Nor Yauyos-Cochas.
Der Ort ist ideal für Abenteuersportler, die Abseilen und Klettern üben möchten. Vom Aussichtspunkt des Shucto Canyons aus kannst du die atemberaubende Landschaft genießen und die Natur hautnah erleben.
Die Shucto-Schlucht wurde aus horizontalen Schichten widerstandsfähigen Kalksteins oder bläulich-grauem Dolomitgestein der Jumasha-Formation geformt, die steile Klippen von über 50 Metern Höhe bilden.
Der Shucto-Canyon ist eine faszinierende geologische Formation, die sich über einen 470 Meter langen Abschnitt des Piñascocha-Flusses erstreckt und eindeutig fluvialen Ursprungs ist. Die Kalksteinschichten weisen Hohlräume und Vertiefungen auf, die durch Karstauflösung entstanden sind. Die Wände des Canyons zeigen Diskontinuitäten zwischen den Schichten und verschiedene Brüche, die sowohl senkrecht als auch parallel zur Hauptausrichtung des Canyons verlaufen. Ein bemerkenswertes Merkmal der Kalksteinschichten sind die reichen Vorkommen an Knollen, die oft eine symmetrische oder unregelmäßige Form haben.
Die Wanderung durch den Shucto-Canyon bietet dir eine einzigartige Möglichkeit, die faszinierende Geologie und die imposante Schönheit der Natur zu erleben. 
Translate to English

title: Fløyen
short_description: Get the best view of Bergen
long_description:
Hike, or take the Fløibanen funicular, up to Fløyen, the best view of Bergen and enjoy the nice amenities at the top. Enjoy the view for as long as you would like before heading back down to the city in just minutes. 
Many choose to take the historic funicular to the top and enjoy a scenic walk back down through the forest. Be aware that demand can be high for the funicular and therefore you may need to wait in a line for some time.
From the top of Fløyen, a large network of trails head further into the forest, including the trail heading to Blåmanen. Enjoy day hikes in the surrounding mountains, or bring gear for camping overnight, the adventures are endless!

title: Shvil Emek HaMa'ayanot (Valley of the springs trail)
short_description: The Valley of the Springs Trail is a long, semi-circular hiking trail that starts at Mount Gilboa, surrounds the entire Valley of the Springs and ends in the city of Beit Shean. The length of the route is about 140 kilometers.
long_description: Due to the length of the route, which is about 140 kilometers, it is made in several sections. During the route, the travelers pass by springs, streams, historical sites and more. White-orange-white trail markings.

title: Bynuten
short_description: Hike to the tallest peak in Sandnes
long_description: Hike to the tallest peak in Sandnes, towering 670 meters above sea level. Enjoy the magnificent views of the surrounding mountains and fjord.

title: Vigdel Beach to Borestranda Beach
short_description: Visit three beautiful sandy beaches on a hike along the Jæren coast
long_description:
Jæren’s beaches come in all sizes and this hike visits a mixed bag of sandy treats. Starting at the small Vigdel Beach, this trail winds around a hilly point before traveling the length of Hellestøstranda Beach, past the colorful Sele Harbor, and finishing at Borestranda Beach. Throughout the entire journey Feistein Lighthouse lingers in your sight off the coast.
If you’re feeling extra energetic, start from Solastranda Beach and hike via Ølberg Beach to Vigdel Beach. This would add about 3.5 kilometers to the one-way journey.

title: La Pointe de Merquel hike
short_description: This route, to be taken at low tide, allows you to discover the culture of the salt marshes, observe the birds and enjoy the magnificent scenery, with its changing colours and atmosphere depending on the weather. The route has something to offer in every season!
long_description: This walk between land and sea passes through the oyster-farming village of Kercabellec and takes in the salt marshes and hedgerows before reaching the ocean. Follow the coast as far as the Pointe de Merquel, with its jetty and iconic little lighthouse. At the top of a blockhouse is an ornithological observatory where you can watch marine and migratory birds.

title: Dalsnuten
short_description: Short hike with amazing views of Stavanger
long_description: The short hike up to Dalsnuten (323 meters above sea level) takes you along easy terrain up to the summit, providing beautiful views of the surrounding mountains and fjord.

title: Frøylandsvatnet Lake
short_description: Explore a scenic lake from Bryne center in Jæren
long_description: Frøylandsvatnet Lake is a scenic recreation area at the northern end of Bryne town center in Jæren. A clear trail leads along the western shore of the lake and over the 230-meter long, wooden Midgardsormen Bridge to the woods at Njåskogen on the eastern side. The architecturally-designed pedestrian bridge has been placed to encourage exploration and complement the surrounding environment.

title: Mount Choungui
short_description: Discover a must-do hike in Mayotte, offering breathtaking panoramic views of the south of the island, and more if the weather is fine!
long_description:
This route takes you to the summit of Mont Choungui, an impressive peak culminating at 593 meters above sea level.
The ascent is sometimes demanding, with slopes sometimes reaching over 70°, turning some passages into veritable climbing challenges. But the effort is well worth it: a breathtaking panoramic view of the whole island awaits you at the summit.

title: Månafossen Waterfall
short_description: Enjoy the short hike to one of Norway’s best waterfalls
long_description: Månafossen Waterfall, the 9th largest waterfall in Norway, is a spectacular sight to see and located just an hour car ride from Stavanger. Enjoy the quick hike up the mountain to experience the power of Norway's nature.

title: Round St.Alban near Dießen am Ammersee
short_description: We walk from Dießen via Bierdorf back again. This panoramic circular route takes us to the heights above Lake Ammersee - and along its shores.
long_description: Our Nordic walking loop starts in Dießen at the railway station. We cross the railway tracks behind the car park and walk along them to St. Alban (1). Behind the small village is a camping site (2) with several places to stop for refreshments. At the information board we turn left to Bierdorf. We reach Bierdorf on an open field. We first turn left towards Dießen and then right. Cross a small bridge and continue straight on past the church (3). This is where the path begins. We follow the signs in the direction of "Dießen, St. Georgen". From here we have a wonderful view of the Ammersee (4). We walk past the chapel (5) back to the station.

images.caption: From the ridgeway we can catch a glimpse of the Ammersee.
Church by the wayside in Dießen

title: Varhaug Old Churchyard to Kvassheim
short_description: Hike the coastline between two stunningly located landmarks in Jæren
long_description:
This coastal hike is one of Jæren’s best, starting at arguably Norway’s most scenic graveyard and finishing at Kvassheim’s picturesque lighthouse and harbor. The trail passes by farmland with with grazing sheep and cattle that greet you as you pass. Further on, the trail comes closer to the ocean leading over the stony shore past towards Madland Harbor and meeting Norwegian Scenic Route Jæren at Hårr.
The churchyard is the southern end of the Kongevegen trail from Hå Old Vicarage (8.2 kilometers). From the lighthouse a trail continues south to Ogna (8.7 kilometers).

title: Skywalk Hohe Wand
short_description: A one-way, short and easy hiking route leading to the amazing observation point "Skywalk Hohe Wand" (or in Hebrew translation: "The High Wall"), south of the city of Vienna
long_description:
A flat hiking route to a special observation point that hangs on a mountainside in the territory of the Hohe Wand Nature Park (translated into Hebrew: the high wall). From the lookout there is a great panoramic view of the valley. A great hiking route for families and for those who want to enjoy a view from a great height that can be reached without much physical effort.
Due to the fact that the route is linear, the walking time as well as the distance shown on this page are for one direction only, but at any point on the route you can retrace the steps to the beginning of the route.

title: A trip to the chariots
short_description: A short and circular hiking route leading to an ancient engraving on a rock known as "the Chariots" and back through one of the impressive malls of Timna Park
long_description: A pleasant hiking trail leading first to a small visitor center that presents ancient finds found in the area and then a short ascent to the "Chariots" engraving and then back through an impressive mall.

title: Laguna Cuicocha
short_description: Refresh with this day trip from the famous Otavalo market
long_description:
Lake Cuicocha is a hidden gem in the Ecuadorian highlands, located a little over an hour from the famous weekend-market town of Otavalo. The hike around Lake Cuicocha is a relaxing get away from the hustle and bustle of the market, making it the perfect day trip. It’s a crater lake, which means its a result of a volcano and is 3 km wide and about 200 meters deep! There are three small islands located in the center of the glistening blue water. 
The route takes you along the outskirts of the lake, giving you ample opportunities to get incredible views! There are many trail options, and you don’t have to go all the way around the lake if you don’t want to. From the trail, you can see the nearby Cayambe Volcano as well as orchids, rich vegetation of the valley below, and wildlife. You'll notice the lake is very blue due to the high amounts of alkaline and very little aquatic life. 
The lake’s name origins are from a Kichwa name for "guinea pig", after the shape of the islands. For a different view of the lake, take a 30-minute boat ride that leaves from the visitors center. Be prepared for the engine to stall, which happens often.

title: Refugio Whymper
short_description: Hike to the second base camp on Chimborazo
long_description:
Have you ever dreamed of going to outer space? Well, summiting Chimborazo gets you to the highest point on the Earth’s surface to the moon. It’s also the highest mountain in Ecuador, and of the Andes north of Peru. This volcano stands at an astonishing height of 6,263 m.a.s.l., with the top completely covered in glaciers. Don't worry about this volcano spewing out lava though, it hasn’t erupted since around 550 C.E. On this hike you'll reach the second refuge and the highest point that does not require a guide, Refugio Whymper. This refuge, known in English as, The Whymper Refuge, is the highest altitude refuge in the country!
The hike is demanding, but very doable and can be done all year round. Although the best times to hike are June, July, December, and January. The temperature drops quickly, so be prepared with extra clothing.
Refugio Whymper is named after the first person to summit the mountain, the British climber, Edward Whymper. 
You can spend the night at both refuges, Refugio Hermanos Carrel and Refugio Whymper. Make sure you book in advance. Other less rustic options include Estrella del Chimborazo and Condor and Curiquingue, however, these are not located directly on the trail route.

title: Hike to Lac de Gers
short_description: Hike to Lac de Gers for an immersive mountain adventure: a picturesque trail leads to a serene lake surrounded by spectacular alpine scenery.
long_description:
The hike starts from the Pont de Lédedian parking lot. The climb begins gently, guiding you through alpine meadows and fir forests. The transition between wooded areas and open spaces allows you to appreciate the diversity of the landscape and observe the local fauna, including chamois and various mountain birds.
As you advance, the trail becomes progressively steeper. You'll pass through rocky sections and steeper slopes, but the panoramic views that unfold as you go are a constant source of motivation. Every bend in the trail offers new perspectives on the surrounding mountains, with panoramas of ridges and valleys.
The highlight of this hike is undoubtedly Lac de Gers. Nestled at an altitude of 1537 m, this mountain lake offers a spectacle of serenity and natural beauty. Its crystal-clear waters reflect the sky and surrounding peaks, creating the ideal setting for a well-deserved break. It's the perfect place to admire the view, take photos or simply relax while listening to the gentle murmur of the waters and the songs of the birds.
The way back is usually the same. The descent is an opportunity to rediscover the landscape from another angle, with panoramic views over valleys and mountains.

title: Hike to the Gaisberg - from Gnigl via the Kühberg
short_description: Schöne hike on the Gaisberg – üvia the Jägersteig on the Kühberg, past the Gersbergalm up to the Gaisberg summit

title: Pedra do Forno Trail
short_description: Trail climbing Pedra do Forno with 1,970m altitude that offers an incredible view of the Mantiqueira Mountains and the entire region of Gonçalves, Campos do Jord&atildeo and Monte Verde
long_description: The route is mostly through closed forest, passing by river springs and a beautiful forest of araucaria. In the final stretch a small via ferrata leading to the top of the mountain, where we have an incredible 360º view of the whole region of Gonçalves, Campos do Jord&atildeo and Monte Verde. L á on top there is a small chapel, with a logbook and still é possible to see the Baú stone (São Bento do Sapucaí) and the region of Fernão Dias (Paraisópolis and Pouso Alegre).

title: Misti Volcano Trail
short_description: Trekking for two days to the 5,800m of the Misti Volcano. Near Arequipa.
long_description: Precious hiking route with overnight stay. Route with a lot of slope and areas of greater difficulty. Overnight stay at the Nido de Àguilas campsite. Route located in the Arequipa region.

title: Blåmanen
short_description: Hike the nicest trip with Fløyen as a starting point
long_description:
Blåmanen is one of the seven mountains that surround the city of Bergen. This particular route to Blåmanen is a true gem because it takes you through the diverse landscape and gives you great views of the city, mountains, and water without being surrounded by tourists or anyone for that matter!
The trail varies in elevation, however, the slopes are not very steep. The trail starts in a sheltered pine forest, as you gain elevation there are more views including of the nearby mountain, Ulriken. The winds are pretty cold upon reaching Blåmanen, so make sure you dress in layers. Lake Skomakerdiket and Lake Store Tindevatnet are perfect places to take a break.
The trip can be hiked all year round, even in snowy weather, as it does not snow too much on the coast.

images.caption: Gammel steinlagt trase øvers mot Blåmanen fra sør.
Tidligere transportveger er nå en del av stisystemet på fjellene innenfor Fløien.
Varden på Blåmanen med tårnet på Ulriken bak.

title: Ulriken
short_description: Explore Bergen’s highest mountain by foot or cable car
long_description:
Ulriken is the highest of the 7 mountains surrounding the city of Bergen. A cable car also goes to the top, where you will have a full 360-degree view, with no other mountains obstructing the view. Here, you will also understand why locals use these 7 mountains as their adventure destination as much as possible, especially when the sun is shining.
The hike can be done year around. If it is snowy weather, go later in the day so that you have tracks to follow. There are some steep areas that require you scramble over some large rocks, but it is not too challenging! Ulriken is exposed above the tree-line at 643 meters over sea level, so it can become cold and windy. You should wear a windproof and waterproof jacket that can keep you warm and dry. The weather changes quickly on the coast, so check the weather forecast before you go.

title: Walk to the Grande Cascade
short_description: This fairly short hike allows access to the Grande Cascade from Le Mont-Dore. A beautiful discovery on the heights of the village!
long_description:
Without doubt one of the most famous hikes from Le Mont-Dore!
From the thermal baths, you start the route with a staircase climb to get some height already. After crossing the Besse road, you continue your ascent through the undergrowth until you reach the famous Grande Cascade. A not inconsiderable point of refreshment, especially in hot weather.
.
The discovery doesn't stop there! You continue your ascent by a path and then by metal steps that will lead you to the highest point of this route. From here, the plunging view of Mont-Dore is memorable! An ideal break for a snack or simply to take a break before taking the way back...

images.caption: View of the village of Le Mont-Dore
View of the surroundings from the summit
randonnée - Puy-de-Dôme: Randonnée vers la Grande Cascade
Hiking on the heights of Le Mont-Dore in the Auvergne

title: Rucu Pichincha
short_description: Climb to see the best views in Quito
long_description:
Pichincha Volcano known in Spanish as Rucu Pichincha, is an incredible 4,784 m.a.s.l. high volcano on the eastern side of Quito. The trailhead begins at Cruz de Loma, a lookout point after an 8 to 10-minute ride on the highest gondola in South America called the TeleferiQo. You’ll continue with the other hardcore adventurers for a few more hours, where you’ll get epic views of other Andean peaks including Antisana, Cayambe, Cotopaxí, Pasochoa, and Rummiñahui. You haven’t seen the capital until you’ve gone on this hike.
It’s a demanding hike to the top, but it is not a technical climb. It’s best to start in the morning because it often rains and gets cloudy and foggy in the afternoon. From the top of the TeleferiQo at Cruz de Loma, it will take about 3 to 4 hours round trip. The weather changes very frequently, so make sure you’re prepared with the right gear. Consult the Outtt day hiking packing list. If it’s not a good weather day it will be hard to see from the top, but you will most likely see Quito from Cruz de Loma. 
Give yourself a few days to get acclimated to Quito’s high altitude of 2,800 m.a.s.l. before embarking on this adventure. The teleferiQo opened in July 2005, and is open 7-days a week, from 9:00 to 20:00 Tuesday - Thursday and 8:00 to 20:00 Friday - Monday. Please remember to bring a photo ID with you, which helps organizers keep track of who’s on the mountain.

title: Laguna Quilotoa Rim
short_description: Spectacular views of a glistening crater lake
long_description:
Hike around the highlight of the Quilotoa Loop - the rim of Quilotoa Crater Lake. It’s a vigorous hike and it is perfect if you want a challenge, but you don't have a few days to devote to the entire loop. While hiking you’ll get stunning views of the 3 km wide blue-green lake on one side, and a patchwork of farms and mountain landscape of the Ecuadorian highlands on your other side. If the sky is not too cloudy, you’ll even be able to see the other volcanoes in the area.
Quilotoa is located just south of the equator, which means that there are 12 hours of sunlight every day, all year round. It’s a good idea to start this hike early before it gets too sunny during the day, or too chilly in the evening. 
The lake was only formed roughly 800 years ago when the volcano erupted after 14,000 years of being dormant. There are bubbles that are in the water, which is from the release of carbon dioxide gas. No worries, the volcano is now considered dormant. 
It’s free to camp at the base of the crater lake. It is surprisingly warmer at the base than the surroundings trails on the rim, but make sure that you bring extra layers. 
Another option is staying at the well-known Black Sheep Inn.

title: Refugio José Rivas
short_description: Hike to Ecuador’s most popular refuge
long_description:
José Rivas refuge is the cozy base camp for the volcano, Cotopaxi, and is used almost exclusively by climbers. Located in Cotopaxi National Park at 4,864 m.a.s.l., the refuge is a 1.5-hour drive from the capital, Quito. On a sunny day, you’ll get magnificent views of the top peak. Often times, upon arrival at the refuge, the view of the valley below is foggy, making it difficult to see the landscape through the thick clouds.
It’s best to visit a few days after getting acclimated to the local altitude in Quito or the surrounding areas. Remember to take breaks, no matter your fitness level or how adjusted you are to the altitude. The park opens at 8:00 so arrive early for the best weather and to avoid the majority of the crowds. Another tactic for avoiding lots of hikers is to go on a weekday.
Cotopaxi is located 50 km south of Quito in the Andes Mountains. Since 1738, the volcano has erupted more than 50 times and was relatively active in 2015. The refuge was built in 1971 and its orange square shaped roof can be seen in a clear day from the Limpiopungo Basin at the base of the volcano. Park authorities take safety very seriously and you’ll see clear signage for evacuation routes throughout the park. 
If you plan to summit Cotopaxi, your guide can arrange for you to stay at the refuge. This must be done in advance.
Tambopaxi Lodge, located in the nearby town of Machachi provides breathtaking views of the mountains for the lodge’s garden. It’s also a great place to get an afternoon snack or coffee.
Other noteworthy accommodations include Albergue de Alta Montaña Paja Blanca and Refuge campground.

title: Menesstølen
short_description: Take a steep summer farm adventure
long_description:
The long Meneseggi Ridge stretches all the way from the fjord to the alpine Melsnipa. The hike to Menesstølen gives you a taste of the ridge, and a tremendous view over the Fjærlandsfjord and the Sognefjord. It’s tough on the legs with 750 meters of elevation gain, but the reward is a beautiful lunch spot at an old summer farm.
In Balestrand you can find a choice of hotels, B&Bs and self-catering apartments. Historical Kviknes Hotel was the favourite of famous painters in the 1800s.

title: Feigefossen
short_description: Experience a rushing waterfall at close range
long_description:
Experience the roaring Feigefossen at close range by hiking up the short, marked trail to a viewpoint close to this magnificent waterfall. With a sheer drop of 218 meters, this is the second-largest unregulated waterfall in Norway after Vettisfossen (275 meters).
Surrounded by green mountains and the pristine Luster Fjord, the hike up the steep, rocky trail is worth the effort. 
Stay at Turtagrø Hotel for a traditional mountain lodge experience. The hotel dates back to the 1880s but was recently renovated. They serve breakfast, lunch, and three-course dinners. Campsite rental is also available, which includes access to showers, toilets, and a common area. You'll find the lodge along Road 55, about 16 kilometers northeast of Skjolden. It's open between Easter and mid-September.

title: Børesteinen
short_description: Experience far-reaching fjord views
long_description:
The hike to the top of Børesteinen grants you one of the best views possible of the Luster fjord and village. Enjoy as vistas of the green hillsides and pristine fjord spread out before you as you reach the top of the peak.
This hike is demanding as the trail travels steeply uphill all the way, reaching an elevation of almost 1,000 meters above sea level. Conditions are breezy and unprotected at the top, so do not leave children unattended.
Døsen Farm bed and breakfast is situated along Road 55, about 1 kilometer south of Luster. This traditional farm is now turned into a modern bed and breakfast, offering apartment, hotel, and glamping (glamorous camping) accommodation. Enjoy a locally sourced breakfast and stunning fjord views.
Another option is Turtagrø Hotel, which is located alongside Road 55, about 30 kilometers northeast of Fortun. It dates back to the 1880s but was recently renovated. They serve breakfast, lunch, and three-course dinners. Campsite rental is also available, which includes access to showers, toilets, and a common area. The lodge is open between Easter and mid-September.

title: Harevollnipa
short_description: Hike a steep ridge between the fjords
long_description:
Meneseggi Ridge stretches all the way from the fjord to the alpine Melsnipa. Halfway along the ridge is Harevollnipa, a destination for experienced hikers seeking a challenge and fjord views. The ridge itself is quite wide, but there are steep parts and a total elevation gain of 1,400 meters. The ridge lies between the Vetlefjord, Fjærlandsfjord and Sognefjord and offers stunning views.
Prepare for a long day outside and hike this trail only in good weather, primarily for safety’s sake, but also to ensure views from the top. This trail is an extension of the one to Menesstølen.
In Balestrand you can find a choice of hotels, B&Bs and self-catering apartments. Historical Kviknes Hotel was the favourite of famous painters in the 1800s.

title: Torsteinen
short_description: Stand upon a stone for outstanding views high above Lærdal Valley
long_description:
Torsteinen is a true hidden gem with views as impressive as any hike in Norway, but without the foot traffic of much more famous trails. Located in Lærdal at the edge of the Sognefjord, the long and demanding trail leads to a large stone at an elevation of 1,170 meters. From there, high amongst the mountains, an incredible view opens up down the valley to the fjord.
For a much shorter and easier version of this trail, consider the hike to Løberg.

title: "Stories of the Forest" in Buila-Vânturarița Mountains
short_description: A picturesque nature trail organized by the Kogayon Association, which admirably handles the management, maintenance, and promotion of the trails in the Buila-Vânturarița National Park. The trail aims to educate on how to differentiate between tree species, signs to look for in the forest, or sounds that you can hear on the trails.
long_description:
The informative panels start in the village of Pietreni and continue to the Pătrunsa hermitage. The route runs approximately along the border of the national park, and is very well-marked and visible so you can't get lost.
The walk goes mostly through deciduous forests, while the fir trees can be spotted somewhat higher up. In fact, two paths emerge from the nature trail, leading up to the main ridge of Buila Mountain, one on Mount Cacova, the other on Mount Piatra, and further on to the main refuge of the massif - Curmătura Builei.
The panels tell you about tree species, what happens to dry trees and how to read the footprints or the traces left by various wildlife species.
Take advantage of the bivouac shelter in Poiana Scărișoara or the refuge in Curmătura Builei to extend your stay in this mountain paradise, which continues to be sought after only by avid hikers. At Pătrunsa hermitage, almost three centuries old, you might even find a warm vegetarian or vegan meal.

images.caption: Buila-Vânturarița National Park in the area of Pătrunsa Hermitage

title: On the Elbe Cycle Route from Hradec Králové to Kuks
short_description: The scenic route along the Elbe between Hradec Králové and Kuks is ideally suited for pleasure cyclists.
long_description:
The Elbe Cycle Route is one of the longest continuous cycle routes in the Czech Republic. The route between Hradec Králové and Kuks leads through the beautiful and varied landscape of the Elbe countryside and runs mostly along the river. The easy route is not only suitable for common bicycles, but can also be ridden with children's trailers, inline skates or hand bikes. There are plenty of places to stop along the way, and the Elbe invites you to linger  
For those who prefer mountain biking, there is an approximately 12 km long single trail network near Trutnov. A total of four routes offer riding pleasure at different levels of difficulty. More information is available at www.TrutnovTrails.cz
.

title: Ås til Åsleden - Klåveröd to Jälläbjär
short_description: The fourth stage of the s til Åsledens leads from Klåveröd to Jällebjär.
long_description: From the Klåveröd recreation area we hike to the Söderåsen National Park. The often stony path leads between rocky outcrops and rivers and past places steeped in legend through an area that is one of Sweden's most species-rich plant reserves.

title: Molden
short_description: Experience a stunning sunrise over Jotunheimen
long_description:
Hiking to the top of Molden (1,116 m.a.s.l.) grants you striking 360-degree vistas of the Luster Fjord. For the best views, head to the eastern side of the peak, where you’ll see towards the innermost parts of the fjord. A tip is to do this hike during a clear summer night and watch as the sun rises over Jotunheimen at around 4am.
Except for some steep sections, the trail descends gradually towards the top and is easy to follow. 
Close to Molden is Walaker, Norway’s oldest hotel dating back to 1640. They offer accommodation in traditional rooms with stunning fjord views and serve four-course dinners. Located in the idyllic village of Solvorn, Walaker is a 15-minute drive south from Krossen.
A more relaxed option is Gaupnetunet Hotel, which offers both hotel and cabin accommodation. Located in Gaupne, Gaupnetunet is a 15-minute drive north from Krossen.

title: Solvorn
short_description: Visit an idyllic fjord village and Norway’s oldest stave church
long_description:
Solvorn is a small, picturesque village wedged between mountains along the fjord. Across the fjord, just a short ferry ride away, is Urnes Stave Church, Norway’s oldest. A visit to both locations is a relaxing day trip featuring Norwegian history and culture, delicious local produce, and of course beautiful fjord scenery.
Solvorn is a lovely place to while away a few hours, whether you’re relaxing along the waterfront or wandering around exploring. The beautiful village is home to Norway’s oldest hotel, Walaker Hotel. Further up the hill, Eplet makes and sells juices, jams, and other products made from local fruit. There are also some local walking trails featured at the ferry dock.

images.caption: Solvorn from the ferry to Ornes.
The beginning of the trail from Galden to Solvorn.

title: Sværeskaret
short_description: Travel along old trade routes to a mountain lake
long_description:
The Sværeskaret trail follows an old trade route up to the mountain lake Skarvatnet near Torsnesstølen in Gaularfjellet. The trail through Sværeskaret to the Sognefjord was the most important route to transport livestock before the road over Gaularfjellet was built in 1938. Now it is a popular hike for locals and visitors.
This trail shares a parking lot and trailhead with the Fossestien Waterfall Trail.
Hov Hyttegrend offers cabins and facilities for tents, as well as shuttle services to Fossestien every morning in the high season.
Flatheim Farm is a traditional B&B. They offer comfortable beds and facilities for camping, as well as guided trips and a summer café with local refreshments.
In Balestrand you can find a choice of hotels, B&Bs and self-catering apartments. Historical Kviknes Hotel was the favourite of famous painters in the 1800s.
Near Sande on the the Sunnfjord side of Gaularfjellet, Villa Åmot offers a unique cultural experience. In Jølster and Førde you will find both self-catering apartments and hotels.

title: Kyrkja
short_description: Take a trip to the iconic spike shaped mountain
long_description:
The Kyrkja summit is an iconic church spike shaped mountain looming over the Leirdalen valley and is a stark contrast to neighboring mountains. Its central location in Jotunheimen near Leirvassbu Mountain Lodge and Lake Leirvatnet, make it very easy to access. Kyrkja is one of the 291 peaks in Norway that are located 2,000 masl, which makes the view from the top truly magnificent.
The mountain may look very intimidating to hike from below. The trip is challenging, but surprisingly not as tough as it looks. It’s even suitable for children who enjoy heights.
In the 19th century, it was believed that no one would ever manage to reach the top of such a dramatic and steep mountain. What was considered impossible for people 200 years ago can now be hiked by 6 and 7-year-olds. 
Leirvassbu Mountain Lodge is located at the base of Kyrkja and next to Lake Leirvatnet. It has a variety of accommodation options ranging from dorms to double rooms. It is centrally located in Jotunheimen and gives you access to various exciting hikes to explore in the area.

title: Stetinden
short_description: The lesser known "Stetinden" located in Jotunheimen
long_description:
Stetinden in Jotunheimen shares the same name of the much more demanding mountain in Northern Norway. Although this smaller mountain cannot truly compare to its bigger counterpart, you'll still get incredible views. From the top at 2020 meters above sea level, you'll see Mount Leirvatnet and Leirvassbu in the west. 
This trip is one of the most popular hikes from Leirvassbu Mountain Lodge. 
The Leirvassbu Mountain Lodge, known as "The Pearl of Jotunheimen", is located in the center of Jotunheimen and is the starting point for many trails. 
Pitch a tent! Just make sure you follow the Right to Roam rules.

title: On the beach of Glowe
short_description: This Nordic walking tour takes us along the beach of Glowe, which is rich in views. The way back is partly in the forest and on the cycle path.
long_description: From Glowe harbour (1) we walk along the beach in the direction of Juliusruh. After we have left the Glowe area, only forest, beach and sea accompany us. The Schaabe with its approximately 10 km long sandy beach is a wonderful hiking and sports area. This long but also narrow headland is a very recent phenomenon in the history of the earth. When the last ice age ended about 10,000 years ago, Rügen consisted of many so-called island cores. As the ice melted, the sea level rose and Rügen eventually consisted of individual islands such as Wittow, Jasmund or Muttland. Sea currents removed sand and debris from the island cores and deposited it again between them. This is how spits grew from island to island. The Schaabe is such a spit. It connects the island cores Jasmund and Wittow. So the connection we are now walking on has only existed for about 3000 years. We enjoy the impressive view to Jasmund (2). The peninsula, over 160 m high, looks very majestic with its white chalk coast. We continue walking in a northerly direction. After about 3 km we use one of the numerous beach accesses to change to the cycle path in the forest of the Schaabe. We walk back to Glowe along the cycle path and gain an impression of the wooded dune landscape of the Schaabe (3). We pass the "Ostseeperle" (4) on the beach promenade (5) and can take advantage of one of Glowe's many refreshment stops. We enjoy very beautiful views of the Tromper Wiek, Cape Arkona and the light sandy beach of the Schaabe. In the picturesque fishing and sports boat harbour of Glowe, it is worth visiting the small observation tower. From up here we can look back on our Nordic Walking tour.

images.caption: On the spa square in Glowe there is a fish smokehouse as well as other culinary offerings.
The "Baltic pearl" from the times of the GDR has an extraordinary architecture.
The beach pavilion designed by the well-known architect Ulrich Müther is a listed building.
The Jasmund peninsula rises impressively in the east.
There is a small fish smokehouse on the Glow beach promenade.
The beach promenade allows a view of Glowe.
Many beach accesses lead through the wooded dune landscape of the Schaabe.
The striking chalk coast of Cape Arkona is clearly visible on a clear day.

title: Fantesteinen
short_description: Discover an old hiding place at 1,434 meters above sea level
long_description:
For thousands of years, cairns have been used to guide people and horses over the Sognefjellet mountain pass. However, in the old days, it was unsafe to travel, as the mountains were unreachable by the long arm of the law and tramps roamed the area. Fantestien (“the Tramp Track”) allows you to travel through history and wander in the footsteps of travelers past.
The trail runs past Fantesteinen (“the Tramp Rock”), the highest point along Norwegian Scenic Route Sognefjellet (1,434 meters above sea level). Legend has it that vagrants used the large boulder as a hiding place. Today, the mountains aren’t considered lawless areas any longer, so rest assured that it's perfectly safe to hike the trail.
Sognefjellshytta Mountain Lodge offers hotel accommodation and serves communal meals. The new, modern common room linking the two traditional buildings is worth a visit. The combination of wood and glass disperses the light through the room and imparts the changing moods of weather and light at this high altitude. The lodge is open between Easter and mid-September.

title: Gjendehøe
short_description: Gain altitude and get views quickly on a quiet summit hike that won’t take all day
long_description:
The short hike up Gjendehøe is a relatively quick adventure with lovely views over Gjende Lake, Besseggen Ridge, and the surrounding mountains. If you’re at Gjende and looking for an easier and shorter hike than Besseggen, Gjendehøe is a great option.
From Gjendesheim, you need to take a small boat across the narrow waterway at the foot of Gjendehøe. Ask about the boat at the convenience store. It’s also possible to take an alternative trail from the main road, skipping the boat ride.
Gjendesheim Lodge is a full-service DNT cabin and great place to stay in this area. It is located at the start of the trail.

title: Vettisfossen Waterfall
short_description: Hike the base of a massive waterfall in Utladalen
long_description:
Vettisfossen is one of Norway's tallest waterfalls, and the 284th tallest in the world with a free-fall of 275 metres (902 ft). It’s also the tallest waterfall in Norway that’s unregulated by hydropower. Here you can feel and hear the forceful water and feel the water spray.
It is located in the Jotunheimen mountain range inside the Utladalen Landscape Protection Area in the municipality of Årdal in Sogn og Fjordane county, Norway. The hike to Vettisfossen is rather exhausting but it´s worth while the sweat. There are many routes to choose from into Jotunheimen National Park.  Make sure to visit when it’s not raining, so that you can enjoy the true beauty of waterfall when the track isn´t too slippery. 
Vettisfossen is the highest protected waterfall in Norway, with protection dating back to 1924. The name of the waterfall comes from the Vetti Gard farm. The farm dates back to the 12th century, with the name meaning “fairy tale meadow”. Nowadays you can spend the night at Vetti Gard. 
We suggest staying Vetti gard, the farm you’ll pass on the trip that has a rich history. Single and twin rooms are available, as well as four beds and a dormitory in a room. The farm also has space to rent an area to pitch your own tent. Food is also served.

title: Thüringenweg
short_description: We hike once from east to west through the Free State of Thuringia and experience the unique culture and nature of the region. The varied landscape of hills in the northern foothills of the Thuringian Forest has many towns, villages and rivers worth seeing. Nature lovers, meanwhile, will be delighted by the beautiful valley landscapes, rivers, meadows and mountain pastures.
long_description: We start our hike in Altenburg, which is known for its skate museum, and walk through the agricultural region through Schmölln and past Posterstein Castle to Greiz. Here the summer palace is particularly worth a visit. The route continues along the White Elster to Gera, alternating between forests and meadows. On the way you can take a short detour to Mildenfurth Monastery near Wuppertal. South of Eisenberg, with its impressive castle church, we now hike along remote paths to Jena and Bad Berka, whereby the wooded sections of the trail increase steadily. We continue on our way and can take a look at the castle of the same name with its idyllic park in Großkochberg. Descending into the valley of the Saale we reach Rudolstadt, where Heidecksburg Castle offers a magnificent panoramic view. The trail passes Bad Blankenburg, where the ruins of Greifenstein Castle are only half a kilometre from our route. In the scenic low mountain landscape we continue past the monastery church of Paulinzella, over the Ilm and along the Heyda dam to Gräfenroda. We take a slightly northerly direction and pass through Friedrichroda and Tabarz. Before that, however, it is worth making a detour to Ohrdruf to see the famous Tobiashammer monument. Past Ruhla we hike to Eisenach. It is advisable to take a whole day to visit Wartburg Castle and the historic old town of Lutherstadt, which is well worth seeing. From Lauchrüden, with the ruins of Brandenburg Castle, we follow the Werra üvia Neuenhof to Hürschel and Creuzburg.

title: Galdhøpiggen
short_description: Climb Northern Europe’s highest peak
long_description:
The highest mountain in Norway looms over the surrounding peaks, providing a stunning view of Jotunheimen National Park. Galdhøpiggen is more than a mountain - it is also a symbol of the relationship between the Norwegians and the mountains. But even as the mountain is the highest in Norway, it is not inaccessible. There are three main entry points to Galdhøpiggen all at different levels: easy, difficult, and extreme.
Although the entry point from Spiterstulen is relatively easy, it does require a lot of motivation and good physical condition because it is quite a long trip. During the hike, you will scale three peaks, totaling over 2,000 meters in height! This trip is among the more sought-after hikes in Jotunheimen.
In 2010, sherpas (mountain experts) renovated the trail because of increased erosion. Make sure to follow the trail markers, to help prevent more erosion and preserve the area. Upon reaching the top on a clear day, you can see up to one-fourth of Southern Norway!
Spiterstulen Turisthytte is located on a former mountain farm and is the most convenient option as a basecamp for Galdhøpiggen. The lodge accompanies all price ranges and has rooms to book as well as camping facilities with showers, toilets, and a communal kitchen. If you are bringing your motorhome there is an option to access electrical outlets and empty toilets. There’s also a swimming pool, sauna, and seating outside to watch the river or enjoy the mountains.
The season lasts from the beginning of March to the beginning of May, and then from mid-May to mid-October.

title: Multi-day coastal circular walk on the island of Gozo
short_description: Four-day, varied circular hike on the Maltese island of Gozo
long_description:
The four-day hike along the Gozo coast is about 50 km long in total. We discover picturesque bathing spots, abandoned gorges and historical buildings on the tour.
The Azure Window, for example, is one of the island's most famous sights. Through the 40-metre-high rock gate, you can enjoy the breathtaking view of the turquoise-blue sea water. Dwejra Bay, Dahlet Quorrot Bay or the inland lake invite you to take a dip in the cool water along the way, and Fungus Rock represents a popular diving area.
Culturally, ancient watchtowers, imposing forts, traditional churches and the Ggantija temples, which are several millennia old, can be discovered on the hike. And all this with a constant distant view over the sea that reaches as far as the neighbouring islands - and with a little luck even as far as the Italian island of Sicily.

title: Besshøe
short_description: Test yourself on Besseggen’s challenging neighbor
long_description:
Besshøe Mountain is next to Besseggen Ridge at the western end of Bessvatnet Lake. The peak reaches 2,258 meters above sea level, a good 500 meters above Besseggen’s highest point.
If you want to avoid the crowds of Besseggen, or perhaps you’ve done it before and are looking for a new challenge, Besshøe is a great alternative. The hike is demanding, but the reward is tremendous views over Besseggen, Bessvatnet and Gjende Lakes, and large areas of Jotunheimen.
Gjendesheim Turisthytte is a full-service DNT cabin and great place to stay in this area. It is located at the start of the trail.

title: Wanderung im Landschaftsschutzgebiet Bosque de Puyas de Raimondi
short_description:
Eine der beeindruckendsten Attraktionen ist der Puya de Raimondi-Wald, der nur 3 km von der Hauptplatz des Dorfes entfernt liegt. Dieser Wald erstreckt sich über eine Fläche von mehr als 70 Hektar und ist einer der am besten erhaltenen Wälder in Peru.
Translate to English
long_description:
Die Wanderung zum Bosque de Puyas de Raymondi von Canchayllo aus ist ein wahrhaft beeindruckendes Erlebnis.
In Canchayllo gibt es Unterkünfte, Restaurants und verschiedene Geschäfte. Ich empfehle das Natty Guesthouse, dessen Kontaktdaten auf einem der Fotos zu finden sind. Es ist ein gemütlicher Ort zum Ausruhen, Essen und der einzige Ort im Dorf mit einer ausgezeichneten WLAN-Verbindung. Mein Movistar-Signal hatte nur Zugang für Telefonanrufe, es gab keine Internetdatenverbindung. Daher war es großartig, das WLAN des Ortes nutzen zu können. 
Eine der beeindruckendsten Attraktionen ist der Puya de Raimondi-Wald, der nur 3 km von der Hauptplatz des Dorfes entfernt liegt. Dieser Wald erstreckt sich über eine Fläche von mehr als 70 Hektar und ist einer der am besten erhaltenen Wälder in Peru.
Die Puya de Raimondi ist eine endemische Art in Peru, was bedeutet, dass sie nur auf unserem Territorium wächst. Dies allein ist Grund genug, sich für ihren Schutz einzusetzen. Darüber hinaus ist diese Pflanze mit den größten Blütenständen der Welt ausgestattet - bis zu 8.000 Blüten und 6 Millionen Samen pro Stiel - und erreicht während dieser Phase eine Höhe von etwa 12 Metern.
Der Anblick der imposanten Puyas, die hoch in den Himmel ragen, ist einfach atemberaubend. Es ist ein wahrhaft magischer Ort, der dich mit seiner Schönheit und Einzigartigkeit verzaubern wird. Während du durch den Wald wanderst, kannst du die einzigartige Flora und Fauna bewundern, die sich in diesem geschützten Lebensraum entwickelt hat.
Die Wanderung zum Bosque de Puyas de Raymondi ist eine unvergessliche Erfahrung und ein absolutes Muss für Naturliebhaber. Tauche ein in die wunderbare Welt der Puyas und lass dich von ihrer majestätischen Pracht verzaubern.

title: Kust till Kustleden - from Lärkesholm to Bjärabygget
short_description: The eleventh stage of the Kust till Kustleden leads along the old King's Path through the recreation area at Lärkesholmsjön to Bjärabygget.
long_description: On today's section of the trail we walk along an important historical travel route. The old King's Trail (not to be confused with the Kungsleden in Lapland) runs right through the recreation area at Lärkesholmsjön, which the former lord of the manor bequeathed to the suffering village community after his death. There are still old milestones along the way, which were supposed to show travellers the way to the next inn. In times gone by, this path was always dangerous, as many ruffians were up to their mischief here.

title: Via Chiantigiana
short_description: This scenic route leads from the blasting metropole Florence southwards to Siena in Tuscany. Discover the stunning world of Chianti Classico, the famous Tuscan wine brand.
long_description:
On more than 70 km Via Chiantigiana presents us one of the biggest wine-growing areas of Southern Europe. There are several small towns alongside the route waiting to be explored, among them Panzano in Chianti and Fonterutoli. Just let your eyes wander over Tuscany‘s gentle hills, the marvellous vineyards and olive groves, framed by picturesque woods.
From Florence, the cradle of the Renaissance, we drive along in southern direction to the medieval city of Siena past Ugolino Golf Course and the medieval fortress of Castellina in Chianti.

title: Nipen
short_description: Tackle a rewarding hike over the bridge from Havøysund
long_description: The trip to the Nipen peak is a great option for those looking for a more demanding hike directly from Havøysund. From Nipen you can look over the windmills on Havøya as well the islands of Rolvsøya and Ingøya further afield. Starting just over the bridge on the mainland side, the clear trail begins with a steady ascent before an easier hike across the mountain top to the edge of the western cliffs.

title: Sukkertoppen
short_description: Sukkertoppen
long_description: Sukkertoppen is a ridge hike with far-reaching views over the Barents Sea and down towards Havøysund. A tough first half of the hike features a 300 meter ascent, but you are rewarded with a flatter second half as you move along the ridge. Those with a fear of heights should be aware that the ridge becomes narrower as the hike progresses.

title: Hiking on the heights of Dourgne
short_description: In the heart of the Haut-Languedoc Regional Nature Park, this route takes you to the heights of Dourgne (Tarn) to enjoy a superb panorama of the surrounding area, particularly at the Capelette de Saint-Ferréol.
long_description:
<From the centre of Dourgne, follow first signs Capelette path. One then begins ascent for 1 km through communal forest. A stop at Saint-Stapin statue gives you a good view surroundings. Then, new climb allows to see Pyrenean peaks in distance, on clear day.
We then take beautiful forest paths crossing a few streams to reach the desert of Saint-Ferréol and its pastoral activity. A relatively wide path, along a forest of fir trees, leads to the "flagship" spot of this hike where the capelette of Saint-Ferréol is located. Not far from there, it is not unusual to come across paragliders in full flight.
.
The end of the walk takes wooded paths and sections of road punctuated by various explanatory panels.

title: Paint Pots Trail
short_description: A route to the Kootenay National Park area in British Columbia (Canada). A short and easy route, but it offers spectacular panoramic views of the Rocky Mountains and several natural Paint Pots with bright colors.
long_description:
The "Paint Pots" trail is amazing in its beauty and suitable for those who are looking for an easy but special adventure with character. The route is mostly flat with minor ascents.
As the name suggests, a series of pools of different colors await you within a short distance. This is a unique and interesting natural phenomenon that occurs several times in a relatively small area.
The Pots get their red, yellow and brown color from the acidic and metal-rich soil. The Ktunaxa people used to collect ochre to make pigments. In the 1920s, the area was turned into a National Park to protect this natural phenomenon and the surrounding landscape.

title: Løberg
