title: HUAROCHIRI: LAGUNA NEVERIA (CHICLA - SAN MATEO)
short_description:
Ruta hacia la Laguna Neveria (Laguna Quimacocha según google maps) uniendo las llamadas rutas corta y larga. El inicio del trekking es desde el pueblo de Chicla y culmina a la altura de la planta embotelladora de agua San Mateo, en el pueblo del mismo nombre.
Translate to English
long_description:
El inicio del trekking es algo demandante por la contínua subida. Luego de pasar el abra, el camino ya se dispone de forma más moderada.
IMPORTANTE: Tener muy en cuenta las bifurcaciones descritas en el trayecto, puesto que al momento de la caminata se presentan varios senderos.
A partir de BIFURCACION 2, se empieza a caminar por sendero que colinda con casas de los pobladores. En cada una de ellas hay varios perros muy agresivos. Tomar mucha precaución al transitar.
   Translate to English

title: Caparaó Waterfalls to Bandeira Peak Trail
short_description: A walk to Pico da Bandeira, considered the third highest point in the country, passing by belvederes, valleys, waterfalls and beautiful natural pools.
long_description:
The Caparaó National Park is one of the most interesting places of rare beauty in our country. It is located on the border of the states of Minas Gerais and Espárito Santo, in the Serra da Mantiqueira. Created in May 1961, the park is home to the third highest peak in Brazil, Pico da Bandeira, with an altitude of 2,897 metres. From here one can see the highest points of the Serra do Caparaó, such as Pico do Cristal and Pico do Calçado.
The vegetation of the Park is quite diverse. Its slopes are covered by Atlantic Forest and rupestrian fields in the higher parts. In some stretches there is the predominance of altitude fields. Moreover, the area has several springs forming streams, rapids, lakes and natural pools with pure and crystalline waters. It is one of the preferred destinations for adventure tourism groups, especially for the possibilities of climbing, rappelling, canyoning and other activities related to mountaineering.

images.caption: Pico da Bandeira no Parque Nacional do Caparaó, Brasil
Pôr do Sol no Pico da Bandeira no Parque Nacional do Caparaó, Brasil

title: From Kempten along the Iller to Martinszell
short_description: We learn about hydroelectric power generation along the Iller, marvel at imposing bridge structures and old factory buildings and walk for a long time quite lonely through the varied Iller floodplains.
long_description: In the Kempten area, there used to be many paper mills and spinning mills along the Iller. These were driven by water wheels. Around the middle of the 19th century, these were replaced by turbines. After these factories were abandoned, the power plants continued to be used to generate electricity. State-of-the-art technology enables ever higher electricity yields. To prevent fish from being prevented from migrating upstream by the weirs, mighty fish ladders have to be built.

images.caption: Old walls in which an Allgäu thriller was already set.
Barrage at an Ill power station.

title: Great loop on the GR34, the peninsula of Séné from Vannes
short_description: A magnificent loop which allows you to leave the old town of Vannes and then walk along the port to reach the Séné peninsula, a superb sample of the Gulf of Morbihan. Most of the route follows the famous customs path (GR 34).
long_description:
You first walk along the port of Vannes in a straight line, then the channel widens and you reach the Pointe des Emigrés. The walk at this level is very beautiful, on wide paths in the pine forest and on your left the view of Conleau, which you reach.
At Conleau, you cross the bay thanks to the "petit passeur", a frequent shuttle that allows you to reach the Séné peninsula opposite. Once on the peninsula, follow the GR to Port Anna, and continue on the seaside path. The views are superb, you contemplate the boats, and the beautiful residences overlooking the bay.
.
You continue and reach the oyster beds (tasting possible), then an area of marshland. At the level of Gorvenez, you leave the coast and cross the residences to come across a menhir in equilibrium in the middle of the buildings, surprising.
The paths cross the area as far as Séné, from where you can continue to follow the GR 34 in its entirety or like us shorten a little, the walk being relatively long (about 18 km).

images.caption: randonnée dans le Morbihan: Grande boucle sur le GR34, la presqu'île de Séné depuis Vannes

title: Elfstedentocht stage 8
short_description: This is stage 8 of the Elfstedentocht already
long_description: Today, you will cycle from Harlingen to Franeker. Franeker is an old university town. This city also possesses beautiful monumental buildings. Franeker is also known for its handball matches. This is an old sport only practised in part of Friesland s territory.

title: Bürgenstock cliff path
short_description: The Bürgenstock. It is more than a mountain. It is a myth. The rock path built between 1900 and 1905 has also contributed to this reputation. This and the spectacular Hammetschwand lift lead up to the Hammetschwand, the highest point in the city of Lucerne.

title: Walen Path
short_description: The Walenpfad is a unique hiking trail that leads from the Brunni area to the Bannalp area (above Wolfenschiessen).
long_description:
The Walen Path is a unique hiking trail leading from the Brunni region to the Bannalp region (above Wolfenschiessen).

This trail starts at Ristis. Families with children love it here. Between the summer toboggan run and the Ristis mountain restaurant, there's a huge playground. The theme is «Hop, Jump, Swing and Have Fun» - and there are plenty of toys to help kids do just that.

Up in the hills of Walen there's a large grill station with a great view of the midlands. Other highlights include a visit to Ziegenalp Oberdorf and the barefoot trail around Lake Härzli. On the three paths around the lake you can see all sorts of medicinal herbs.

The destination of the trail - Bannalp - is one of Nidwalden's treasures. This family-friendly hiking area and its mountain lake are embedded in a high valley that impresses with its powerful pre-alpine mountains. Grill stations with firewood make it easy to have a BBQ near Lake Bannalp.

Note(s)
For hiking, follow the logo on the yellow signposts.

title: Along the River Bow (Bow Falls)
short_description: An easy and short hiking route leaving the town of Banff and walking along the River Bow. Make your way to the beautiful views of Bow Falls.
long_description: An accessible and leisurely walk in the urban nature of the city of Banff. This is an ideal route for those looking for easy and short access to a great view of the waterfalls. The road leading to the waterfalls is well maintained and great to walk. It starts downhill and returns to the starting point with a relatively short ascend. The trail is mostly in a wooded area and you can observe animals on the way in their natural habitat.

title: Trip to Lake Kinney
short_description: A relatively short and easy hiking trail leads to the beautiful Lake Kinney in Mount Robson Reserve, not far from Jasper Reserve in western Canada.
long_description:
Great hike within a relatively short walk to the enchanting Lake Kinney, surrounded by a mountainous panorama. The trail runs smoothly along the undulating Robson River and passes two small lakes with spectacular colored waters.
As you have to return on the same route, you can choose to walk as far as you want to and turn back whenever you like.

title: La Lupa del Lagorai
short_description:
Breve passeggiata in quota, adatta anche ai meno allenati e a passeggini (da trekking).
Translate to English
long_description:
Passeggiata estremamente tranquilla con partenza da Vetriolo presso il punto di lancio dei parapendii.
Da qui il percorso sale in maniera costante ma estremamente dolce seguendola strada forestale che, volendo, porta anche a Malga Masi (punto ristoro generalmente aperto l'estate).
Si cammina nella zona di Pian della Casara, una delle aree più colpite dalla tempesta Vaia dell'ottobre 2018 e per questo il paesaggio è ancora molto spoglio e i segni del vento devastante sono ancora ben visibili. Per quanto opere di piantumazione e riforestazione siano partite, i risultati saranno visibili solo tra molti anni.
Questa - terribile - mancanza di alberi permette però di godere di un'ottima vista sulla Valsugana, sulla catena Cima 12-Ortigara e sui laghi di Levico e Caldonazzo.
Il punto di arrivo è l'opera "Lupa del Lagorai" dell'artista vicentino Matalar, autore anche di altre sculture maestose create con legno locale, come il Drago a Lavarone (TN) (distrutto da un incendio nell'agosto 2023), il Cervo a malga Millegrobbe (TN) o il Gallo a Gallio (VI).
Il ritorno si effettua lungo la stessa strada forestale.

La Lupa del Lagorai - Artista: Martalar

title: Hiking in Izmir Karagöl Nature Park
short_description: Izmir Karagöl Nature Park, which also offers picnic and camping opportunities with its untouched nature, is one of the best weekend activities that can be done with friends or family.
long_description:
Located at an altitude of 850 metres above sea level, Izmir Karagöl Nature Park is a large area with a large area and rich in natural beauties. If you want to do camping, yoga, picnic, if you are looking for a place to have a good time with family or friends or if you have the thought that you want to find some peace alone, you can easily come to this nature park.
There are ideal routes for nature walks in the Göl phase. You can both realise your yürüyüs and have the opportunity to camp if you wish. This route also offers you a very charming view of this göl and helps you to meet nature and have a good time among the trees. After a short walk on the road that winds around the gölün, you can take a descending route on the path that diverges into the forest.
After following the route through the forest, you connect back to the railway and the route ends.

title: Round trip from Weiler to Altenburg
short_description: The small but nice loop takes us to the old castle ruins of Altenburg. Perfect for a Sunday outing with the kids or your 4-legged companion.
long_description: A short hiking route with constant views of the Allgäu mountains. From Weiler-Simmerberg via Bremenried to Altenburg and back via Kapfreute. You mostly walk on a tarred road, the short stretch to the castle ruins is a forest path. The ruins consist of several individual parts, so it is worth looking around. The castle was built in the 13th century by Eberhard von Weiler. On the way back from Kapfreute to Bremenried, you walk along a natural path with a beautiful view of the Nagelfluh chain. The Treasure Keeper of Altenburg Castle There is a legend that speaks of a treasure guardian of the Altenburg. She was the wife of a cruel knight and after her death was condemned to guard the treasure of the Altenburg until someone came along to use the treasure for good. However, because of her hideous figure, this never happened.

title: Circuit around the Cardinquère by the Lac Nère
short_description: Nice hike from the Grand Site du Pont d'Espagne between the Val d'Azun and the Vall d'Estaacuteing to cover the Nere lake in the Pyrenees.
long_description:
<From the Puntas car park, hike starts with a passage to famous Pont d'Espagne and its waterfall before taking path running more or less alongside Gave du Marcadau. The route is easy for first few kilometres starting climb Embarrat lakes Pourtet lake at highest point of (2429 m altitude).
The route then continues to the Gave du Marcadau, where it is possible to see the waterfalls and the lakes.
The route then continues towards Lake Nère surrounded by beautiful mountains. The western side of the Cardinqu're massif can then be seen before reaching the Wallon-Marcadau refuge (1863 m above sea level).
The route ends with a short hike to the lake.
The end of the route is along the Gave de Marcadau in the Vallée du Mercadau to return to the starting point at the Puntas car park.

title: Baden - Baldegg - Birmenstorf - Baden
short_description: Beautiful and pleasant round trip from/to Baden
long_description:
From Baden Bahnhof Ost, start with line 5 (line 5: at least every 30 minutes) to Baldegg Endstation.

Take a curve around the restaurant and go in search of the outstanding destination with the coordinate: 47.47015; 8.282417. How many steps do you have to take to enjoy the view?

Go back to the bus stop and look for the official hiking signs to Birmenstorf and follow them. Stay on the path, and aim for the coordinate 47.4684; 8.262167. How high is Petersberg?

Perhaps buy something from the Wernli family farm, but in any case turn onto the agricultural and forestry path, where first fruit orchards line the path and a little further on, sweet plants are grown (coordinate: 47.46775; 8.257717). What are they?

Continue along the Trotteweg to the coordinate 47.4674; 8.25575:
What is the name of the viewpoint at the Rebhüsli? Continue. Are you hungry? Then barbecue what you have brought with you at the coordinate 47.46635; 8.252433.

Freshly refreshed, you continue the Trotteweg. What natural product is holding the vine at the coordinate 47.466333; 8.252317? It is not far to the lookout point. Enjoy the view of Birmenstorf from here (coordinate: 47.465283; 8.249317).

The steep descent to Birmenstorf is made easier by a staircase (coordinate: 47.464633; 8.2484). Once in Birmenstorf, follow the official hiking trail signs to the Birmenstorf Post bus stop.

If you are still fit enough, take the bus to Dättwil (PostAuto: Dättwil Täfere; RVBW: Dättwil Dorf) and make the hike üvia the Teufelskeller to Baden Oberstadt (Variante A).

title: From Oberstaufen to the West Allgäu
short_description: On our way to the West Allgäu we enjoy the beauty of nature. We pay special attention to the theme of water.
long_description: Above the Weißach we reach Eibele with its waterfalls. We climb the high road and enjoy the view. There we come across the border trail, which deals with the smugglers of the past. We end our excursion into Austria at the former border hut. We reach Vorderschweinh f along a little Bächlein. At Schnellers we turn into the Obere Hausbachklamm. Behind the Untere Hausbachklamm we arrive in Weiler. On our way to the railway station in Röthenbach we make a small detour to the Eratic Block, a huge ice-age boulder. We reach our destination on the old railway line. We can still marvel at the might of the Rentershofen railway embankment.

title: Walk through the Bruno Weber Sculpture Park
short_description: The Bruno Weber Sculpture Park offers an extraordinary fantasy journey on over 15,000 m² with monumental works of art, which have been created by the artist Bruno Weber since 1962.
long_description:
To get to the sculpture park, go to Dietikon station and take the 306 bus to the Dietikon, Stadthalle Ost stop. A 6-minute walk will take you to the roundabout, where Weber's seahorses will show you the way to the park (another 10-minute walk).
As you walk through the colorful gate, you will be immersed in a unique place full of detailed sculptures that reflect Weber's artistic dream.
10 minutes above the park is the Sandbühl playground, which is ideal for a family outing near Zurich. Take a break and enjoy the view of the park.
After your visit, follow the Bruno Weber Weg from the seahorse roundabout and walk about 45 minutes back to Dietikon station. The sculpture trail, which was created in 2006 to mark the 75th birthday of Bruno Weber, is lined with colorful and cheerful figures that make the walk a fascinating experience between art and nature.

Novy Svit, Cape Kapchik, Golitsyn Trail, Tsarsky Beach Trail, Crimea
short_description: The trail leads to the fantastically beautiful Cape Kapchanik, which resembles a humpbacked, curved 300-metre-long lizard slithering into the depths of the sea.
long_description: Kapchik Cape — is a truly natural symbol of Crimea, which is located in the village of Novy Svit. This cape occupies a place of honor in many travel guides and is highly demanded by travel agencies. The unique microclimate, local wine products, two excursion routes attracts travelers to the beach and lovers of Crimean unique species. Cape Kapchik is also renowned for its caves and grottoes, one of which is the grotto of Golitsina, located on the Golitsina path.

title: Tarsar Lake Trek, Jammu and Kashmir, India
short_description: Tarsar Lake is an almond-shaped alpine lake located in the Aru Valley in the Anantnag district of Jammu and Kashmir. The hiker community definitely considers it to be a very beautiful track.
long_description:
Tarsar Lake is surrounded by meadows adorned with conifer trees and the snowy peaks of the Kolhai Mountains. According to the rays of the sun, this lake changes its color throughout the day. Together with its twin Marsar Lake, it forms the end point of two famous hiking routes in the Pahalgam Valley.
An outlet stream from Tarsar Lake falls into the Lidder River at Liddervat, 15 km to the east. The basin of Tarsar and the adjacent Dachigam National Park is home to many migratory birds and rare wild animals such as Kashmir stag (hangul), Nilgiri tahr (ibex), musk deer, snow leopard, Himalayan brown bear and, most importantly, golden squirrel.
During winters, the Tarsar Lake gets covered with heavy snow and freezes. Trekking routes also remain closed due to heavy snowfall. Tarsar Lake is accessible during summer from June to mid-September. This is the time when casual tourists frolic around Pahalgam and the Aru Valley, while serious hikers flock to see the twin lakes.

title: Kust till Kustleden - from Körröd to Knösen
short_description: The fifteenth stage of the Kust till Kustleden leads from the Körröd rest area just before the town of Båstad üover a long coastal path and subsequent fields up to the Knösen campsite.
long_description: Our route today takes us through Båstad, a city that is internationally known for its tennis tournament. Every year, tennis celebrities – and about 20,000 spectators meet here. On the beach path, with a bit of luck we can watch seals sunning themselves on the warm rocks, then we walk through a nature reserve rich in species.

title: Clariden High Trail
short_description: The panoramic Clariden Hiking Trail - A fantastic hike that offers everything a hiker's heart desires. Beautiful views, varied flora, well-maintained hiking trails and views of imposing mountain ranges as far as the eye can see.
long_description:
The tour starts at the car park on the Klausenpass pass. Pass the Clariden restaurant and follow the signpost in the direction of Chamerstock. At the beginning, the trail is rather steep and requires a bit of fitness. The view of the Glatten, the surrounding mountains and the imposing Clariden, however, makes you forget all the effort. After a while you reach an impressive stone wall. Over tons of gravel, lush meadows and several small streams, the path leads rather flatly downhill to Gemsfairenhüttli (1951m). Now you find yourself on a huge, open area. A stony stream bed runs through the lush green meadow. Now the path gradually becomes steeper again. After a few metres of altitude, you reach the actual high trail. From here, the very good and almost stoneless path runs mainly at the same altitude until you reach the Fiseten Pass. Now you are directly above the mountain station of the Urnerboden-Fisetengrat cable car. The route continues over the Fiseten ridge with gentle ups and downs and a breathtaking view of mighty mountains. Now you have made it!  Arrived at the Chamerstock viewpoint you can see into Linthal and over to Braunwald on the left. Follow the same path back to the top station. The post bus will take you back to the Klausen Pass within a few minutes.
The Clariden Höhenweg. The epitome of a hike in the mountains. Only a few metres of altitude to conquer, a breathtaking backdrop and all the more enjoyment. A wonderful experience for the whole family.

title: Easy winter hike in Akams with great mountain views
short_description: The hike is a circular tour and starts from the inn "Zum lustigen Hirschen". If you would like to combine the tour with a stop for refreshments, you should make a reservation at the inn.

title: Klausenpass - Brunni - Unterschächen mountain trail
short_description: Scenic hike on the Klausenpass Höhenweg from Brunni to Unterschächten.
long_description: After an impressive post bus ride (Flüelen - Linthal line) you reach the starting point on the Klausen Pass. Below the Chlausenchappeli, the left-hand hilly trail begins out of the valley. The trail leads over cart fields and several watercourses to the Chammli. From here you can enjoy a magnificent view over the whole Schächental, down to the Reuss plain. From the Chammli you climb on the partly somewhat exposed path üvia the Chammlitritt down to the Oberalp, further üvia the Huenderli and along a winding narrow path to the Nideralp. The hike continues on the well-maintained alpine path to Wannelen, Alp Trogen and Nider Lammerbach. On the newly constructed alpine access road, through dense spruce forests, you reach Brunni. If you run from Brunni on the left side of the valley to Unterschwalchen, the valley reveals itself to the hiker in all its beauty. Unterschächen is reached via the new valley road. Passing the picturesque Bad-Kapelle chapel, you reach your destination in Unterschächen.

title: Hiking trail : Sentier des Collines - La Tardière
short_description: Take a walk along this path between old mills and peat bogs.

title: Three Passes Hike from Bormes-les-Mimosas
short_description: This relatively sporty hiking route takes you to the heights of Bormes-les-Mimosas via Pierre d'Avenon, the highest point of the Maures massif. Beautiful views are on the programme!

title: Gitschenen circular trail
short_description: Far away from the traffic and surrounded by a picturesque mountain backdrop, Gitschenen lies at around 1,600 m above sea level.
long_description: The unique sun terrace is easily reached by the St. Jakob-Gitschenen cable car. From the Gitschenen inn, follow the path in the direction of Chneuwies, where you then take the path to Geissboden. The Geissboden is used for alpine farming during the summer. An alp is an area of pastureland that is located in the valley, away from the place of residence, and is used for the summering of cattle. From Geissboden, the path leads below Alpeler to the mountain chapel and back to the mountain station of the Gitschenen cable car. The circular trail is an easy walk with a rest area and fireplace, which is ideal for getting to know Gitschenen with its biodiversity of plants and animals.

title: Schwandi - Golzeren mountain trail
short_description: The hiker is assured of a very varied mountain hike with an imposing view down into the Reuss valley and a magnificent view of the Maderan valley.
long_description: From the mountain station of the Obere Schwandi cable car, Erstfeld, follow the wide mountain hiking trail through open woodland to Strengmatt. Continue on the actual mountain hiking trail to the Evital up to the flower-filled mountain meadows on the Chilcherberge. The recently renovated trail leads through secluded forest sections in gentle ups and downs towards the destination of Golzeren.

title: Elfstedentocht stage 7
short_description: Today is part 7 of the Elfstedentocht!
long_description: Today, you will cycle from Bolsward to Harlingen. Harlingen possesses a beautiful harbour and warehouses can be found on the over. Harlingen used to be a real port city.

title: Sari Gaon - Deoria Tal - Jhandi Top Track, Uttarakhand, India
short_description: Deoria Taal - Jhandi Top is a short yet catchy offbeat track. This trek full of Himalayan beauty can also be considered as a companion track of "Deoria Tal - Chopta - Chandrashila - Tungnath Track" .
long_description:
Deoria Tal is an alpine lake situated at an altitude of 2438 meters above sea level. The lake is situated amidst beautiful meadows and is part of the Kedarnath Musk Deer Sanctuary. If you are lucky, you can also spot some beautiful musk deer drinking water from the lake during your trek.
Sari Gaon - Deoria Tal - Jhandi Top is an easy and beautiful trek for beginner hikers. If time permits, it can be extended to Bishu Tal, Chopta, Rohini Bugyal and even Tungnath and Chandrashila.
Not only this, but this area also offers a beautiful panoramic view of the huge Himalayan mountain peaks. From here you can clearly see various Himalayan mountain peaks like Chaukhamba, Neelkanth, Bandarpoonch, Kedarnath and Kalanag. Most of the family tourists return from Deoria Lake after having a picnic. But serious hikers also prefer to visit Jhandi Top, located about one and a half kilometers away. Jhandi Top is a mountain peak. While it is chock full of snow in winters, there is some snow in it even in summers. Both Deoria Lake and Jhandi Top are places worth visiting.
